src.control_plane

Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane.

Provides task specification, agent capability registry, deterministic routing, specialized independent reviewers, review reconciliation, verification plans, evidence ledgers, transparent performance metrics, project adapters, human authority boundaries, and closed-loop governed task orchestration.

  1"""
  2Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane.

  5specialized independent reviewers, review reconciliation, verification plans,
  6evidence ledgers, transparent performance metrics, project adapters, human authority boundaries,
  7and closed-loop governed task orchestration.
  8"""

@dataclass
class TaskSpec(src.control_plane.task_spec.DataClassSerializationMixin): 
129@dataclass
130class TaskSpec(DataClassSerializationMixin):
131    """Represents a discrete engineering task handled by the multi-agent control plane."""
132
133    task_id: str
134    repository: str
135    objective: str
136    acceptance_criteria: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
137    constraints: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
138    task_class: str = "feature"
139    risk_level: str = "medium"
140    required_skills: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
141    recommended_reasoning_tier: str = "tier_2"
142    preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None
143    recommended_agent: Optional[str] = None
144    # Durable audit answer to "who produced the work this task is governing".
145    # Provisional while implementation is still moving between resources, and
146    # pinned to the effective implementer the moment implementation settles.
147    # It is NOT a dispatch slot: nothing may overwrite it to tell a backend
148    # which resource to invoke, which is exactly how a reviewer's provider id
149    # ended up here on HOWLFRAM-BUG-52 (issues.md #16). Use
150    # `dispatch_resource_id` / `dispatch_target` for that.
151    actual_agent: Optional[str] = None
152    # The single authoritative effective-implementer identity (issues.md #16).
153    # Written once implementation settles -- on success, on promotion of a
154    # retained candidate, and on recovery after an interruption -- and never
155    # written by any review, remediation or dispatch path. `actual_agent`
156    # mirrors it so durable task metadata, reviewer-independence records and
157    # the final summary cannot disagree about who produced the candidate.
158    effective_implementer_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
159    # Transient: which resource the *next* backend invocation represents.
160    # Reviewer and implementation failover both rewrite this per attempt; it
161    # carries no audit meaning and is deliberately excluded from every
162    # "who implemented this" question.
163    dispatch_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
164    is_override: Optional[bool] = None
165    override_reason: Optional[str] = None
166    allowed_tools: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
167    prohibited_actions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
168    verification_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
169    reviewer_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
170    human_approval_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
171    current_state: str = "discovered"
172    task_journal_path: Optional[str] = None
173    # Exact repo-relative paths this task may commit (#59.2 Phase 8). Empty
174    # (the default) means unrestricted -- existing serialized task.yaml files
175    # without this key deserialize unaffected. When non-empty,
176    # GitIntegrationExecutor.stage_and_commit fails closed on any other path.
177    allowed_paths: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
178    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
179    schema: str = TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION
180
181    def __post_init__(self):
182        self.validate()
183
184    @property
185    def dispatch_target(self) -> Optional[str]:
186        """Which resource the next backend invocation represents.
187
188        Falls back to `actual_agent` so a caller that never set a dispatch
189        target (implementation paths that construct a fresh TaskSpec per
190        candidate) keeps its existing behaviour. Being a property rather than
191        a field, it is never serialized.
192        """
193        return self.dispatch_resource_id or self.actual_agent
194
195    def validate(self) -> None:
196        """Validates internal fields against allowed enums and non-empty constraints."""
197        if not self.task_id or not isinstance(self.task_id, str):
198            raise TaskSpecValidationError("task_id must be a non-empty string")
199        if not self.repository or not isinstance(self.repository, str):
200            raise TaskSpecValidationError("repository must be a non-empty string")
201        if not self.objective or not isinstance(self.objective, str):
202            raise TaskSpecValidationError("objective must be a non-empty string")
203        if self.task_class not in VALID_TASK_CLASSES:
204            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
205                f"task_class '{self.task_class}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_CLASSES)}"
206            )
207        if self.risk_level not in VALID_RISK_LEVELS:
208            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
209                f"risk_level '{self.risk_level}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_RISK_LEVELS)}"
210            )
211        if self.recommended_reasoning_tier not in VALID_REASONING_TIERS:
212            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
213                f"recommended_reasoning_tier '{self.recommended_reasoning_tier}' invalid."
214            )
215        if self.current_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
216            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
217                f"current_state '{self.current_state}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_STATES)}"
218            )
219        if self.schema != TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION:
220            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
221                f"schema '{self.schema}' invalid. Expected '{TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION}'"
222            )
223
224    def transition_to(self, new_state: str, reason: str = "") -> None:
225        """
226        Transitions the task to a new lifecycle state.
227        Raises InvalidStateTransitionError if the transition is illegal.
228        """
229        if new_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
230            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(f"Unknown target state: {new_state}")
231
232        allowed = STATE_TRANSITIONS.get(self.current_state, set())
233        if new_state not in allowed:
234            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(
235                f"Cannot transition task '{self.task_id}' from '{self.current_state}' to '{new_state}'. "
236                f"Allowed transitions from '{self.current_state}': {sorted(allowed)}"
237            )
238
239        self.current_state = new_state
240        if "history" not in self.metadata:
241            self.metadata["history"] = []
242        self.metadata["history"].append(
243            {"to_state": new_state, "reason": reason}
244        )
245
246    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
247        """Converts TaskSpec to dictionary representation."""
248        return asdict(self)
249
250    @classmethod
251    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "TaskSpec":
252        """Constructs a TaskSpec from a dictionary."""
253        d = dict(data)
254        d.pop("schema", None)
255        valid_fields = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
256        filtered = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in valid_fields}
257        return cls(schema=TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, **filtered)
258
259    def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
260        """Serializes TaskSpec to formatted JSON string."""
261        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent)
262
263    @classmethod
264    def from_json(cls, json_str: str) -> "TaskSpec":
265        """Deserializes TaskSpec from JSON string."""
266        data = json.loads(json_str)
267        return cls.from_dict(data)

196        """Validates internal fields against allowed enums and non-empty constraints."""

def transition_to(self, new_state: str, reason: str = '') -> None: 
224    def transition_to(self, new_state: str, reason: str = "") -> None:
225        """
226        Transitions the task to a new lifecycle state.
227        Raises InvalidStateTransitionError if the transition is illegal.
228        """
229        if new_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
230            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(f"Unknown target state: {new_state}")
231
232        allowed = STATE_TRANSITIONS.get(self.current_state, set())
233        if new_state not in allowed:
234            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(
235                f"Cannot transition task '{self.task_id}' from '{self.current_state}' to '{new_state}'. "
236                f"Allowed transitions from '{self.current_state}': {sorted(allowed)}"
237            )
238
239        self.current_state = new_state
240        if "history" not in self.metadata:
241            self.metadata["history"] = []
242        self.metadata["history"].append(
243            {"to_state": new_state, "reason": reason}
244        )

253    """Manages agent type definitions and capabilities."""

255    def __init__(self, agents: Optional[List[AgentProfile]] = None):
256        self._agents: Dict[str, AgentProfile] = {}
257        self._resources: Dict[str, AgentProfile] = {}
258        initial = agents if agents is not None else BUILTIN_AGENTS
259        for profile in initial:
260            self.register_agent(profile)
261
262    def register_agent(self, profile: AgentProfile) -> None:
263        """Registers or updates an agent profile."""
264        self._agents[profile.agent_id] = profile
265        self._resources[profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id] = profile
266
267    def get_agent(self, agent_id: str) -> Optional[AgentProfile]:
268        """Retrieves an agent profile by agent_id."""
269        return self._agents.get(agent_id)
270
271    def get_resource(self, resource_id: str) -> Optional[AgentProfile]:
272        """Retrieves a resource profile without conflating it with provider ID."""
273        return self._resources.get(resource_id)
274
275    def list_resources(self) -> List[AgentProfile]:
276        """Lists registered resource profiles in deterministic registration order."""
277        return list(self._resources.values())
278
279    def list_agents(self, only_available: bool = False) -> List[AgentProfile]:
280        """Lists all registered agent profiles."""
281        agents = list(self._agents.values())
282        if only_available:
283            agents = [a for a in agents if a.availability == "available"]
284        return agents
285
286    def filter_agents(
287        self,
288        capability: Optional[str] = None,
289        reasoning_tier: Optional[str] = None,
290        cost_class: Optional[str] = None,
291        interface: Optional[str] = None,
292        only_available: bool = True,
293    ) -> List[AgentProfile]:
294        """Filters agents matching multiple criteria."""
295        results = self.list_agents(only_available=only_available)
296        if capability:
297            results = [a for a in results if capability in a.capabilities]
298        if reasoning_tier:
299            results = [a for a in results if a.reasoning_tier == reasoning_tier]
300        if cost_class:
301            results = [a for a in results if a.cost_class == cost_class]
302        if interface:
303            results = [a for a in results if a.interface == interface]
304        return results
305
306    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
307        return {
308            "schema": AGENT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
309            "agents": [a.to_dict() for a in self._agents.values()],
310        }
311
312    @classmethod

314        agents_data = data.get("agents", [])
315        profiles = [AgentProfile.from_dict(item) for item in agents_data]
316        return cls(agents=profiles)

 972
 973    def __init__(
 974        self,
 975        agent_id: str = "fake_agent",

 977        default_stdout: str = "Fake implementation completed successfully. No issues found.",
 978        default_stderr: str = "",

 989        self.duration = duration

1025        if self.side_effect:

1037                    success=False,
1038                    error_message=str(exc),
1039                )
1040
1041        ok = (self.default_exit_code == 0)
1042        return AgentExecutionResult(
1043            agent_id=self.agent_id,
1044            role=role,
1045            command=f"fake_agent({self.agent_id})",
1046            exit_code=self.default_exit_code,
1047            stdout=self.default_stdout,
1048            stderr=self.default_stderr,
1049            duration_seconds=self.duration,
1050            success=ok,
1051            timed_out=self.default_timed_out,
1052            error_message=None if ok else f"Exit code {self.default_exit_code}",
1053            metadata=dict(self.default_metadata),
1054        )

class SubprocessAgentBackend(src.control_plane.AgentBackend): 
347class SubprocessAgentBackend(AgentBackend):
348    """Base backend for executing CLI agents via deterministic subprocess execution."""
349
350    def __init__(
351        self,
352        agent_id: str,
353        binary_name: str,
354        cmd_builder: Optional[Callable[..., List[str]]] = None,
355    ):
356        self.agent_id = agent_id
357        self.binary_name = binary_name
358        self._builder = cmd_builder
359
360    def is_available(self) -> bool:
361        return shutil.which(self.binary_name) is not None
362
363    def probe_readiness(self) -> BackendReadiness:
364        """Reports executable presence without contacting the hosted provider."""
365        installed = self.is_available()
366        native_support = self.agent_id in {"codex", "agy", "devin_cli"}
367        return BackendReadiness(
368            status=(
369                ReadinessStatus.READY
370                if installed
371                else ReadinessStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
372            ),
373            installed=installed,
374            reachable=None,
375            authentication=AuthenticationStatus.UNKNOWN,
376            reason=None if installed else "MISSING_EXECUTABLE",
377            evidence=f"executable:{self.binary_name}",
378            unattended_mutation_capable=installed if native_support else (False if installed and self.agent_id == "gemini_cli" else None),
379            capability_reason="native_role_support" if native_support and installed else (
380                "headless non-interactive mutation unsupported" if self.agent_id == "gemini_cli" and installed else (
381                    "MISSING_EXECUTABLE" if not installed else None
382                )
383            ),
384        )
385
386    def build_command(
387        self,
388        task: TaskSpec,
389        cwd: Path,
390        role: str,
391        prompt: str,
392        timeout_seconds: int = 300,
393    ) -> List[str]:
394        if self._builder:
395            sig = inspect.signature(self._builder)
396            params = sig.parameters
397            if "timeout_seconds" in params or any(
398                p.kind == inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD for p in params.values()
399            ):
400                return self._builder(
401                    task, cwd, role, prompt, timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds
402                )
403            return self._builder(task, cwd, role, prompt)
404        return [self.binary_name, prompt]
405
406    def execute(
407        self,
408        task: TaskSpec,
409        cwd: Union[str, Path],
410        role: str = "implementation",
411        prompt_override: Optional[str] = None,
412        timeout_seconds: int = 300,
413        env_vars: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
414        **kwargs,
415    ) -> AgentExecutionResult:
416        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
417        if not self.is_available():
418            return AgentExecutionResult(
419                agent_id=self.agent_id,
420                role=role,
421                command=self.binary_name,
422                exit_code=127,
423                stdout="",
424                stderr=f"Agent binary '{self.binary_name}' is not installed or available on PATH.",
425                duration_seconds=0.0,
426                success=False,
427                error_message=f"Agent '{self.agent_id}' unavailable",
428                metadata={LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY: LAUNCH_OUTCOME_NOT_INSTALLED},
429            )
430
431        prompt = prompt_override or f"Execute task {task.task_id}: {task.objective}"
432        cmd_args = self.build_command(
433            task, target_cwd, role, prompt, timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds
434        )
435        cmd_str = " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd_args)
436
437        env = os.environ.copy()
438        if env_vars:
439            env.update(env_vars)
440
441        start_t = time.time()
442        try:
443            completed = subprocess.run(
444                args=cmd_args,
445                cwd=str(target_cwd),
446                capture_output=True,
447                text=True,
448                env=env,
449                timeout=timeout_seconds,
450            )
451            elapsed = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
452            is_timeout = False
453            combined_err = f"{completed.stderr}\n{completed.stdout}".lower()
454            timeout_markers = (
455                "error: timeout waiting for response",
456                "timeout waiting for response",
457                "timed out",
458                "request timed out",
459                "connection timed out",
460                "gateway timeout",
461                "operation timed out",
462                "deadline exceeded",
463                "timeout after",
464            )
465            if any(marker in combined_err for marker in timeout_markers):
466                is_timeout = True
467
468            err_msg = None
469            if completed.returncode != 0:
470                if is_timeout and completed.stderr and completed.stderr.strip():
471                    err_msg = completed.stderr.strip()
472                elif is_timeout:
473                    err_msg = "Error: timeout waiting for response"
474                else:
475                    err_msg = f"Process exited with code {completed.returncode}"
476
477            return AgentExecutionResult(
478                agent_id=self.agent_id,
479                role=role,
480                command=cmd_str,
481                exit_code=completed.returncode,
482                stdout=completed.stdout,
483                stderr=completed.stderr,
484                duration_seconds=elapsed,
485                success=(completed.returncode == 0),
486                timed_out=is_timeout,
487                error_message=err_msg,
488                metadata=_launch_metadata(
489                    LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED,
490                    TIMEOUT_SOURCE_TRANSCRIPT if is_timeout else None,
491                ),
492            )
493        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
494            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
495            out = exc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if exc.stdout else ""
496            err = exc.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if exc.stderr else ""
497            return AgentExecutionResult(
498                agent_id=self.agent_id,
499                role=role,
500                command=cmd_str,
501                exit_code=-1,
502                stdout=out,
503                stderr=err + f"\nTimeout after {timeout_seconds}s.",
504                duration_seconds=dur,
505                success=False,
506                timed_out=True,
507                error_message=f"Timeout after {timeout_seconds}s",
508                metadata=_launch_metadata(
509                    LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED, TIMEOUT_SOURCE_HARNESS
510                ),
511            )
512        except (FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError, PermissionError) as exc:
513            # The OS refused the spawn, so the executable really is missing or
514            # unusable. This is the only in-flight error that means that.
515            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
516            return AgentExecutionResult(
517                agent_id=self.agent_id,
518                role=role,
519                command=cmd_str,
520                exit_code=127,
521                stdout="",
522                stderr=str(exc),
523                duration_seconds=dur,
524                success=False,
525                error_message=str(exc),
526                metadata={LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY: LAUNCH_OUTCOME_SPAWN_FAILED},
527            )
528        except Exception as exc:
529            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
530            return AgentExecutionResult(
531                agent_id=self.agent_id,
532                role=role,
533                command=cmd_str,
534                exit_code=-1,
535                stdout="",
536                stderr=str(exc),
537                duration_seconds=dur,
538                success=False,
539                error_message=str(exc),
540            )

484                duration_seconds=elapsed,
485                success=(completed.returncode == 0),
486                timed_out=is_timeout,
487                error_message=err_msg,
488                metadata=_launch_metadata(
489                    LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED,
490                    TIMEOUT_SOURCE_TRANSCRIPT if is_timeout else None,
491                ),
492            )
493        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
494            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
495            out = exc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if exc.stdout else ""
496            err = exc.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if exc.stderr else ""
497            return AgentExecutionResult(
498                agent_id=self.agent_id,
499                role=role,
500                command=cmd_str,
501                exit_code=-1,
502                stdout=out,
503                stderr=err + f"\nTimeout after {timeout_seconds}s.",
504                duration_seconds=dur,
505                success=False,
506                timed_out=True,
507                error_message=f"Timeout after {timeout_seconds}s",
508                metadata=_launch_metadata(
509                    LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED, TIMEOUT_SOURCE_HARNESS
510                ),
511            )
512        except (FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError, PermissionError) as exc:
513            # The OS refused the spawn, so the executable really is missing or
514            # unusable. This is the only in-flight error that means that.
515            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
516            return AgentExecutionResult(
517                agent_id=self.agent_id,
518                role=role,
519                command=cmd_str,
520                exit_code=127,
521                stdout="",
522                stderr=str(exc),
523                duration_seconds=dur,
524                success=False,
525                error_message=str(exc),
526                metadata={LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY: LAUNCH_OUTCOME_SPAWN_FAILED},
527            )
528        except Exception as exc:
529            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
530            return AgentExecutionResult(
531                agent_id=self.agent_id,
532                role=role,
533                command=cmd_str,
534                exit_code=-1,
535                stdout="",
536                stderr=str(exc),
537                duration_seconds=dur,
538                success=False,
539                error_message=str(exc),
540            )

25@dataclass
26class GitBaseline(DataClassSerializationMixin):
27    """Snapshot of repository state before agent implementation begins."""
28
29    repo_root: str
30    initial_commit_sha: str
31    status_porcelain: str = ""
32    pre_existing_modified: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
33    pre_existing_untracked: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
34    # Byte snapshots of pre-existing modified/untracked files so a failed
35    # implementation attempt can be rolled back without losing user work.
36    # Only files below the configured size limit are retained.
37    pre_existing_snapshots: Dict[str, bytes] = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)
38    snapshot_size_limit_bytes: int = 1024 * 1024
39    timestamp: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
40    schema: str = GIT_BASELINE_SCHEMA_VERSION
41
42    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
43        d = asdict(self)
44        d["pre_existing_snapshots"] = {
45            k: base64.b64encode(v).decode("ascii")
46            for k, v in self.pre_existing_snapshots.items()
47        }
48        return d
49
50    @classmethod
51    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "GitBaseline":
52        d = dict(data)
53        raw_snapshots = d.pop("pre_existing_snapshots", {}) or {}
54        snapshots: Dict[str, bytes] = {}
55        for k, v in raw_snapshots.items():
56            if isinstance(v, str):
57                snapshots[k] = base64.b64decode(v)
58            elif isinstance(v, bytes):
59                snapshots[k] = v
60        valid_fields = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
61        filtered = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in valid_fields}
62        return cls(pre_existing_snapshots=snapshots, **filtered)

def capture_baseline( repo_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path], snapshot_size_limit_bytes: int = 1048576) -> GitBaseline: 
162def capture_baseline(repo_dir: Union[str, Path], snapshot_size_limit_bytes: int = 1024 * 1024) -> GitBaseline:
163    """Captures the initial state of the repository prior to task execution."""
164    root = Path(repo_dir).resolve()
165    sha_proc = _run_git_cmd(root, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
166    sha = sha_proc.stdout.strip() if sha_proc.returncode == 0 else "HEAD_UNKNOWN"
167
168    status_out = _run_git_cmd(root, ["status", "--porcelain"]).stdout or ""
169    untracked, modified, _, _ = _parse_porcelain_lines(status_out)
170
171    snapshots: Dict[str, bytes] = {}
172    for rel_path in modified | untracked:
173        abs_path = root / rel_path
174        snap = _snapshot_file(abs_path, snapshot_size_limit_bytes)
175        if snap is not None:
176            snapshots[rel_path] = snap
177
178    return GitBaseline(
179        repo_root=str(root),
180        initial_commit_sha=sha,
181        status_porcelain=status_out,
182        pre_existing_modified=sorted(list(modified)),
183        pre_existing_untracked=sorted(list(untracked)),
184        pre_existing_snapshots=snapshots,
185        snapshot_size_limit_bytes=snapshot_size_limit_bytes,
186    )

Captures the initial state of the repository prior to task execution.

def capture_delta( repo_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path], baseline: GitBaseline) -> RepositoryDelta: 
202def capture_delta(repo_dir: Union[str, Path], baseline: GitBaseline) -> RepositoryDelta:
203    """Computes task-attributable repository delta, isolating pre-existing dirt."""
204    root = Path(repo_dir).resolve()
205    status_out = _run_git_cmd(root, ["status", "--porcelain"]).stdout or ""
206    cur_untracked, cur_modified, cur_deleted, cur_added = _parse_porcelain_lines(status_out)
207
208    pre_untracked = set(baseline.pre_existing_untracked)
209    pre_modified = set(baseline.pre_existing_modified)
210
211    task_added = sorted(list((cur_untracked - pre_untracked) | (cur_added - pre_modified)))
212    task_deleted = sorted(list(cur_deleted - pre_modified))
213    task_modified = sorted(list(cur_modified - pre_modified))
214    excluded = sorted(list((cur_untracked & pre_untracked) | (cur_modified & pre_modified)))
215
216    diffs: List[str] = []
217    tracked_changed = sorted(list(set(task_modified + task_deleted + [f for f in task_added if f in cur_added])))
218    if tracked_changed:
219        d_proc = _run_git_cmd(root, ["diff", "HEAD", "--"] + tracked_changed)
220        if d_proc.returncode == 0 and d_proc.stdout.strip():
221            diffs.append(d_proc.stdout.strip())
222
223    for nf in task_added:
224        if nf in cur_untracked:
225            ch = _generate_untracked_diff(root, nf)
226            if ch.strip():
227                diffs.append(ch.strip())
228
229    full_diff = "\n\n".join(diffs) if diffs else ""
230    ins = sum(1 for l in full_diff.splitlines() if l.startswith("+") and not l.startswith("+++"))
231    dels = sum(1 for l in full_diff.splitlines() if l.startswith("-") and not l.startswith("---"))
232    # Each hunk was stripped before joining, so the assembled patch ends without
233    # a newline and `git apply` rejects the whole file as corrupt at its last
234    # line. Preserved evidence has to be replayable -- a candidate that cannot
235    # be applied cannot be reviewed or verified (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Counts
236    # are taken above so this stays purely a serialization fix.
237    if full_diff:
238        full_diff += "\n"
239
240    return RepositoryDelta(
241        files_added=task_added,
242        files_modified=task_modified,
243        files_deleted=task_deleted,
244        diff_content=full_diff,
245        insertions=ins,
246        deletions=dels,
247        is_empty=not bool(task_added or task_modified or task_deleted or full_diff.strip()),
248        pre_existing_excluded=excluded,
249    )

Computes task-attributable repository delta, isolating pre-existing dirt.

class TaskRouter: 
 49class TaskRouter:
 50    """
 51    Deterministic task router that matches task specifications to agent capabilities
 52    without making external API calls.
 53    """
 54
 55    def __init__(
 56        self,
 57        registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
 58        resource_pool: Optional[Any] = None,
 59    ):
 60        self.resource_pool = resource_pool
 61        self.registry = registry or (
 62            resource_pool.registry if resource_pool is not None else AgentRegistry()
 63        )
 64
 65    def recommend_resource(
 66        self,
 67        task: TaskSpec,
 68        candidates: List[AgentProfile],
 69        *,
 70        role: str,
 71        operator_preferences: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 72    ) -> CognitiveRecommendation:
 73        """Ranks only already eligible resources and grants no authority."""
 74        if not candidates:
 75            return CognitiveRecommendation(
 76                resource_id=None,
 77                reason="No policy and capability eligible candidates were supplied.",
 78            )
 79        by_resource = {
 80            profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id: profile
 81            for profile in candidates
 82        }
 83        for preferred in operator_preferences or []:
 84            if preferred in by_resource:
 85                return CognitiveRecommendation(
 86                    resource_id=preferred,
 87                    reason="Explicit operator preference among eligible resources.",
 88                )
 89
 90        skills = set(task.required_skills)
 91        architectural = bool(skills.intersection({
 92            "architectural_guardrails",
 93            "systems_logic",
 94            "technical_writing",
 95            "cyber_security",
 96        }))
 97        autonomous = (
 98            "autonomous_workflow" in task.allowed_tools
 99            or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical")
100        )
101        ordered = sorted(
102            candidates,
103            key=lambda profile: profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
104        )
105        if task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1" or architectural:
106            tier = [profile for profile in ordered if profile.reasoning_tier == "tier_1"]
107            if autonomous:
108                autonomous_tier = [
109                    profile for profile in tier
110                    if "autonomous_workflow" in profile.capabilities
111                ]
112                if autonomous_tier:
113                    tier = autonomous_tier
114            selected = (tier or ordered)[0]
115            reason = "Deterministic Tier 1 task and role recommendation."
116        elif task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_3" and task.risk_level == "low":
117            local = [profile for profile in ordered if profile.cost_class == "free_local"]
118            selected = (local or ordered)[0]
119            reason = "Deterministic low risk local task recommendation."
120        else:
121            tier = [profile for profile in ordered if profile.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
122            headless = [profile for profile in tier if profile.interface == "headless_cli"]
123            selected = (headless or tier or ordered)[0]
124            reason = f"Deterministic routing preference for role '{role}'."
125        return CognitiveRecommendation(
126            resource_id=selected.resource_id or selected.agent_id,
127            reason=reason,
128        )
129
130    def route(self, task: TaskSpec) -> RoutingDecision:
131        """
132        Calculates the recommended agent and reviewers for a given task specification.
133        """
134        if self.resource_pool is not None:
135            return self._route_resource(task)
136        reviewers, reviewer_reasons = self._select_reviewers(task)
137
138        # 1. Check for human / policy override
139        if task.preferred_agent:
140            target = self.registry.get_agent(task.preferred_agent)
141            if target:
142                if target.availability == "available":
143                    return RoutingDecision(
144                        selected_agent_id=target.agent_id,
145                        selected_agent_name=target.name,
146                        reasoning_tier=target.reasoning_tier,
147                        rationale=(
148                            f"User/policy override explicitly requested agent '{target.agent_id}' ({target.name})."
149                        ),
150                        recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
151                        reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
152                        is_override=True,
153                        alternatives=[
154                            a.agent_id
155                            for a in self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
156                            if a.agent_id != target.agent_id
157                        ],
158                    )
159
160        # 2. Evaluate task risk, skills, and reasoning requirements
161        available_agents = self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
162        if not available_agents:
163            raise RuntimeError("No available agents found in the registry.")
164
165        skills = set(task.required_skills)
166        is_security = bool(
167            skills.intersection({"cyber_security", "blue_team", "red_team", "bug_bounty_hunter"})
168        )
169        is_arch = bool(
170            skills.intersection({"architectural_guardrails", "systems_logic", "technical_writing"})
171        )
172        is_autonomous = "autonomous_workflow" in task.allowed_tools or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical")
173
174        # 3. Apply deterministic decision matrix
175        selected_agent: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
176        rationale_lines: List[str] = []
177
178        if task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1" or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical") or is_security or is_arch:
179            # Tier 1 reasoning candidates
180            tier_1_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_1"]
181            if tier_1_agents:
182                # Prefer claude_code if orchestration/architecture, devin_cli if autonomous
183                if is_autonomous and any(a.agent_id == "devin_cli" for a in tier_1_agents):
184                    selected_agent = next(a for a in tier_1_agents if a.agent_id == "devin_cli")
185                    rationale_lines.append(
186                        "Selected Devin CLI for autonomous multi-step execution under high risk/tier 1 constraints."
187                    )
188                else:
189                    selected_agent = tier_1_agents[0]
190                    rationale_lines.append(
191                        f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for Tier 1 reasoning, architectural depth, and risk handling."
192                    )
193            else:
194                # Fall back to strongest Tier 2 agent
195                tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
196                selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0] if tier_2_agents else available_agents[0]
197                rationale_lines.append(
198                    f"Tier 1 requested but unavailable; routed to highest available Tier 2 agent: {selected_agent.name}."
199                )
200
201        elif task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_3" and task.risk_level == "low":
202            # Local / low-cost candidates
203            local_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.cost_class == "free_local"]
204            if local_agents:
205                selected_agent = local_agents[0]
206                rationale_lines.append(
207                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} to minimize cost and preserve session limits for low-risk Tier 3 work."
208                )
209            else:
210                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
211                rationale_lines.append(
212                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for low-risk standard execution."
213                )
214
215        else:
216            # Standard Tier 2 implementation
217            tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
218            if tier_2_agents:
219                # If headless delegation is allowed, prefer agy
220                if "headless_cli" in [a.interface for a in tier_2_agents]:
221                    selected_agent = next(
222                        (a for a in tier_2_agents if a.interface == "headless_cli"),
223                        tier_2_agents[0],
224                    )
225                else:
226                    selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0]
227                rationale_lines.append(
228                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for balanced standard implementation (Tier 2)."
229                )
230            else:
231                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
232                rationale_lines.append(f"Selected {selected_agent.name} as best available general agent.")
233
234        # Build alternatives list
235        alternatives = [a.agent_id for a in available_agents if a.agent_id != selected_agent.agent_id]
236
237        return RoutingDecision(
238            selected_agent_id=selected_agent.agent_id,
239            selected_agent_name=selected_agent.name,
240            reasoning_tier=selected_agent.reasoning_tier,
241            rationale=" ".join(rationale_lines),
242            recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
243            reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
244            is_override=False,
245            alternatives=alternatives,
246        )
247
248    def _route_resource(self, task: TaskSpec) -> RoutingDecision:
249        """Routes through the shared resource pool without bypassing policy."""
250        reviewers, reviewer_reasons = self._select_reviewers(task)
251        decision = self.resource_pool.select_resource(
252            task,
253            role="implementation",
254            explicit_resource_id=task.preferred_agent,
255        )
256        metadata: Dict[str, Any] = {
257            "resource_selection": decision.to_dict(),
258            "blocked_outcome": decision.blocked_outcome() if not decision.selected else None,
259        }
260        if decision.selected is None:
261            return RoutingDecision(
262                selected_agent_id="",
263                selected_agent_name="No eligible AI resource",
264                reasoning_tier=task.recommended_reasoning_tier,
265                rationale="No configured resource passed hard policy, readiness, capability, capacity, and economic filtering.",
266                recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
267                reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
268                is_override=bool(task.preferred_agent),
269                metadata=metadata,
270            )
271
272        selected = self.registry.get_resource(decision.selected.resource_id)
273        reviewer_mapping, diversity = self.resource_pool.select_reviewers(
274            decision.selected.resource_id,
275            reviewers,
276            task=task,
277        )
278        metadata.update({
279            "reviewer_resource_mapping": reviewer_mapping,
280            "reviewer_resource_identities": {
281                role: self.registry.get_resource(resource_id).resource_identity().to_dict()
282                for role, resource_id in reviewer_mapping.items()
283                if self.registry.get_resource(resource_id) is not None
284            },
285            "review_diversity_achieved": diversity,
286        })
287        recommendation = decision.cognitive_recommendation
288        return RoutingDecision(
289            selected_agent_id=decision.selected.resource_id,
290            selected_agent_name=selected.name if selected else decision.selected.resource_id,
291            reasoning_tier=selected.reasoning_tier if selected else task.recommended_reasoning_tier,
292            rationale=(recommendation.reason if recommendation else "Deterministic resource selection."),
293            recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
294            reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
295            is_override=decision.explicit_override,
296            alternatives=[
297                identity.resource_id for identity in decision.eligible_resources
298                if identity.resource_id != decision.selected.resource_id
299            ],
300            metadata=metadata,
301        )
302
303    def _select_reviewers(self, task: TaskSpec) -> Tuple[List[str], Dict[str, str]]:
304        """
305        Determines the specialized reviewer roles required for the task and records explicit rationales.
306        """
307        reviewers: List[str] = []
308        reasons: Dict[str, str] = {}
309
310        def add_reviewer(role: str, reason: str):
311            if role not in reviewers:
312                reviewers.append(role)
313                reasons[role] = reason
314
315        # If the task explicitly lists required reviewers, honor that as the
316        # authoritative starting set instead of the default baseline. This lets
317        # special tasks (e.g., the live acceptance canary, which produces an
318        # evidence artifact rather than production code) avoid reviewers that
319        # are inappropriate for their scope, while preserving the security and
320        # risk-based additions below.
321        if task.reviewer_requirements:
322            for req in task.reviewer_requirements:
323                add_reviewer(req, "Explicitly required by TaskSpec reviewer_requirements.")
324        else:
325            # Baseline reviewers for ordinary tasks
326            add_reviewer("correctness-reviewer", "Baseline correctness, edge cases, and acceptance contract verification.")
327            add_reviewer("test-falsifier", "Adversarial test verification, missing negative branch and vacuous assertion checks.")
328
329        skills = set(task.required_skills)
330        if task.risk_level in ("high", "critical") or skills.intersection(
331            {"cyber_security", "blue_team", "red_team", "bug_bounty_hunter"}
332        ):
333            add_reviewer("security-reviewer", "Triggered by high/critical risk level or security-related skill requirements.")
334
335        if skills.intersection({"architectural_guardrails", "systems_logic", "technical_writing"}) or task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1":
336            add_reviewer("architecture-reviewer", "Triggered by Tier 1 reasoning requirement or architectural skill requirements.")
337
338        if task.risk_level in ("medium", "high", "critical"):
339            add_reviewer("regression-reviewer", "Triggered by medium/high/critical risk scope to protect existing contracts and call sites.")
340
341        # Simplicity reviewer for refactoring or multi-file work
342        add_reviewer("simplicity-reviewer", "Minimal diff review to prevent overengineering and eliminate dead code.")
343
344        return reviewers, reasons

Deterministic task router that matches task specifications to agent capabilities without making external API calls.

TaskRouter( registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None, resource_pool: Optional[Any] = None) 
55    def __init__(
56        self,
57        registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
58        resource_pool: Optional[Any] = None,
59    ):
60        self.resource_pool = resource_pool
61        self.registry = registry or (
62            resource_pool.registry if resource_pool is not None else AgentRegistry()

def recommend_resource( self, task: TaskSpec, candidates: List[AgentProfile], *, role: str, operator_preferences: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> src.control_plane.resource_models.CognitiveRecommendation: 
 65    def recommend_resource(
 66        self,
 67        task: TaskSpec,
 68        candidates: List[AgentProfile],
 69        *,
 70        role: str,
 71        operator_preferences: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 72    ) -> CognitiveRecommendation:
 73        """Ranks only already eligible resources and grants no authority."""
 74        if not candidates:
 75            return CognitiveRecommendation(
 76                resource_id=None,
 77                reason="No policy and capability eligible candidates were supplied.",
 78            )
 79        by_resource = {
 80            profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id: profile
 81            for profile in candidates
 82        }
 83        for preferred in operator_preferences or []:
 84            if preferred in by_resource:
 85                return CognitiveRecommendation(
 86                    resource_id=preferred,
 87                    reason="Explicit operator preference among eligible resources.",
 88                )
 89
 90        skills = set(task.required_skills)
 91        architectural = bool(skills.intersection({
 92            "architectural_guardrails",
 93            "systems_logic",
 94            "technical_writing",
 95            "cyber_security",
 96        }))
 97        autonomous = (
 98            "autonomous_workflow" in task.allowed_tools
 99            or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical")
100        )
101        ordered = sorted(
102            candidates,
103            key=lambda profile: profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
104        )
105        if task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1" or architectural:
106            tier = [profile for profile in ordered if profile.reasoning_tier == "tier_1"]
107            if autonomous:
108                autonomous_tier = [
109                    profile for profile in tier
110                    if "autonomous_workflow" in profile.capabilities
111                ]
112                if autonomous_tier:
113                    tier = autonomous_tier
114            selected = (tier or ordered)[0]
115            reason = "Deterministic Tier 1 task and role recommendation."
116        elif task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_3" and task.risk_level == "low":
117            local = [profile for profile in ordered if profile.cost_class == "free_local"]
118            selected = (local or ordered)[0]
119            reason = "Deterministic low risk local task recommendation."
120        else:
121            tier = [profile for profile in ordered if profile.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
122            headless = [profile for profile in tier if profile.interface == "headless_cli"]
123            selected = (headless or tier or ordered)[0]
124            reason = f"Deterministic routing preference for role '{role}'."
125        return CognitiveRecommendation(
126            resource_id=selected.resource_id or selected.agent_id,
127            reason=reason,
128        )

Ranks only already eligible resources and grants no authority.

def route( self, task: TaskSpec) -> RoutingDecision: 
130    def route(self, task: TaskSpec) -> RoutingDecision:
131        """
132        Calculates the recommended agent and reviewers for a given task specification.
133        """
134        if self.resource_pool is not None:
135            return self._route_resource(task)
136        reviewers, reviewer_reasons = self._select_reviewers(task)
137
138        # 1. Check for human / policy override
139        if task.preferred_agent:
140            target = self.registry.get_agent(task.preferred_agent)
141            if target:
142                if target.availability == "available":
143                    return RoutingDecision(
144                        selected_agent_id=target.agent_id,
145                        selected_agent_name=target.name,
146                        reasoning_tier=target.reasoning_tier,
147                        rationale=(
148                            f"User/policy override explicitly requested agent '{target.agent_id}' ({target.name})."
149                        ),
150                        recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
151                        reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
152                        is_override=True,
153                        alternatives=[
154                            a.agent_id
155                            for a in self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
156                            if a.agent_id != target.agent_id
157                        ],
158                    )
159
160        # 2. Evaluate task risk, skills, and reasoning requirements
161        available_agents = self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
162        if not available_agents:
163            raise RuntimeError("No available agents found in the registry.")
164
165        skills = set(task.required_skills)
166        is_security = bool(
167            skills.intersection({"cyber_security", "blue_team", "red_team", "bug_bounty_hunter"})
168        )
169        is_arch = bool(
170            skills.intersection({"architectural_guardrails", "systems_logic", "technical_writing"})
171        )
172        is_autonomous = "autonomous_workflow" in task.allowed_tools or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical")
173
174        # 3. Apply deterministic decision matrix
175        selected_agent: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
176        rationale_lines: List[str] = []
177
178        if task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1" or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical") or is_security or is_arch:
179            # Tier 1 reasoning candidates
180            tier_1_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_1"]
181            if tier_1_agents:
182                # Prefer claude_code if orchestration/architecture, devin_cli if autonomous
183                if is_autonomous and any(a.agent_id == "devin_cli" for a in tier_1_agents):
184                    selected_agent = next(a for a in tier_1_agents if a.agent_id == "devin_cli")
185                    rationale_lines.append(
186                        "Selected Devin CLI for autonomous multi-step execution under high risk/tier 1 constraints."
187                    )
188                else:
189                    selected_agent = tier_1_agents[0]
190                    rationale_lines.append(
191                        f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for Tier 1 reasoning, architectural depth, and risk handling."
192                    )
193            else:
194                # Fall back to strongest Tier 2 agent
195                tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
196                selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0] if tier_2_agents else available_agents[0]
197                rationale_lines.append(
198                    f"Tier 1 requested but unavailable; routed to highest available Tier 2 agent: {selected_agent.name}."
199                )
200
201        elif task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_3" and task.risk_level == "low":
202            # Local / low-cost candidates
203            local_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.cost_class == "free_local"]
204            if local_agents:
205                selected_agent = local_agents[0]
206                rationale_lines.append(
207                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} to minimize cost and preserve session limits for low-risk Tier 3 work."
208                )
209            else:
210                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
211                rationale_lines.append(
212                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for low-risk standard execution."
213                )
214
215        else:
216            # Standard Tier 2 implementation
217            tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
218            if tier_2_agents:
219                # If headless delegation is allowed, prefer agy
220                if "headless_cli" in [a.interface for a in tier_2_agents]:
221                    selected_agent = next(
222                        (a for a in tier_2_agents if a.interface == "headless_cli"),
223                        tier_2_agents[0],
224                    )
225                else:
226                    selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0]
227                rationale_lines.append(
228                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for balanced standard implementation (Tier 2)."
229                )
230            else:
231                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
232                rationale_lines.append(f"Selected {selected_agent.name} as best available general agent.")
233
234        # Build alternatives list
235        alternatives = [a.agent_id for a in available_agents if a.agent_id != selected_agent.agent_id]
236
237        return RoutingDecision(
238            selected_agent_id=selected_agent.agent_id,
239            selected_agent_name=selected_agent.name,
240            reasoning_tier=selected_agent.reasoning_tier,
241            rationale=" ".join(rationale_lines),
242            recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
243            reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
244            is_override=False,
245            alternatives=alternatives,
246        )

Calculates the recommended agent and reviewers for a given task specification.

REVIEWER_ROLES = {'correctness-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='correctness-reviewer', name='Correctness Reviewer', focus_areas=['correctness', 'edge_cases', 'contract_compliance', 'error_handling'], falsification_goal='Produce a concrete input or state where code violates requirements, fails on edge cases, or contains logic bugs.', prompt_template='You are an independent Correctness Reviewer. Your role is strictly adversarial to buggy code.\nDo NOT assume the code works just because it appears clean or passes basic tests.\nYour primary objective is to produce a concrete input, state, or execution path where behavior violates requirements or logic:\n1. Logic bugs, off-by-one errors, inverse condition checks, incorrect boolean logic.\n2. Unhandled edge cases (None/null, empty collections, negative numbers, timeouts, unexpected types).\n3. Mismatches where the code fails to strictly fulfill an acceptance criterion.\n4. Broken error handling or swallowed exceptions that mask underlying failures.\n5. Incomplete state transitions or unhandled error recovery states.\n'), 'regression-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='regression-reviewer', name='Regression Reviewer', focus_areas=['regression', 'backwards_compatibility', 'call_sites', 'contract_drift'], falsification_goal='Identify previously valid behavior, caller contracts, or configurations broken by this change.', prompt_template='You are an independent Regression Reviewer. Your job is to protect existing functionality from breakage.\nDo NOT evaluate whether the new feature is nice; evaluate what previously valid behavior is now broken.\nSearch specifically for:\n1. Breaking changes to function/method signatures, interfaces, or return types.\n2. Deleted or renamed attributes/variables still referenced elsewhere in the repository.\n3. Behavior changes for existing callers under default parameters or existing workflows.\n4. Schema migrations, configuration drifts, or altered environment assumptions.\n5. Inadvertently altered public contracts or library APIs.\n'), 'security-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='security-reviewer', name='Security Reviewer', focus_areas=['security', 'vulnerabilities', 'credentials', 'injection', 'authorization'], falsification_goal='Identify trust-boundary violations, unsafe execution, secret exposure, authorization gaps, or fail-open logic.', prompt_template='You are an independent Security Reviewer. Your job is to identify security vulnerabilities, credential leaks, and unsafe patterns.\nAttempt to identify trust-boundary violations, unsafe execution, secret exposure, authorization gaps, injection surfaces, or fail-open behavior:\n1. Hardcoded secrets, API keys, credentials, PII, or internal tokens.\n2. Unsafe command execution, unescaped shell interpolations (`shell=True`, bash backtick injection, subprocess without list args).\n3. Missing input validation, path traversal (`../`), unconstrained deserialization, or unvalidated file writes.\n4. Authorization flaws, bypasses of human approval gates, or fail-open authorization logic.\n5. Insecure defaults or sensitive data leakage in logs or exceptions.\n'), 'test-falsifier': ReviewerRole(role_id='test-falsifier', name='Test Falsifier', focus_areas=['test_gap', 'vacuous_tests', 'mock_fidelity', 'untested_branches'], falsification_goal='Prove the test suite is inadequate or construct a broken implementation that still passes tests.', prompt_template="You are an independent Test Falsifier. Code implementations that pass the test suite while violating the true task requirements.\n"), 'architecture-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='architecture-reviewer', name='Architecture Reviewer', focus_areas=['architecture', 'coupling', 'abstraction_quality', 'boundary_discipline'], falsification_goal='Identify structural coupling, leaky abstractions, and layering violations that materially raise risk.', prompt_template="You are an independent Architecture Reviewer. Unnecessary coupling between unrelated modules or circular dependencies.\n2. Leaky abstractions or single-caller abstractions that add indirection without value.\n3. Violations of the repository's established layer boundaries (e.g. domain vs infrastructure vs orchestration).\n4. Redundant boilerplate that obscures business logic.\nNOTE: Do NOT propose rewrites merely for elegance; focus on removing actual excess complexity.\n')}

 735class ReviewRunner:
 736    """Orchestrates independent review runs, output parsing, and reconciliation."""
 737
 738    @classmethod
 739    def _reconstruct_cached_review(
 740        cls,
 741        cycle_dir: Optional[Path],
 742        role_id: str,
 743        role_name: str,
 744    ) -> Optional["SingleReviewResult"]:
 745        """Rebuilds a reviewer's durable state after an interruption.
 746
 747        Prefers the persisted `result.json`, which records exactly what the
 748        live path concluded. Runs predating that file fall back to judging the
 749        transcript itself: an empty one reconstructs as `output_invalid`, never
 750        as clean. Returns None when the reviewer genuinely never ran.
 751        """
 752        if cycle_dir is None:
 753            return None
 754
 755        cached_md = cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md"
 756        cached_yaml = cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml"
 757
 758        persisted = read_review_result(cycle_dir, role_id)
 759        raw_text = ""
 760        if cached_md.is_file():
 761            try:
 762                raw_text = cached_md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 763            except Exception:
 764                raw_text = ""
 765
 766        if persisted is not None:
 767            findings: List[ReviewFinding] = []
 768            if persisted.get("status") in ("clean", "findings_detected"):
 769                findings = cls._load_cached_findings(cached_yaml)
 770            return SingleReviewResult(
 771                reviewer_role=role_id,
 772                reviewer_name=role_name,
 773                status=persisted.get("status", REVIEW_STATUS_NOT_RUN),
 774                findings=findings,
 775                raw_output=raw_text,
 776                error_message=persisted.get("raw_failure"),
 777                duration_seconds=persisted.get("duration_seconds", 0.0) or 0.0,
 778                attempts=(persisted.get("failover") or {}).get("attempts", []),
 779            )
 780
 781        if not (cached_md.is_file() and cached_yaml.is_file()):
 782            return None
 783
 784        # Legacy evidence, written before reviewer results were persisted. The
 785        # findings file cannot settle this on its own -- an empty list is what a
 786        # deliberate clean review and a dead provider both leave behind. The
 787        # transcript can: a reviewer that emitted nothing at all did not review
 788        # anything, whatever its findings file says. That is exactly the pair
 789        # SLOPFIX-06 reconstructed as clean (0-byte transcript, `[]` findings).
 790        if not raw_text.strip():
 791            return SingleReviewResult(
 792                reviewer_role=role_id,
 793                reviewer_name=role_name,
 794                status="output_invalid",
 795                findings=[],
 796                raw_output="",
 797                error_message=(
 798                    "Reviewer transcript is empty; no durable result was "
 799                    "recorded, so the review cannot be treated as completed."
 800                ),
 801                duration_seconds=0.0,
 802            )
 803
 804        findings = cls._load_cached_findings(cached_yaml)
 805        return SingleReviewResult(
 806            reviewer_role=role_id,
 807            reviewer_name=role_name,
 808            status="findings_detected" if findings else "clean",
 809            findings=findings,
 810            raw_output=raw_text,
 811            error_message=None,
 812            duration_seconds=0.0,
 813        )
 814
 815    @staticmethod
 816    def _load_cached_findings(cached_yaml: Path) -> List[ReviewFinding]:
 817        """Reads a persisted findings file, tolerating both list and mapping forms."""
 818        if not cached_yaml.is_file():
 819            return []
 820        try:
 821            raw_data = yaml.safe_load(cached_yaml.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or []
 822        except Exception:
 823            return []
 824        if isinstance(raw_data, dict):
 825            entries = raw_data.get("findings", [])
 826        elif isinstance(raw_data, list):
 827            entries = raw_data
 828        else:
 829            entries = []
 830        out: List[ReviewFinding] = []
 831        for item in entries:
 832            try:
 833                out.append(
 834                    ReviewFinding.from_dict(item) if isinstance(item, dict) else item
 835                )
 836            except Exception:
 837                continue
 838        return out

 840    @classmethod
 841    def execute_review_cycle(
 842        cls,
 843        task: TaskSpec,
 844        diff_content: str,
 845        reviewer_roles: List[str],
 846        cwd: Union[str, Path],
 847        backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None,
 848        cycle_index: int = 1,
 849        reviewer_agent_mapping: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 850        custom_reviewer_fn: Optional[Callable[[str, str, TaskSpec], str]] = None,
 851        run_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 852        provider_pool: Optional[Any] = None,
 853        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
 854        implementer_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
 855    ) -> ReviewCycleResult:
 856        """
 857        Executes each specified reviewer independently against the actual implementation diff.
 858        Preserves already-completed reviewer artifacts from previous interrupted runs.
 859
 860        `provider_pool` is optional (#59.2 Phase 4): when supplied, a reviewer
 861        whose primary assignment fails, times out, or produces invalid output
 862        gets one bounded fallback attempt against an independent candidate via
 863        `invoke_reviewer_with_failover`, mirroring implementation failover.
 864        Omitting it (the default, and the only behavior any caller exercised
 865        before #59.2) preserves the prior single-attempt-per-role behavior
 866        exactly.
 867        """
 868        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
 869        reviewer_results: Dict[str, SingleReviewResult] = {}
 870        all_findings: List[ReviewFinding] = []
 871        has_failure = False
 872        non_independent_roles: List[str] = []
 873
 874        skill_context = build_skill_context(task)
 875
 876        # Establish cycle directory for incremental checkpointing
 877        cycle_dir: Optional[Path] = None
 878        if run_dir:
 879            r_path = Path(run_dir).resolve()
 880            if cycle_index == 1:
 881                cycle_dir = r_path / "reviews"
 882            else:
 883                cycle_dir = r_path / "remediation" / f"cycle-{cycle_index - 1:02d}" / "re_review"
 884            cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 885
 886        for role_id in reviewer_roles:
 887            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
 888            role_name = role.name if role else role_id
 889
 890            # Reconstruct a reviewer that already ran in an interrupted run.
 891            # Status comes from the persisted result, never from the shape of
 892            # the findings file: inferring "clean" from an empty list turned a
 893            # dead reviewer's zero-byte output into a passing review and
 894            # skipped the retry it was owed (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
 895            cached_result = cls._reconstruct_cached_review(
 896                cycle_dir, role_id, role_name
 897            )
 898
 899            if cached_result is not None:
 900                if cached_result.status in ("clean", "findings_detected"):
 901                    reviewer_results[role_id] = cached_result
 902                    all_findings.extend(cached_result.findings)
 903                    continue
 904                # Persisted as invalid/failed: it stays invalid, and the role is
 905                # re-run under the normal policy below rather than being
 906                # silently accepted.
 907
 908            # Render brief with the REAL implementation diff and skill context
 909            brief = (
 910                role.render_brief(task=task, diff_content=diff_content, context=skill_context)
 911                if role
 912                else f"# Review Brief for {role_id}\n{skill_context or ''}\n```diff\n{diff_content}\n```"
 913            )
 914
 915            raw_output = ""
 916            err_message = None
 917            agent_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
 918            duration = 0.0
 919
 920            attempts_log: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
 921            assigned_agent = (reviewer_agent_mapping or {}).get(role_id) or "claude_code"
 922            if backend:
 923                assigned_agent = getattr(backend, "agent_id", assigned_agent)
 924
 925            from src.control_plane.progress import track_operation
 926            with track_operation(
 927                progress_tracker,
 928                phase="REVIEWING",
 929                resource_id=assigned_agent,
 930                role="review",
 931                cycle=cycle_index,
 932                details=f"cycle {cycle_index}",
 933            ):
 934                if custom_reviewer_fn:
 935                    try:
 936                        raw_output = custom_reviewer_fn(role_id, diff_content, task)
 937                    except Exception as exc:
 938                        err_message = str(exc)
 939                        has_failure = True
 940                elif provider_pool is not None and not backend:
 941                    candidates = build_reviewer_candidates(
 942                        role_id, assigned_agent, provider_pool, task, implementer_resource_id
 943                    )
 944                    winner, agent_res, attempts_log = invoke_reviewer_with_failover(
 945                        role_id=role_id,
 946                        candidates=candidates,
 947                        task=task,
 948                        cwd=target_cwd,
 949                        prompt_override=brief,
 950                        backend_lookup=lambda aid: AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(aid),
 951                        provider_pool=provider_pool,
 952                    )
 953                    duration = agent_res.duration_seconds if agent_res else 0.0
 954                    if winner and implementer_resource_id and winner == implementer_resource_id:
 955                        # Failover exhausted every independent candidate and fell
 956                        # through to the implementer. The review still runs, but a
 957                        # change reviewed by its own author is not independently
 958                        # reviewed, and the gate has to say so.
 959                        non_independent_roles.append(role_id)
 960                    if winner and agent_res:
 961                        raw_output = agent_res.stdout
 962                    else:
 963                        err_message = "All candidate reviewers failed or were unavailable"
 964                        has_failure = True
 965                else:
 966                    selected_backend = backend or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(assigned_agent)
 967                    agent_res = selected_backend.execute(
 968                        task=task,
 969                        cwd=target_cwd,
 970                        role=role_id,
 971                        prompt_override=brief,
 972                        timeout_seconds=REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
 973                    )
 974                    duration = agent_res.duration_seconds
 975                    if agent_res.success:
 976                        raw_output = agent_res.stdout
 977                    else:
 978                        err_message = agent_res.stderr or agent_res.error_message
 979                        has_failure = True
 980
 981            findings, parse_err, is_valid_output = parse_and_validate_findings(raw_output, role_id)
 982            if parse_err:
 983                has_failure = True
 984                status = "malformed_output"
 985            elif err_message:
 986                status = "reviewer_failure"
 987            elif findings:
 988                status = "findings_detected"
 989            elif not is_valid_output:
 990                has_failure = True
 991                status = "output_invalid"
 992            else:
 993                status = "clean"
 994
 995            single_res = SingleReviewResult(
 996                reviewer_role=role_id,
 997                reviewer_name=role_name,
 998                status=status,
 999                findings=findings,
1000                raw_output=raw_output,
1001                error_message=err_message or parse_err,
1002                duration_seconds=duration,
1003                agent_result=agent_res,
1004                attempts=attempts_log,
1005            )
1006            reviewer_results[role_id] = single_res
1007            all_findings.extend(findings)
1008
1009            # Persist individual reviewer artifact incrementally. The legacy
1010            # markdown/findings pair stays for backward compatibility; the
1011            # result record is what resume actually reads.
1012            if cycle_dir:
1013                from src.control_plane.atomic_io import atomic_write_text, atomic_write_yaml
1014                try:
1015                    atomic_write_text(cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md", raw_output)
1016                    atomic_write_yaml(
1017                        cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml",
1018                        [f.to_dict() for f in findings],
1019                        sort_keys=False,
1020                    )
1021                    write_review_result(
1022                        cycle_dir,
1023                        role_id,
1024                        single_res,
1025                        implementer=implementer_resource_id,
1026                        assigned_resource=assigned_agent,
1027                    )
1028                except Exception as persist_err:
1029                    # A review whose evidence did not survive is not a review we
1030                    # may later reconstruct as clean. Mark it failed loudly
1031                    # rather than leaving a half-written pair on disk.
1032                    single_res.status = "reviewer_failure"
1033                    single_res.error_message = (
1034                        f"Reviewer evidence could not be persisted: {persist_err}"
1035                    )
1036                    has_failure = True
1037
1038        # Run reconciliation across all gathered findings
1039        reconciliation = ReviewReconciler.reconcile(all_findings) if all_findings else None
1040
1041        # Check if remediation is needed: unresolved blockers > 0, unresolved highs
1042        # > 0, or any reviewer failed to complete (#59.2 Phase 3). A reviewer that
1043        # never ran/parsed successfully must never be silently indistinguishable
1044        # from "ran cleanly, found nothing" -- has_failure alone must gate here,
1045        # independent of whether any findings exist to reconcile.
1046        requires_remediation = False
1047        if has_failure:
1048            requires_remediation = True
1049        if reconciliation:
1050            if reconciliation.unresolved_blockers > 0 or reconciliation.unresolved_highs > 0:
1051                requires_remediation = True
1052            elif reconciliation.confirmed or reconciliation.likely:
1053                requires_remediation = True
1054
1055        overall_status = "review_failure" if has_failure else ("has_findings" if all_findings else "clean")
1056
1057        return ReviewCycleResult(
1058            cycle_index=cycle_index,
1059            reviewer_results=reviewer_results,
1060            all_findings=all_findings,
1061            reconciliation=reconciliation,
1062            status=overall_status,
1063            requires_remediation=requires_remediation,
1064            non_independent_roles=non_independent_roles,
1065        )
1066
1067    @classmethod
1068    def determine_re_review_roles(
1069        cls,
1070        findings: List[ReviewFinding],
1071        original_roles: List[str],
1072    ) -> List[str]:
1073        """
1074        Deterministically selects targeted reviewers for re-review after remediation.
1075        """
1076        if not findings:
1077            return list(original_roles)
1078
1079        selected: Set[str] = set()
1080        for f in findings:
1081            cat = (f.category or "").lower()
1082            role = f.reviewer_role
1083
1084            if role:
1085                selected.add(role)
1086
1087            if cat in ("security", "vuln", "auth"):
1088                selected.update(["security-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer", "test-falsifier"])
1089            elif cat in ("architecture", "coupling", "boundary"):
1090                selected.update(["architecture-reviewer", "regression-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
1091            elif cat in ("regression", "breaking_change"):
1092                selected.update(["regression-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
1093            elif cat in ("test_gap", "missing_test", "vacuous_test"):
1094                selected.update(["test-falsifier", "correctness-reviewer"])
1095            elif cat in ("simplicity", "complexity", "dead_code"):
1096                selected.update(["simplicity-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
1097            else:
1098                selected.update(["correctness-reviewer", "test-falsifier"])
1099
1100        # Filter against available original roles or known reviewer roles
1101        target_roles = [r for r in original_roles if r in selected]
1102        if not target_roles:
1103            target_roles = list(selected)
1104        return sorted(list(set(target_roles)))
