1016                    atomic_write_yaml(
1017                        cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml",
1018                        [f.to_dict() for f in findings],
1019                        sort_keys=False,
1020                    )
1021                    write_review_result(
1022                        cycle_dir,
1023                        role_id,
1024                        single_res,
1025                        implementer=implementer_resource_id,
1026                        assigned_resource=assigned_agent,
1027                    )
1028                except Exception as persist_err:
1029                    # A review whose evidence did not survive is not a review we
1030                    # may later reconstruct as clean. Mark it failed loudly
1031                    # rather than leaving a half-written pair on disk.
1032                    single_res.status = "reviewer_failure"
1033                    single_res.error_message = (
1034                        f"Reviewer evidence could not be persisted: {persist_err}"
1035                    )
1036                    has_failure = True
1037
1038        # Run reconciliation across all gathered findings
1039        reconciliation = ReviewReconciler.reconcile(all_findings) if all_findings else None
1040
1041        # Check if remediation is needed: unresolved blockers > 0, unresolved highs
1042        # > 0, or any reviewer failed to complete (#59.2 Phase 3). A reviewer that
1043        # never ran/parsed successfully must never be silently indistinguishable
1044        # from "ran cleanly, found nothing" -- has_failure alone must gate here,
1045        # independent of whether any findings exist to reconcile.
1046        requires_remediation = False
1047        if has_failure:
1048            requires_remediation = True
1049        if reconciliation:
1050            if reconciliation.unresolved_blockers > 0 or reconciliation.unresolved_highs > 0:
1051                requires_remediation = True
1052            elif reconciliation.confirmed or reconciliation.likely:
1053                requires_remediation = True
1054
1055        overall_status = "review_failure" if has_failure else ("has_findings" if all_findings else "clean")
1056
1057        return ReviewCycleResult(
1058            cycle_index=cycle_index,
1059            reviewer_results=reviewer_results,
1060            all_findings=all_findings,
1061            reconciliation=reconciliation,
1062            status=overall_status,
1063            requires_remediation=requires_remediation,
1064            non_independent_roles=non_independent_roles,
1065        )

Executes each specified reviewer independently against the actual implementation diff. Preserves already-completed reviewer artifacts from previous interrupted runs.

provider_pool is optional (#59.2 Phase 4): when supplied, a reviewer whose primary assignment fails, times out, or produces invalid output gets one bounded fallback attempt against an independent candidate via invoke_reviewer_with_failover, mirroring implementation failover. Omitting it (the default, and the only behavior any caller exercised before #59.2) preserves the prior single-attempt-per-role behavior exactly.

@classmethod
def determine_re_review_roles( cls, findings: List[ReviewFinding], original_roles: List[str]) -> List[str]: 
1067    @classmethod
1068    def determine_re_review_roles(
1069        cls,
1070        findings: List[ReviewFinding],
1071        original_roles: List[str],
1072    ) -> List[str]:
1073        """
1074        Deterministically selects targeted reviewers for re-review after remediation.
1075        """
1076        if not findings:
1077            return list(original_roles)
1078
1079        selected: Set[str] = set()
1080        for f in findings:
1081            cat = (f.category or "").lower()
1082            role = f.reviewer_role
1083
1084            if role:
1085                selected.add(role)
1086
1087            if cat in ("security", "vuln", "auth"):
1088                selected.update(["security-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer", "test-falsifier"])
1089            elif cat in ("architecture", "coupling", "boundary"):
1090                selected.update(["architecture-reviewer", "regression-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
1091            elif cat in ("regression", "breaking_change"):
1092                selected.update(["regression-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
1093            elif cat in ("test_gap", "missing_test", "vacuous_test"):
1094                selected.update(["test-falsifier", "correctness-reviewer"])
1095            elif cat in ("simplicity", "complexity", "dead_code"):
1096                selected.update(["simplicity-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
1097            else:
1098                selected.update(["correctness-reviewer", "test-falsifier"])
1099
1100        # Filter against available original roles or known reviewer roles
1101        target_roles = [r for r in original_roles if r in selected]
1102        if not target_roles:
1103            target_roles = list(selected)
1104        return sorted(list(set(target_roles)))

Deterministically selects targeted reviewers for re-review after remediation.

def parse_and_validate_findings( raw_output: str, reviewer_role: str) -> Tuple[List[ReviewFinding], Optional[str], bool]: 
339def parse_and_validate_findings(
340    raw_output: str,
341    reviewer_role: str,
342) -> Tuple[List[ReviewFinding], Optional[str], bool]:
343    """
344    Parses YAML/JSON findings from raw reviewer output.
345    Returns (findings, error_message, is_valid_output).
346    If output is malformed, returns a synthetic finding signaling REVIEWER_FAILURE.
347
348    `is_valid_output` is False whenever zero findings resulted from output that
349    was empty, blank, or otherwise not a deliberate "no findings" signal -- such
350    output must never be indistinguishable from a reviewer that actually ran and
351    reported a clean result (REVIEW_COMPLETED_WITH_NO_FINDINGS, is_valid_output=True).
352    """
353    if not raw_output or not raw_output.strip():
354        # Empty output is never evidence of a completed clean review.
355        return [], None, False
356
357    clean_text = raw_output.strip()
358
359    # Extract yaml / json code block if wrapped in markdown
360    code_block_match = re.search(r"```(?:yaml|json)?\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n```", clean_text)
361    if code_block_match:
362        payload_text = code_block_match.group(1).strip()
363    elif _is_recognized_clean_phrase(clean_text):
364        # Unfenced natural-language prose reporting a clean result: accept it
365        # directly rather than risk yaml.safe_load misreading its bullet
366        # points/colons as an unrelated structured (and thus malformed) shape.
367        return [], None, True
368    else:
369        payload_text = clean_text
370
371    try:
372        parsed = yaml.safe_load(payload_text)
373    except Exception as exc:
374        err_msg = f"Malformed reviewer output YAML: {exc}"
375        failure_finding = ReviewFinding(
376            id=f"ERR-{reviewer_role[:4].upper()}-001",
377            reviewer_role=reviewer_role,
378            title=f"Malformed reviewer output from {reviewer_role}",
379            severity="high",
380            category="other",
381            description=f"Reviewer output failed schema validation: {err_msg}",
382            status="open",
383            claim="Reviewer produced unparseable output format",
384            evidence=raw_output[:500],
385        )
386        return [failure_finding], err_msg, False
387
388    if parsed is None:
389        # Output existed but carried no structured content (e.g. an empty
390        # code block) -- ambiguous, not a deliberate clean signal.
391        return [], None, False
392
393    # Normalization of parsed content
394    findings_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
395    if isinstance(parsed, dict):
396        if "findings" in parsed:
397            raw_f = parsed.get("findings")
398            if isinstance(raw_f, list):
399                findings_list = raw_f
400            elif raw_f is None:
401                findings_list = []
402            else:
403                err_msg = f"'findings' field in output must be a list, got {type(raw_f)}"
404                return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
405        else:
406            # Maybe single finding object
407            if "title" in parsed or "severity" in parsed:
408                findings_list = [parsed]
409            elif not parsed:
410                # Empty dict -- ambiguous, not a deliberate clean signal.
411                return [], None, False
412            else:
413                err_msg = "Reviewer dictionary output missing 'findings' list"
414                return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
415    elif isinstance(parsed, list):
416        findings_list = parsed
417    elif isinstance(parsed, str) and _is_recognized_clean_phrase(parsed):
418        # An explicit prose "clean" signal is a deliberate, valid result.
419        return [], None, True
420    else:
421        err_msg = f"Unexpected reviewer output type: {type(parsed)}"
422        return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
423
424    validated_findings: List[ReviewFinding] = []
425    for idx, item in enumerate(findings_list, 1):
426        if not isinstance(item, dict):
427            err_msg = f"Finding at index {idx} is not a valid dictionary"
428            return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
429
430        f_id = str(item.get("id") or f"F{idx:03d}")
431        title = str(item.get("title") or f"Issue found by {reviewer_role}")
432        severity = str(item.get("severity") or "medium").lower().strip()
433        if severity not in VALID_SEVERITIES:
434            severity = "medium"
435
436        category = str(item.get("category") or "correctness").lower().strip()
437        description = str(item.get("description") or item.get("claim") or title)
438        location = item.get("location")
439        claim = item.get("claim")
440        evidence = item.get("evidence")
441        suggested_fix = item.get("suggested_fix")
442        component = item.get("component")
443
444        finding = ReviewFinding(
445            id=f_id,
446            reviewer_role=reviewer_role,
447            title=title,
448            severity=severity,
449            category=category,
450            description=description,
451            component=component,
452            claim=claim,
453            location=location,
454            evidence=evidence,
455            suggested_fix=suggested_fix,
456            status="open",
457        )
458        validated_findings.append(finding)
459
460    # Reaching here means the output was a structurally valid findings
461    # container (an explicit list, a `findings:` key, or `findings: null`),
462    # even when validated_findings ends up empty -- a deliberate clean signal.
463    return validated_findings, None, True

Parses YAML/JSON findings from raw reviewer output. Returns (findings, error_message, is_valid_output). If output is malformed, returns a synthetic finding signaling REVIEWER_FAILURE.

is_valid_output is False whenever zero findings resulted from output that was empty, blank, or otherwise not a deliberate "no findings" signal -- such output must never be indistinguishable from a reviewer that actually ran and reported a clean result (REVIEW_COMPLETED_WITH_NO_FINDINGS, is_valid_output=True).

62    def validate(self) -> None:
63        if not self.id or not isinstance(self.id, str):
64            raise ReconciliationValidationError("Finding id must be a non-empty string.")
65        if self.severity not in VALID_SEVERITIES:
66            raise ReconciliationValidationError(

72            )
73        if self.redundancy_status not in VALID_REDUNDANCY_STATUSES:
74            raise ReconciliationValidationError(

76            )
77
78        # Rule: Any dismissed blocker or high finding must have a resolution reason
79        if self.status in ("false_positive", "out_of_scope") and self.severity in ("blocker", "high"):
80            if not self.resolution_reason or not self.resolution_reason.strip():
81                raise ReconciliationValidationError(
82                    f"Finding '{self.id}' with severity '{self.severity}' cannot be marked '{self.status}' "
83                    "without an explicit non-empty resolution_reason."
84                )

88        d = dict(data)
89        d.pop("schema", None)
90        return cls(schema=REVIEW_FINDING_SCHEMA_VERSION, **d)

 93@dataclass
 94class ReconciliationResult:
 95    """Summary and categorized output of finding reconciliation."""
 96
 97    findings: List[ReviewFinding]

110
111    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
112        return {
113            "summary": {
114                "total_findings": len(self.findings),
115                "confirmed_count": len(self.confirmed),
116                "likely_count": len(self.likely),
117                "disputed_count": len(self.disputed),
118                "false_positive_count": len(self.false_positives),
119                "out_of_scope_count": len(self.out_of_scope),
120                "requires_human_count": len(self.requires_human_judgment),
121                "unresolved_blockers": self.unresolved_blockers,
122                "unresolved_highs": self.unresolved_highs,
123                "duplicate_count": self.duplicate_count,
124                "overlapping_count": self.overlapping_count,
125                "unique_findings_by_role": self.unique_findings_by_role,
126                "findings_by_role": self.findings_by_role,
127            },
128            "findings": [f.to_dict() for f in self.findings],
129        }
130
131    def render_markdown(self) -> str:
132        """Generates a human-readable reconciliation report."""
133        lines = [
134            "# Review Reconciliation Report",
135            "",
136            "## Summary",
137            f"- **Total findings:** {len(self.findings)}",
138            f"- **Confirmed findings:** {len(self.confirmed)}",
139            f"- **Likely findings:** {len(self.likely)}",
140            f"- **Disputed findings:** {len(self.disputed)}",
141            f"- **Requires human judgment:** {len(self.requires_human_judgment)}",
142            f"- **False positives (dismissed with reason):** {len(self.false_positives)}",
143            f"- **Out of scope (dismissed with reason):** {len(self.out_of_scope)}",
144            f"- **Duplicates detected:** {self.duplicate_count}",
145            f"- **Overlapping findings:** {self.overlapping_count}",
146            f"- **Unresolved Blockers / Highs:** {self.unresolved_blockers + self.unresolved_highs}",
147            "",
148            "## Findings & Unique Signal by Reviewer Role",
149            "| Reviewer Role | Total Findings | Unique Findings | Duplicates / Overlaps |",
150            "| --- | --- | --- | --- |",
151        ]
152        for role, total in sorted(self.findings_by_role.items()):
153            unique = self.unique_findings_by_role.get(role, 0)
154            dups = total - unique
155            lines.append(f"| `{role}` | {total} | {unique} | {dups} |")
156        lines.append("")
157
158        if self.confirmed:
159            lines.append("## Confirmed Findings (Multi-Reviewer Agreement / Verified)")
160            for f in self.confirmed:
161                redundancy_tag = f" `[{f.redundancy_status}]`" if f.redundancy_status != "independent" else ""
162                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
163                if f.location:
164                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
165                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
166                if f.suggested_fix:
167                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
168            lines.append("")
169
170        if self.likely:
171            lines.append("## Likely Findings (Single Reviewer High Confidence)")
172            for f in self.likely:
173                redundancy_tag = f" `[{f.redundancy_status}]`" if f.redundancy_status != "independent" else ""
174                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
175                if f.location:
176                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
177                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
178                if f.suggested_fix:
179                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
180            lines.append("")
181
182        if self.disputed:
183            lines.append("## Disputed Findings (Requires Resolution)")
184            for f in self.disputed:
185                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
186                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
187                if f.resolution_reason:
188                    lines.append(f"  - Dispute notes: {f.resolution_reason}")
189            lines.append("")
190
191        if self.requires_human_judgment:
192            lines.append("## Requires Human Judgment")
193            for f in self.requires_human_judgment:
194                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
195                lines.append(f"  - Reason for human review: {f.resolution_reason or f.description}")
196            lines.append("")
197
198        return "\n".join(lines)

174                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
175                if f.location:
176                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
177                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
178                if f.suggested_fix:
179                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
180            lines.append("")
181
182        if self.disputed:
183            lines.append("## Disputed Findings (Requires Resolution)")
184            for f in self.disputed:
185                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
186                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
187                if f.resolution_reason:
188                    lines.append(f"  - Dispute notes: {f.resolution_reason}")
189            lines.append("")
190
191        if self.requires_human_judgment:
192            lines.append("## Requires Human Judgment")
193            for f in self.requires_human_judgment:
194                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
195                lines.append(f"  - Reason for human review: {f.resolution_reason or f.description}")
196            lines.append("")
197
198        return "\n".join(lines)

class ReviewReconciler: 
201class ReviewReconciler:
202    """Performs deterministic reconciliation of multi-agent review findings."""
203
204    @staticmethod
205    def reconcile(findings: List[ReviewFinding]) -> ReconciliationResult:
206        """
207        Reconciles a collection of review findings into classified categories.
208        Ensures all validations pass and preserves every disagreement.
209        """
210        # Validate all findings first
211        for f in findings:
212            f.validate()
213
214        confirmed: List[ReviewFinding] = []
215        likely: List[ReviewFinding] = []
216        disputed: List[ReviewFinding] = []
217        false_positives: List[ReviewFinding] = []
218        out_of_scope: List[ReviewFinding] = []
219        requires_human: List[ReviewFinding] = []
220
221        unresolved_blockers = 0
222        unresolved_highs = 0
223        duplicate_count = 0
224        overlapping_count = 0
225        findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = {}
226        unique_findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = {}
227
228        # Index findings by location and component
229        location_map: Dict[str, List[ReviewFinding]] = {}
230        for f in findings:
231            findings_by_role[f.reviewer_role] = findings_by_role.get(f.reviewer_role, 0) + 1
232            if f.location:
233                loc_key = f.location.strip().lower()
234                location_map.setdefault(loc_key, []).append(f)
235
236        # Detect cross-reviewer duplicates and overlaps
237        processed_pairs = set()
238        for f in findings:
239            if f.location:
240                loc_key = f.location.strip().lower()
241                co_located = location_map.get(loc_key, [])
242                distinct_reviewers = {other.reviewer_role for other in co_located if other.id != f.id}
243
244                if distinct_reviewers:
245                    # Match found across different reviewer roles
246                    other_findings = [other for other in co_located if other.id != f.id]
247                    for other in other_findings:
248                        pair = tuple(sorted([f.id, other.id]))
249                        if pair not in processed_pairs:
250                            processed_pairs.add(pair)
251                            if other.id not in f.related_finding_ids:
252                                f.related_finding_ids.append(other.id)
253                            if f.id not in other.related_finding_ids:
254                                other.related_finding_ids.append(f.id)
255
256                    # Determine redundancy classification
257                    if f.redundancy_status == "independent":
258                        # If first finding for this location, mark overlapping; if subsequent, duplicate
259                        first_for_loc = co_located[0].id == f.id
260                        if first_for_loc:
261                            f.redundancy_status = "overlapping"
262                            overlapping_count += 1
263                        else:
264                            f.redundancy_status = "duplicate"
265                            duplicate_count += 1
266                else:
267                    if f.redundancy_status == "duplicate":
268                        duplicate_count += 1
269                    elif f.redundancy_status == "overlapping":
270                        overlapping_count += 1
271            else:
272                if f.redundancy_status == "duplicate":
273                    duplicate_count += 1
274                elif f.redundancy_status == "overlapping":
275                    overlapping_count += 1
276
277            if f.redundancy_status == "independent":
278                unique_findings_by_role[f.reviewer_role] = unique_findings_by_role.get(f.reviewer_role, 0) + 1
279
280        for f in findings:
281            # Check if status was already set or should be deduced
282            if f.status == "open":
283                # Auto-classification logic
284                loc_matches = location_map.get(f.location.strip().lower(), []) if f.location else []
285                reviewers_at_loc = {m.reviewer_role for m in loc_matches}
286
287                if len(reviewers_at_loc) > 1:
288                    # Multiple distinct reviewers flagged this location
289                    f.status = "confirmed"
290                elif f.severity in ("blocker", "high") and f.category == "security":
291                    f.status = "requires_human_judgment"
292                    f.resolution_reason = "Security-critical finding automatically routed for human verification."
293                elif f.severity in ("blocker", "high"):
294                    f.status = "likely"
295                else:
296                    f.status = "likely"
297
298            # Sort into buckets
299            if f.status == "confirmed":
300                confirmed.append(f)
301            elif f.status == "likely":
302                likely.append(f)
303            elif f.status == "disputed":
304                disputed.append(f)
305            elif f.status == "false_positive":
306                false_positives.append(f)
307            elif f.status == "out_of_scope":
308                out_of_scope.append(f)
309            elif f.status == "requires_human_judgment":
310                requires_human.append(f)
311
312            # Count unresolved severe items
313            if f.status in ("confirmed", "likely", "disputed", "requires_human_judgment"):
314                if f.severity == "blocker":
315                    unresolved_blockers += 1
316                elif f.severity == "high":
317                    unresolved_highs += 1
318
319        return ReconciliationResult(
320            findings=findings,
321            confirmed=confirmed,
322            likely=likely,
323            disputed=disputed,
324            false_positives=false_positives,
325            out_of_scope=out_of_scope,
326            requires_human_judgment=requires_human,
327            unresolved_blockers=unresolved_blockers,
328            unresolved_highs=unresolved_highs,
329            duplicate_count=duplicate_count,
330            overlapping_count=overlapping_count,
331            unique_findings_by_role=unique_findings_by_role,
332            findings_by_role=findings_by_role,
333        )

129@dataclass
130class VerificationPlan(DataClassSerializationMixin):
131    """Represents the complete verification suite for a task or project."""
132
133    task_id: str
134    steps: List[VerificationStep] = field(default_factory=list)
135    overall_status: str = "unverified"
136    schema: str = VERIFICATION_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION
137
138    def __post_init__(self):
139        self.validate()
140
141    def validate(self) -> None:
142        if not self.task_id or not isinstance(self.task_id, str):
143            raise VerificationError("task_id must be a non-empty string.")
144        if self.overall_status not in VALID_OVERALL_STATUSES:
145            raise VerificationError(
146                f"overall_status '{self.overall_status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_OVERALL_STATUSES)}"
147            )
148        for s in self.steps:
149            s.validate()
150
151    def add_step(
152        self,
153        step_id: str,
154        name: str,
155        command: Union[str, List[str]],
156        category: str = "unit_test",
157        required: bool = True,
158        interpreter: Optional[str] = None,
159        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
160    ) -> None:
161        step = VerificationStep(
162            step_id=step_id,
163            name=name,
164            command=command,
165            category=category,
166            status="claimed",
167            required=required,
168            interpreter=interpreter,
169            metadata=metadata or {},
170        )
171        self.steps.append(step)
172
173    def execute_step(
174        self,
175        step: VerificationStep,
176        cwd: Optional[str] = None,
177        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
178    ) -> None:
179        """
180        Executes a single step deterministically using subprocess without shell=True.
181        Enforces provider integrity for repository hygiene gates.
182        Transitions: claimed -> tested -> observed -> (verified | failed).
183        """
184        step.status = "tested"
185        cmd_args: List[str]
186        if isinstance(step.command, str):
187            cmd_args = shlex.split(step.command)
188        else:
189            cmd_args = list(step.command)
190
191        start_time = time.time()
192        env = os.environ.copy()
193        target_root = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else Path.cwd()
194
195        # Hygiene provider integrity check
196        if step.category == "repository_hygiene" or (cmd_args and "slopslint" in cmd_args[0]):
197            ok, msg, prov_meta = HygienePolicyClassifier.verify_provider_integrity(
198                executable_name="slopslint",
199                pinned_version=PINNED_SLOPSLINT_VERSION,
200            )
201            step.metadata["hygiene_provider"] = prov_meta
202            if not ok:
203                step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
204                step.exit_code = 127 if prov_meta.get("status") == "missing" else 1
205                step.stderr = f"Hygiene provider integrity failure: {msg}"
206                step.status = "failed"
207                return
208            # Use resolved absolute binary path to avoid PATH hijacking
209            if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] == "slopslint" and prov_meta.get("path"):
210                cmd_args[0] = prov_meta["path"]
211
212        # Resolve Python interpreter deterministically for python-based commands
213        try:
214            resolved_py = resolve_python_interpreter(target_root)
215            step.interpreter = resolved_py
216            py_bin_dir = str(Path(resolved_py).parent)
217            env["PATH"] = f"{py_bin_dir}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
218            if "venv" in py_bin_dir or ".venv" in py_bin_dir:
219                env["VIRTUAL_ENV"] = str(Path(resolved_py).parent.parent)
220        except Exception:
221            step.interpreter = sys.executable
222
223        # If command starts with python/pytest/flake8/bandit and we resolved a specific venv python
224        if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("python", "python3") and step.interpreter:
225            cmd_args[0] = step.interpreter
226        elif cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("pytest", "flake8", "bandit", "mypy", "black", "pdoc") and step.interpreter:
227            candidate_bin = Path(step.interpreter).parent / cmd_args[0]
228            if candidate_bin.is_file() and os.access(candidate_bin, os.X_OK):
229                cmd_args[0] = str(candidate_bin)
230
231        cmd_display = (
232            " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd_args)
233            if isinstance(cmd_args, list)
234            else str(cmd_args)
235        )
236
237        from src.control_plane.progress import track_operation
238        try:
239            with track_operation(
240                progress_tracker,
241                phase="VERIFYING",
242                resource_id=step.category,
243                details=cmd_display,
244                role="verification",
245            ):
246                res = subprocess.run(
247                    cmd_args,
248                    cwd=cwd,
249                    capture_output=True,
250                    text=True,
251                    env=env,
252                    timeout=300,
253                )
254
255            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
256            step.exit_code = res.returncode
257            step.stdout = res.stdout
258            step.stderr = res.stderr
259            step.status = "observed"
260
261            if res.returncode == 0:
262                step.status = "verified"
263            else:
264                step.status = "failed"
265
266        except Exception as e:
267            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
268            step.exit_code = -1
269            step.stderr = str(e)
270            step.status = "failed"
271
272    def execute_all(
273        self,
274        cwd: Optional[str] = None,
275        stop_on_failure: bool = False,
276        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
277    ) -> str:
278        """
279        Executes all steps in order and computes the overall status.
280        """
281        any_failed = False
282        all_passed = True
283
284        for step in self.steps:
285            self.execute_step(step, cwd=cwd, progress_tracker=progress_tracker)
286            if step.status == "failed":
287                any_failed = True
288                if step.required:
289                    all_passed = False
290                if stop_on_failure:
291                    break
292            elif step.status != "verified":
293                all_passed = False
294
295        if any_failed:
296            self.overall_status = "failed"
297        elif all_passed:
298            self.overall_status = "passed"
299        else:
300            self.overall_status = "partial"
301
302        return self.overall_status
303
304    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
305        return {
306            "schema": self.schema,
307            "task_id": self.task_id,
308            "overall_status": self.overall_status,
309            "steps": [s.to_dict() for s in self.steps],
310        }
311
312    @classmethod
313    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "VerificationPlan":
314        steps_data = data.get("steps", [])
315        steps = [VerificationStep.from_dict(item) for item in steps_data]
316        return cls(
317            task_id=data.get("task_id", ""),
318            steps=steps,
319            overall_status=data.get("overall_status", "unverified"),
320        )

189            cmd_args = list(step.command)
190
191        start_time = time.time()
192        env = os.environ.copy()
193        target_root = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else Path.cwd()
194
195        # Hygiene provider integrity check
196        if step.category == "repository_hygiene" or (cmd_args and "slopslint" in cmd_args[0]):
197            ok, msg, prov_meta = HygienePolicyClassifier.verify_provider_integrity(
198                executable_name="slopslint",
199                pinned_version=PINNED_SLOPSLINT_VERSION,
200            )
201            step.metadata["hygiene_provider"] = prov_meta
202            if not ok:
203                step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
204                step.exit_code = 127 if prov_meta.get("status") == "missing" else 1
205                step.stderr = f"Hygiene provider integrity failure: {msg}"
206                step.status = "failed"
207                return
208            # Use resolved absolute binary path to avoid PATH hijacking
209            if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] == "slopslint" and prov_meta.get("path"):
210                cmd_args[0] = prov_meta["path"]
211
212        # Resolve Python interpreter deterministically for python-based commands
213        try:
214            resolved_py = resolve_python_interpreter(target_root)
215            step.interpreter = resolved_py
216            py_bin_dir = str(Path(resolved_py).parent)
217            env["PATH"] = f"{py_bin_dir}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
218            if "venv" in py_bin_dir or ".venv" in py_bin_dir:
219                env["VIRTUAL_ENV"] = str(Path(resolved_py).parent.parent)
220        except Exception:
221            step.interpreter = sys.executable
222
223        # If command starts with python/pytest/flake8/bandit and we resolved a specific venv python
224        if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("python", "python3") and step.interpreter:
225            cmd_args[0] = step.interpreter
226        elif cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("pytest", "flake8", "bandit", "mypy", "black", "pdoc") and step.interpreter:
227            candidate_bin = Path(step.interpreter).parent / cmd_args[0]
228            if candidate_bin.is_file() and os.access(candidate_bin, os.X_OK):
229                cmd_args[0] = str(candidate_bin)
230
231        cmd_display = (
232            " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd_args)
233            if isinstance(cmd_args, list)
234            else str(cmd_args)
235        )
236
237        from src.control_plane.progress import track_operation
238        try:
239            with track_operation(
240                progress_tracker,
241                phase="VERIFYING",
242                resource_id=step.category,
243                details=cmd_display,
244                role="verification",
245            ):
246                res = subprocess.run(
247                    cmd_args,
248                    cwd=cwd,
249                    capture_output=True,
250                    text=True,
251                    env=env,
252                    timeout=300,
253                )
254
255            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
256            step.exit_code = res.returncode
257            step.stdout = res.stdout
258            step.stderr = res.stderr
259            step.status = "observed"
260
261            if res.returncode == 0:
262                step.status = "verified"
263            else:
264                step.status = "failed"
265
266        except Exception as e:
267            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
268            step.exit_code = -1
269            step.stderr = str(e)
270            step.status = "failed"

Executes a single step deterministically using subprocess without shell=True. Enforces provider integrity for repository hygiene gates. Transitions: claimed -> tested -> observed -> (verified | failed).

def execute_all( self, cwd: Optional[str] = None, stop_on_failure: bool = False, progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None) -> str: 
272    def execute_all(
273        self,
274        cwd: Optional[str] = None,
275        stop_on_failure: bool = False,
276        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
277    ) -> str:
278        """
279        Executes all steps in order and computes the overall status.
280        """
281        any_failed = False
282        all_passed = True
283
284        for step in self.steps:
285            self.execute_step(step, cwd=cwd, progress_tracker=progress_tracker)
286            if step.status == "failed":
287                any_failed = True
288                if step.required:
289                    all_passed = False
290                if stop_on_failure:
291                    break
292            elif step.status != "verified":
293                all_passed = False
294
295        if any_failed:
296            self.overall_status = "failed"
297        elif all_passed:
298            self.overall_status = "passed"
299        else:
300            self.overall_status = "partial"
301
302        return self.overall_status

112class EvidenceLedger:
113    """Manages the append-only evidence ledger log files."""
114
115    def __init__(self, ledger_file: Optional[str] = None):
116        if ledger_file is None:
117            # Default to logs/control_plane/evidence_ledger.jsonl
118            repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
119            ledger_file = str(repo_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
120        self.ledger_file = Path(ledger_file)
121        self.ledger_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
122
123    def append_entry(self, entry: EvidenceEntry) -> None:
124        """Appends a new sanitized entry to the JSON Lines log."""
125        line = json.dumps(entry.to_dict()) + "\n"
126        with open(self.ledger_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
127            f.write(line)
128
129    def list_all_entries(self) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
130        """Reads all entries from the ledger."""
131        if not self.ledger_file.exists():
132            return []
133        entries = []
134        with open(self.ledger_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
135            for line in f:
136                line = line.strip()
137                if line:
138                    try:
139                        entries.append(EvidenceEntry.from_dict(json.loads(line)))
140                    except Exception:
141                        continue
142        return entries
143
144    def get_task_entries(self, task_id: str) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
145        """Retrieves all evidence entries associated with a specific task_id."""
146        return [e for e in self.list_all_entries() if e.task_id == task_id]

33def redact_sensitive_data(text: str) -> str:
34    """Scans and scrubs secrets, credentials, and PII from text."""
35    if not isinstance(text, str):
36        return text
37    sanitized = text
38    for pattern, replacement in REDACTION_PATTERNS:
39        sanitized = pattern.sub(replacement, sanitized)
40    return sanitized

199            lines.append(

201                f"{fps_str} | {summary.remediation_cycles} | {summary.verification_failures} | "
202                f"{summary.review_findings_received} | {summary.blocker_findings_received} | {summary.human_interventions} |"
203            )
204        lines.append("")
205        lines.append(f"*\\*Note: Sample size < {MIN_ROUTING_SAMPLE_SIZE} indicates insufficient sample size for automated routing.*")
206        lines.append("")
207
208        lines.extend([
209            "## Reviewer Effectiveness & Marginal Value Breakdown",
210            "| Reviewer Role | Runs | Findings | Confirmed | Likely | False Pos | Disputed | Blockers | Unique | Triggered Fix | Prevented Bad Completion | Marginal Value |",
211            "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
212        ])
213        for rid, rsum in sorted(self.reviewer_summaries.items()):
214            lines.append(
215                f"| `{rid}` | {rsum.reviewer_runs} | {rsum.findings_total} | {rsum.confirmed_findings} | "
216                f"{rsum.likely_findings} | {rsum.false_positives} | {rsum.disputed_findings} | {rsum.blockers_found} | "
217                f"{rsum.unique_findings} | {rsum.findings_that_triggered_remediation} | {rsum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion} | {rsum.marginal_value} |"
218            )
219        lines.append("")
220
221        if (
222            self.slop_checks_run > 0
223            or self.duplication_regressions_caught > 0
224            or self.debt_acceptance_requests > 0
225            or self.slop_findings_remediated > 0
226            or self.hygiene_ceilings_lowered > 0
227            or self.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts > 0
228        ):
229            lines.extend([
230                "## Repository Hygiene & Slop Gate Tracking",
231                f"- **Hygiene checks executed:** {self.slop_checks_run} ({self.slop_checks_failed} failed)",
232                f"- **Duplication regressions caught:** {self.duplication_regressions_caught}",
233                f"- **Ceilings lowered (debt reduced):** {self.hygiene_ceilings_lowered}",
234                f"- **Ceiling raise attempts blocked:** {self.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts}",
235                f"- **Policy tightenings:** {self.hygiene_policies_tightened}, **Weakenings requested:** {self.hygiene_policies_weakened}",
236                f"- **Tombstones added (debt accepted):** {self.hygiene_tombstones_added}, **Removed (cleaned):** {self.hygiene_tombstones_removed}",
237                f"- **Orphan surfaces caught:** {self.orphans_caught}",
238                f"- **Stale tombstones caught:** {self.stale_tombstones_caught}",
239                f"- **Contract / claims gaps caught:** {self.claim_gaps_caught}",
240                f"- **Provider integrity mismatches:** {self.hygiene_provider_mismatches}",
241                f"- **Slop findings remediated:** {self.slop_findings_remediated}",
242                f"- **Debt acceptance requests:** {self.debt_acceptance_requests} ({self.debt_acceptance_approved} approved, {self.debt_acceptance_rejected} rejected)",
243                "",
244            ])
245
246        if self.repositories_exercised:
247            lines.extend([
248                "## Repositories Exercised Breakdown",
249                "| Repository | Tasks Recorded |",
250                "| --- | --- |",
251            ])
252            for repo, count in sorted(self.repositories_exercised.items()):
253                lines.append(f"| `{repo}` | {count} |")
254            lines.append("")
255
256        if self.orchestration_counts:
257            lines.extend([
258                "## Human Orchestration & Operator Friction Tracking",
259                "| Orchestration Action | Count |",
260                "| --- | --- |",
261            ])
262            for act, count in sorted(self.orchestration_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
263                lines.append(f"| `{act}` | {count} |")
264            lines.append("")
265
266        if self.common_failure_modes:
267            lines.append("## Most Common Failure Modes Caught")
268            for fail_mode, count in sorted(self.common_failure_modes.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
269                lines.append(f"- **{fail_mode}**: {count} occurrence(s)")
270            lines.append("")
271
272        return "\n".join(lines)

class MetricsCalculator: 
275class MetricsCalculator:
276    """Calculates verifiable performance statistics from evidence ledger entries."""
277
278    @staticmethod
279    def calculate(entries: List[EvidenceEntry]) -> PerformanceMetricsSummary:
280        """
281        Parses evidence ledger entries and constructs a PerformanceMetricsSummary
282        with strict first_pass_success semantics.
283        Independent properties are processed independently without mutually exclusive suppression.
284        """
285        summary = PerformanceMetricsSummary()
286        if not entries:
287            return summary
288
289        # Group entries by task
290        tasks: Dict[str, List[EvidenceEntry]] = {}
291        for entry in entries:
292            tasks.setdefault(entry.task_id, []).append(entry)
293
294        summary.total_tasks = len(tasks)
295
296        for task_id, task_entries in tasks.items():
297            task_agents = set()
298            repo_name = None
299            is_task_override = False
300
301            for e in task_entries:
302                if e.agent_id:
303                    task_agents.add(e.agent_id)
304                if e.implementing_agent:
305                    task_agents.add(e.implementing_agent)
306                if e.actual_agent:
307                    task_agents.add(e.actual_agent)
308                if e.repository:
309                    repo_name = e.repository
310                elif isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "repository" in e.metadata:
311                    repo_name = e.metadata["repository"]
312                if e.is_override is True or (isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("is_override") is True):
313                    is_task_override = True
314
315            if repo_name:
316                summary.repositories_exercised[repo_name] = summary.repositories_exercised.get(repo_name, 0) + 1
317
318            if is_task_override:
319                summary.routing_overrides += 1
320            else:
321                summary.routing_recommendations_followed += 1
322
323            for aid in task_agents:
324                if aid not in summary.agent_summaries:
325                    summary.agent_summaries[aid] = AgentMetricSummary(agent_id=aid)
326                summary.agent_summaries[aid].tasks_worked += 1
327
328            # Task level tracking flags
329            has_remediation = False
330            has_verif_failure = False
331            has_confirmed_blocker_or_high = False
332            has_human_intervention = False
333            is_completed = False
334            is_abandoned = False
335            task_defects_caught = 0
336            task_remediation_cycles = 0
337
338            for e in task_entries:
339                aid = e.actual_agent or e.implementing_agent or e.agent_id
340                agent_sum = summary.agent_summaries.get(aid)
341
342                # 1. Track task class
343                if e.task_class and agent_sum:
344                    agent_sum.task_classes_worked[e.task_class] = (
345                        agent_sum.task_classes_worked.get(e.task_class, 0) + 1
346                    )
347
348                # 2. Track orchestration action
349                orch_act = e.orchestration_action or (e.metadata.get("orchestration_action") if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) else None)
350                if orch_act:
351                    summary.orchestration_counts[orch_act] = summary.orchestration_counts.get(orch_act, 0) + 1
352
353                # 3. Track defect types
354                if e.defect_type == "review_caught_defect" or (e.action == "control_plane_defect_caught" and isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and (e.metadata.get("reviewer_role") or "review" in e.metadata.get("failure_mode", ""))):
355                    summary.review_caught_defects += 1
356                elif e.defect_type == "verification_caught_defect" or (e.action == "verification_executed" and e.result == "failed"):
357                    summary.verification_caught_defects += 1
358                elif e.defect_type == "boundary_caught_risk" or (e.action in ("boundary_checked", "boundary_triggered") and isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("boundary_triggered")):
359                    summary.boundary_caught_risks += 1
360
361                # 4. Track repository hygiene / slop metrics
362                is_slop_check = e.action == "slop_check_executed" or (
363                    e.action == "verification_executed"
364                    and (
365                        (e.command and "slopslint" in e.command)
366                        or (isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("category") == "repository_hygiene")
367                    )
368                )
369                if is_slop_check:
370                    summary.slop_checks_run += 1
371                    if e.result == "failed":
372                        summary.slop_checks_failed += 1
373
374                if e.action == "debt_acceptance_requested" or (
375                    e.action in ("boundary_triggered", "boundary_checked")
376                    and isinstance(e.metadata, dict)
377                    and "slop_debt_acceptance" in (e.metadata.get("boundary_triggered") or [])
378                ):
379                    summary.debt_acceptance_requests += 1
380
381                if e.action == "debt_acceptance_approved" or (
382                    e.action == "human_decision"
383                    and e.result in ("approved", "accepted")
384                    and isinstance(e.metadata, dict)
385                    and "slop_debt_acceptance" in (e.metadata.get("boundary_triggers") or [])
386                ):
387                    summary.debt_acceptance_approved += 1
388
389                if e.action == "debt_acceptance_rejected" or (
390                    e.action == "human_decision"
391                    and e.result in ("rejected", "denied")
392                    and isinstance(e.metadata, dict)
393                    and "slop_debt_acceptance" in (e.metadata.get("boundary_triggers") or [])
394                ):
395                    summary.debt_acceptance_rejected += 1
396
397                if e.action == "hygiene_policy_tightened":
398                    summary.hygiene_policies_tightened += 1
399
400                if e.action in ("hygiene_policy_weakening_requested", "hygiene_policy_weakened"):
401                    summary.hygiene_policies_weakened += 1
402
403                if e.action == "hygiene_ceiling_lowered":
404                    summary.hygiene_ceilings_lowered += 1
405
406                if e.action == "hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempted":
407                    summary.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts += 1
408
409                if e.action == "hygiene_tombstone_added":
410                    summary.hygiene_tombstones_added += 1
411
412                if e.action == "hygiene_tombstone_removed":
413                    summary.hygiene_tombstones_removed += 1
414
415                if e.action == "hygiene_provider_mismatch" or (
416                    isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("failure_mode") == "hygiene_provider_mismatch"
417                ):
418                    summary.hygiene_provider_mismatches += 1
419
420                if e.action == "slop_finding_remediated":
421                    summary.slop_findings_remediated += 1
422
423                # 5. Track control_plane_caught_defect & failure modes
424                if e.control_plane_caught_defect is True or e.action == "control_plane_defect_caught" or (e.action == "verification_executed" and e.result == "failed"):
425                    summary.control_plane_caught_defects += 1
426                    task_defects_caught += 1
427                    if agent_sum:
428                        agent_sum.control_plane_defects_caught += 1
429                    if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "failure_mode" in e.metadata:
430                        fmode = e.metadata["failure_mode"]
431                        summary.common_failure_modes[fmode] = summary.common_failure_modes.get(fmode, 0) + 1
432                        if fmode in ("duplication_regression", "ceiling_regression"):
433                            summary.duplication_regressions_caught += 1
434                        elif fmode == "orphan_surface":
435                            summary.orphans_caught += 1
436                        elif fmode == "stale_tombstone":
437                            summary.stale_tombstones_caught += 1
438                        elif fmode == "contract_claim_gap":
439                            summary.claim_gaps_caught += 1
440
441                # 5. Track remediation cycles
442                if e.remediation_cycles and e.remediation_cycles > 0:
443                    has_remediation = True
444                    task_remediation_cycles = max(task_remediation_cycles, e.remediation_cycles)
445
446                if e.action == "remediation_started":
447                    has_remediation = True
448                elif e.action == "remediation_completed":
449                    has_remediation = True
450                    task_remediation_cycles += 1
451                    summary.rework_cycles_total += 1
452                    if agent_sum:
453                        agent_sum.remediation_cycles += 1
454                elif e.action == "reconciliation_completed":
455                    if e.result and "remediated" in e.result.lower():
456                        has_remediation = True
457                        task_remediation_cycles += 1
458
459                # 6. Track reviewer stats & findings
460                if e.action == "review_submitted" or e.reviewing_agents:
461                    reviewers_list = e.reviewing_agents or (
462                        e.metadata.get("reviewers") if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) else None
463                    )
464                    if reviewers_list:
465                        for r_role in reviewers_list:
466                            if r_role not in summary.reviewer_summaries:
467                                summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role] = ReviewerMetricSummary(role_id=r_role)
468                            summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role].reviewer_runs += 1
469
470                if e.findings_summary:
471                    total_f = e.findings_summary.get("total", 0)
472                    blockers = e.findings_summary.get("blocker", 0)
473                    highs = e.findings_summary.get("high", 0)
474                    confirmed = e.findings_summary.get("confirmed", 0)
475
476                    summary.total_review_findings += total_f
477                    summary.blocker_findings += blockers
478                    summary.high_findings += highs
479                    summary.confirmed_review_findings += confirmed
480
481                    if agent_sum:
482                        agent_sum.review_findings_received += total_f
483                        agent_sum.confirmed_findings_received += confirmed
484                        agent_sum.blocker_findings_received += blockers
485
486                    if blockers > 0 or highs > 0:
487                        has_confirmed_blocker_or_high = True
488
489                if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "reviewers_breakdown" in e.metadata:
490                    rb = e.metadata["reviewers_breakdown"]
491                    for r_role, r_stats in rb.items():
492                        if r_role not in summary.reviewer_summaries:
493                            summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role] = ReviewerMetricSummary(role_id=r_role)
494                        r_sum = summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role]
495                        r_sum.findings_total += r_stats.get("findings_total", 0)
496                        r_sum.confirmed_findings += r_stats.get("confirmed", 0)
497                        r_sum.likely_findings += r_stats.get("likely", 0)
498                        r_sum.false_positives += r_stats.get("false_positives", 0)
499                        r_sum.disputed_findings += r_stats.get("disputed", 0)
500                        r_sum.blockers_found += r_stats.get("blockers", 0)
501                        r_sum.high_findings_found += r_stats.get("highs", 0)
502                        r_sum.unique_findings += r_stats.get("unique", 0)
503                        r_sum.findings_that_triggered_remediation += r_stats.get("triggered_remediation", 0)
504                        r_sum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion += r_stats.get("prevented_bad_completion", 0)
505
506                # 7. Track verification
507                if e.action == "verification_executed":
508                    if e.result == "failed":
509                        has_verif_failure = True
510                        summary.verification_failures += 1
511                        if agent_sum:
512                            agent_sum.verification_failures += 1
513                        fmode = "verification_failure"
514                        summary.common_failure_modes[fmode] = summary.common_failure_modes.get(fmode, 0) + 1
515
516                # 8. Track human decision
517                if e.action == "human_decision" or e.human_decision is not None:
518                    has_human_intervention = True
519                    summary.human_interventions += 1
520                    if agent_sum:
521                        agent_sum.human_interventions += 1
522
523                # 9. Track task closed
524                if e.action == "task_closed":
525                    if e.result == "complete":
526                        is_completed = True
527                        if agent_sum:
528                            agent_sum.tasks_completed += 1
529                    elif e.result in ("failed", "abandoned"):
530                        is_abandoned = True
531                        if agent_sum:
532                            agent_sum.tasks_abandoned += 1
533
534            if has_remediation:
535                summary.tasks_requiring_remediation += 1
536
537            if is_completed:
538                summary.completed_tasks += 1
539                is_first_pass = (
540                    not has_remediation
541                    and not has_verif_failure
542                    and not has_confirmed_blocker_or_high
543                    and not has_human_intervention
544                    and task_remediation_cycles == 0
545                )
546                if is_first_pass:
547                    summary.first_pass_successes += 1
548                    for aid in task_agents:
549                        if aid in summary.agent_summaries:
550                            summary.agent_summaries[aid].first_pass_successes += 1
551            elif is_abandoned:
552                summary.abandoned_tasks += 1
553
554        # Compute marginal value for each reviewer
555        for r_role, r_sum in summary.reviewer_summaries.items():
556            r_sum.marginal_value = (
557                r_sum.unique_findings
558                + r_sum.findings_that_triggered_remediation
559                + r_sum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion
560                + r_sum.blockers_found
561            )
562
563        return summary

Calculates verifiable performance statistics from evidence ledger entries.

@staticmethod
def calculate( entries: List[EvidenceEntry]) -> PerformanceMetricsSummary: 
278    @staticmethod
279    def calculate(entries: List[EvidenceEntry]) -> PerformanceMetricsSummary:
280        """
281        Parses evidence ledger entries and constructs a PerformanceMetricsSummary
282        with strict first_pass_success semantics.
283        Independent properties are processed independently without mutually exclusive suppression.
284        """
285        summary = PerformanceMetricsSummary()
286        if not entries:
287            return summary
288
289        # Group entries by task
290        tasks: Dict[str, List[EvidenceEntry]] = {}
291        for entry in entries:
292            tasks.setdefault(entry.task_id, []).append(entry)
293
294        summary.total_tasks = len(tasks)
295
296        for task_id, task_entries in tasks.items():
297            task_agents = set()
298            repo_name = None
299            is_task_override = False
300
301            for e in task_entries:
302                if e.agent_id:
303                    task_agents.add(e.agent_id)
304                if e.implementing_agent:
305                    task_agents.add(e.implementing_agent)
306                if e.actual_agent:
307                    task_agents.add(e.actual_agent)
308                if e.repository:
309                    repo_name = e.repository
310                elif isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "repository" in e.metadata:
311                    repo_name = e.metadata["repository"]
312                if e.is_override is True or (isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("is_override") is True):
313                    is_task_override = True
314
315            if repo_name:
316                summary.repositories_exercised[repo_name] = summary.repositories_exercised.get(repo_name, 0) + 1
317
318            if is_task_override:
319                summary.routing_overrides += 1
320            else:
321                summary.routing_recommendations_followed += 1
322
323            for aid in task_agents:
324                if aid not in summary.agent_summaries:
325                    summary.agent_summaries[aid] = AgentMetricSummary(agent_id=aid)
326                summary.agent_summaries[aid].tasks_worked += 1
327
328            # Task level tracking flags
329            has_remediation = False
330            has_verif_failure = False
331            has_confirmed_blocker_or_high = False
332            has_human_intervention = False
333            is_completed = False
334            is_abandoned = False
335            task_defects_caught = 0
336            task_remediation_cycles = 0
337
338            for e in task_entries:
339                aid = e.actual_agent or e.implementing_agent or e.agent_id
340                agent_sum = summary.agent_summaries.get(aid)
341
342                # 1. Track task class
343                if e.task_class and agent_sum:
344                    agent_sum.task_classes_worked[e.task_class] = (
345                        agent_sum.task_classes_worked.get(e.task_class, 0) + 1
346                    )
347
348                # 2. Track orchestration action
349                orch_act = e.orchestration_action or (e.metadata.get("orchestration_action") if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) else None)
350                if orch_act:
351                    summary.orchestration_counts[orch_act] = summary.orchestration_counts.get(orch_act, 0) + 1
352
353                # 3. Track defect types
354                if e.defect_type == "review_caught_defect" or (e.action == "control_plane_defect_caught" and isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and (e.metadata.get("reviewer_role") or "review" in e.metadata.get("failure_mode", ""))):
355                    summary.review_caught_defects += 1
356                elif e.defect_type == "verification_caught_defect" or (e.action == "verification_executed" and e.result == "failed"):
357                    summary.verification_caught_defects += 1
358                elif e.defect_type == "boundary_caught_risk" or (e.action in ("boundary_checked", "boundary_triggered") and isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("boundary_triggered")):
359                    summary.boundary_caught_risks += 1
360
361                # 4. Track repository hygiene / slop metrics
362                is_slop_check = e.action == "slop_check_executed" or (
363                    e.action == "verification_executed"
364                    and (
365                        (e.command and "slopslint" in e.command)
366                        or (isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("category") == "repository_hygiene")
367                    )
368                )
369                if is_slop_check:
370                    summary.slop_checks_run += 1
371                    if e.result == "failed":
372                        summary.slop_checks_failed += 1
373
374                if e.action == "debt_acceptance_requested" or (
375                    e.action in ("boundary_triggered", "boundary_checked")
376                    and isinstance(e.metadata, dict)
377                    and "slop_debt_acceptance" in (e.metadata.get("boundary_triggered") or [])
378                ):
379                    summary.debt_acceptance_requests += 1
380
381                if e.action == "debt_acceptance_approved" or (
382                    e.action == "human_decision"
383                    and e.result in ("approved", "accepted")
384                    and isinstance(e.metadata, dict)
385                    and "slop_debt_acceptance" in (e.metadata.get("boundary_triggers") or [])
386                ):
387                    summary.debt_acceptance_approved += 1
388
389                if e.action == "debt_acceptance_rejected" or (
390                    e.action == "human_decision"
391                    and e.result in ("rejected", "denied")
392                    and isinstance(e.metadata, dict)
393                    and "slop_debt_acceptance" in (e.metadata.get("boundary_triggers") or [])
394                ):
395                    summary.debt_acceptance_rejected += 1
396
397                if e.action == "hygiene_policy_tightened":
398                    summary.hygiene_policies_tightened += 1
399
400                if e.action in ("hygiene_policy_weakening_requested", "hygiene_policy_weakened"):
401                    summary.hygiene_policies_weakened += 1
402
403                if e.action == "hygiene_ceiling_lowered":
404                    summary.hygiene_ceilings_lowered += 1
405
406                if e.action == "hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempted":
407                    summary.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts += 1
408
409                if e.action == "hygiene_tombstone_added":
410                    summary.hygiene_tombstones_added += 1
411
412                if e.action == "hygiene_tombstone_removed":
413                    summary.hygiene_tombstones_removed += 1
414
415                if e.action == "hygiene_provider_mismatch" or (
416                    isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and e.metadata.get("failure_mode") == "hygiene_provider_mismatch"
417                ):
418                    summary.hygiene_provider_mismatches += 1
419
420                if e.action == "slop_finding_remediated":
421                    summary.slop_findings_remediated += 1
422
423                # 5. Track control_plane_caught_defect & failure modes
424                if e.control_plane_caught_defect is True or e.action == "control_plane_defect_caught" or (e.action == "verification_executed" and e.result == "failed"):
425                    summary.control_plane_caught_defects += 1
426                    task_defects_caught += 1
427                    if agent_sum:
428                        agent_sum.control_plane_defects_caught += 1
429                    if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "failure_mode" in e.metadata:
430                        fmode = e.metadata["failure_mode"]
431                        summary.common_failure_modes[fmode] = summary.common_failure_modes.get(fmode, 0) + 1
432                        if fmode in ("duplication_regression", "ceiling_regression"):
433                            summary.duplication_regressions_caught += 1
434                        elif fmode == "orphan_surface":
435                            summary.orphans_caught += 1
436                        elif fmode == "stale_tombstone":
437                            summary.stale_tombstones_caught += 1
438                        elif fmode == "contract_claim_gap":
439                            summary.claim_gaps_caught += 1
440
441                # 5. Track remediation cycles
442                if e.remediation_cycles and e.remediation_cycles > 0:
443                    has_remediation = True
444                    task_remediation_cycles = max(task_remediation_cycles, e.remediation_cycles)
445
446                if e.action == "remediation_started":
447                    has_remediation = True
448                elif e.action == "remediation_completed":
449                    has_remediation = True
450                    task_remediation_cycles += 1
451                    summary.rework_cycles_total += 1
452                    if agent_sum:
453                        agent_sum.remediation_cycles += 1
454                elif e.action == "reconciliation_completed":
455                    if e.result and "remediated" in e.result.lower():
456                        has_remediation = True
457                        task_remediation_cycles += 1
458
459                # 6. Track reviewer stats & findings
460                if e.action == "review_submitted" or e.reviewing_agents:
461                    reviewers_list = e.reviewing_agents or (
462                        e.metadata.get("reviewers") if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) else None
463                    )
464                    if reviewers_list:
465                        for r_role in reviewers_list:
466                            if r_role not in summary.reviewer_summaries:
467                                summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role] = ReviewerMetricSummary(role_id=r_role)
468                            summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role].reviewer_runs += 1
469
470                if e.findings_summary:
471                    total_f = e.findings_summary.get("total", 0)
472                    blockers = e.findings_summary.get("blocker", 0)
473                    highs = e.findings_summary.get("high", 0)
474                    confirmed = e.findings_summary.get("confirmed", 0)
475
476                    summary.total_review_findings += total_f
477                    summary.blocker_findings += blockers
478                    summary.high_findings += highs
479                    summary.confirmed_review_findings += confirmed
480
481                    if agent_sum:
482                        agent_sum.review_findings_received += total_f
483                        agent_sum.confirmed_findings_received += confirmed
484                        agent_sum.blocker_findings_received += blockers
485
486                    if blockers > 0 or highs > 0:
487                        has_confirmed_blocker_or_high = True
488
489                if isinstance(e.metadata, dict) and "reviewers_breakdown" in e.metadata:
490                    rb = e.metadata["reviewers_breakdown"]
491                    for r_role, r_stats in rb.items():
492                        if r_role not in summary.reviewer_summaries:
493                            summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role] = ReviewerMetricSummary(role_id=r_role)
494                        r_sum = summary.reviewer_summaries[r_role]
495                        r_sum.findings_total += r_stats.get("findings_total", 0)
496                        r_sum.confirmed_findings += r_stats.get("confirmed", 0)
497                        r_sum.likely_findings += r_stats.get("likely", 0)

500                        r_sum.blockers_found += r_stats.get("blockers", 0)
501                        r_sum.high_findings_found += r_stats.get("highs", 0)
502                        r_sum.unique_findings += r_stats.get("unique", 0)
503                        r_sum.findings_that_triggered_remediation += r_stats.get("triggered_remediation", 0)
504                        r_sum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion += r_stats.get("prevented_bad_completion", 0)
505
506                # 7. Track verification
507                if e.action == "verification_executed":
508                    if e.result == "failed":

510                        summary.verification_failures += 1
511                        if agent_sum:

513                        fmode = "verification_failure"

541                    and not has_verif_failure
