 96class ProjectAdapter:
 97    """
 98    Discovers project configuration and constructs project-specific verification plans
 99    while respecting local project sovereignty.
100    """
101
102    @classmethod
103    def discover(cls, project_dir: Union[str, Path] = ".") -> ProjectContext:
104        """
105        Scans a directory for .ai-project.toml, project_manifest.yaml, .slop/ configuration,
106        or project stack markers.
107        """
108        root = Path(project_dir).resolve()
109        name = root.name
110        project_types: List[str] = []
111        skills: List[str] = []
112        test_commands: List[List[str]] = []
113        build_commands: List[List[str]] = []
114        lint_commands: List[List[str]] = []
115        format_commands: List[List[str]] = []
116        hygiene_commands: List[List[str]] = []
117        hygiene_status = "not_configured"
118        capabilities: List[str] = []
119        metadata: Dict[str, Any] = {}
120        has_manifest = False
121        has_agents_md = (root / "AGENTS.md").exists()
122
123        def _extract_manifest_cmds(cmds: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
124            for k in ("test", "build", "lint", "format", "fmt"):
125                if k in cmds:
126                    val = cmds[k]
127                    cmd_list = val if isinstance(val, list) else [val]
128                    if k == "test":
129                        test_commands.append(cmd_list)
130                    elif k == "build":
131                        build_commands.append(cmd_list)
132                    elif k == "lint":
133                        lint_commands.append(cmd_list)
134                    else:
135                        format_commands.append(cmd_list)
136            for hk in ("hygiene", "repository_hygiene"):
137                if hk in cmds:
138                    hval = cmds[hk]
139                    hygiene_commands.append(hval if isinstance(hval, list) else [hval])
140                    break
141
142        # 1. Check for .ai-project.toml
143        ai_toml = root / ".ai-project.toml"
144        if ai_toml.exists():
145            has_manifest = True
146            with open(ai_toml, "rb") as f:
147                data = tomllib.load(f)
148            name = data.get("name", name)
149            project_types = data.get("project_type", [])
150            skills = data.get("skills", [])
151            _extract_manifest_cmds(data.get("commands", {}))
152            sec = data.get("security", {})
153            capabilities = sec.get("capabilities", [])
154            metadata.update(data.get("metadata", {}))
155
156        # 2. Check for project_manifest.yaml
157        manifest_yaml = root / "project_manifest.yaml"
158        if manifest_yaml.exists() and not has_manifest:
159            has_manifest = True
160            with open(manifest_yaml, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
161                data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
162            name = data.get("name", name)
163            project_types = data.get("project_types", [])
164            skills = data.get("skills", [])
165            _extract_manifest_cmds(data.get("commands", {}))
166            capabilities = data.get("capabilities", [])
167            metadata.update(data.get("metadata", {}))
168
169        # 3. Discover SlopsLint repository hygiene configuration
170        slop_config = root / ".slop" / "config.yml"
171        slop_ceilings = root / ".slop" / "ceilings.yml"
172        if slop_config.exists():
173            if not slop_ceilings.exists():
174                hygiene_status = "invalid_configuration"
175            else:
176                ok, _, pmeta = HygienePolicyClassifier.verify_provider_integrity("slopslint")
177                if ok:
178                    hygiene_status = "configured_and_passed"
179                elif pmeta.get("status") == "version_mismatch":
180                    hygiene_status = "invalid_provider_version"
181                else:
182                    hygiene_status = "configured_tool_missing"
183
184            if not hygiene_commands:
185                hygiene_commands.append(["slopslint", "check", "--classify", "--enforce"])
186
187        # 4. Discover HowlFrame source files and metadata
188        howl_sources = _find_howl_sources(root)
189        if howl_sources:
190            if "howlframe" not in project_types:
191                project_types.append("howlframe")
192            if "howlframe-app-development" not in skills:
193                skills.append("howlframe-app-development")
194            metadata["howl_sources"] = [str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in howl_sources]
195            metadata["howl_source_count"] = len(howl_sources)
196            apparent_targets = _extract_apparent_targets(howl_sources)
197            if apparent_targets:
198                metadata["apparent_targets"] = apparent_targets
199
200        if "howlframe" in project_types and "howlframe-app-development" not in skills:
201            skills.append("howlframe-app-development")
202
203        # Check for HowlFrame bootstrap revision in scripts/bootstrap.sh
204        bootstrap_sh = root / "scripts" / "bootstrap.sh"
205        if bootstrap_sh.is_file():
206            try:
207                boot_txt = bootstrap_sh.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
208                rev_match = re.search(r'PINNED_HOWLFRAME_REV\s*=\s*["\']?([a-f0-9]+)["\']?', boot_txt)
209                if rev_match:
210                    metadata["howlframe_pinned_rev"] = rev_match.group(1)
211            except Exception:
212                pass
213
214        # Check for nested Go module (e.g. tests/go.mod)
215        tests_go_mod = root / "tests" / "go.mod"
216        if tests_go_mod.is_file():
217            metadata.setdefault("nested_modules", []).append({"type": "go", "path": "tests"})
218            metadata["test_module"] = "tests/go.mod"
219
220        # 5. Stack heuristics if commands are not explicitly specified
221        if not test_commands or not build_commands or not lint_commands:
222            # Check for Makefile
223            makefile = root / "Makefile"
224            if makefile.exists():
225                text = makefile.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
226                if "test:" in text and not test_commands:
227                    test_commands.append(["make", "test"])
228                if "lint:" in text and not lint_commands:
229                    lint_commands.append(["make", "lint"])
230                if "build:" in text and not build_commands:
231                    build_commands.append(["make", "build"])
232
233            # Check for Go (root module)
234            if (root / "go.mod").exists():
235                if "go" not in project_types:
236                    project_types.append("go")
237                if not test_commands:
238                    test_commands.append(["go", "test", "./..."])
239                if not build_commands:
240                    build_commands.append(["go", "build", "./..."])
241                if not lint_commands:
242                    lint_commands.append(["go", "vet", "./..."])
243
244            # Check for Python
245            if (root / "pyproject.toml").exists() or (root / "setup.py").exists() or (root / "requirements.txt").exists():
246                if "python" not in project_types:
247                    project_types.append("python")
248                if not test_commands:
249                    test_commands.append(["pytest"])
250                if not lint_commands:
251                    lint_commands.append(["flake8"])
252
253            # Check for Node / TS
254            if (root / "package.json").exists():
255                if "javascript" not in project_types:
256                    project_types.append("javascript")
257                if not test_commands:
258                    test_commands.append(["npm", "test"])
259
260            # Check for Rust
261            if (root / "Cargo.toml").exists():
262                if "rust" not in project_types:
263                    project_types.append("rust")
264                if not test_commands:
265                    test_commands.append(["cargo", "test"])
266                if not build_commands:
267                    build_commands.append(["cargo", "build"])
268
269            # Check for conventional script entrypoints in scripts/
270            if not build_commands:
271                if (root / "scripts" / "build.sh").is_file():
272                    build_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/build.sh"])
273                elif (root / "scripts" / "build").is_file():
274                    build_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/build"])
275
276            if not test_commands:
277                if (root / "scripts" / "test.sh").is_file():
278                    test_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/test.sh"])
279                elif (root / "scripts" / "test").is_file():
280                    test_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/test"])
281
282            if not lint_commands:
283                if (root / "scripts" / "lint.sh").is_file():
284                    lint_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/lint.sh"])
285                elif (root / "scripts" / "lint").is_file():
286                    lint_commands.append(["bash", "scripts/lint"])
287
288            # Check for nested test module fallback if test_commands still empty
289            if not test_commands and tests_go_mod.is_file():
290                test_commands.append(["bash", "-c", "cd tests && go test ./..."])
291
292            # Check for standalone shell test suites
293            tests_dir = root / "tests"
294            if tests_dir.is_dir() and not test_commands:
295                sh_tests = sorted(tests_dir.glob("*.sh"))
296                for sh_t in sh_tests:
297                    rel_p = str(sh_t.relative_to(root))
298                    test_commands.append(["bash", rel_p])
299
300        # 6. Formatting commands.
301        #
302        # Deliberately discovered outside the block above, which only runs when
303        # a test/build/lint command is still missing: a project that specifies
304        # all three would otherwise never be offered a formatter at all.
305        #
306        # Formatting is part of ordinary implementation work rather than a
307        # deterministic gate, so these commands are kept separate from the
308        # verification surface. They are what an implementer may legitimately
309        # run; they are not added to the VerificationPlan and do not change what
310        # a change is verified against (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07, where a Claude
311        # implementation attempt was blocked on `gofmt -l` and `go fmt` because
312        # no formatting command was discoverable for any language).
313        if not format_commands:
314            makefile = root / "Makefile"
315            if makefile.exists():
316                text = makefile.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
317                for target in ("fmt", "format"):
318                    if f"{target}:" in text:
319                        format_commands.append(["make", target])
320                        break
321
322        # Language defaults are added even when a Makefile target was found.
323        # A wrapper target is what the project prefers, not the only formatter
324        # an implementer will reach for: an agent told to format Go code runs
325        # `gofmt`, and granting only `make format` leaves it blocked exactly as
326        # in HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07. Both are legitimate and neither widens the
327        # bound beyond formatting.
328        if not any(cmd[:1] != ["make"] for cmd in format_commands):
329            if (root / "go.mod").exists():
330                # Both forms: `go fmt` rewrites, `gofmt -l` reports. A mutating
331                # role already holds Edit/Write, so the rewriting form grants no
332                # new kind of authority, and a provider denied one of the two
333                # reports itself blocked exactly as SLOPFIX-07 did.
334                format_commands.append(["go", "fmt", "./..."])
335                format_commands.append(["gofmt", "-l", "."])
336            elif (root / "pyproject.toml").exists():
337                pyproject = (root / "pyproject.toml").read_text(
338                    encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"
339                )
340                # Only grant a formatter the project actually configures.
341                if "ruff" in pyproject:
342                    format_commands.append(["ruff", "format", "."])
343                elif "black" in pyproject:
344                    format_commands.append(["black", "."])
345            elif (root / "Cargo.toml").exists():
346                format_commands.append(["cargo", "fmt"])
347
348        return ProjectContext(
349            project_root=str(root),
350            name=name,
351            project_types=project_types,
352            skills=skills,
353            test_commands=test_commands,
354            build_commands=build_commands,
355            lint_commands=lint_commands,
356            format_commands=format_commands,
357            hygiene_commands=hygiene_commands,
358            hygiene_status=hygiene_status,
359            capabilities=capabilities,
360            has_manifest=has_manifest,
361            has_agents_md=has_agents_md,
362            metadata=metadata,
363        )

366    def create_verification_plan(cls, context: ProjectContext, task_id: str) -> VerificationPlan:
367        """

369        """
370        plan = VerificationPlan(task_id=task_id)
371        idx = 1
372
373        for cmd in context.lint_commands:
374            plan.add_step(

376                name=f"Lint check ({' '.join(cmd)})",

378                category="lint",
379                required=True,
380            )
381            idx += 1

383        for cmd in context.build_commands:

387                command=cmd,
388                category="build",
389                required=True,
390            )
391            idx += 1
392
393        for cmd in context.test_commands:
394            plan.add_step(
395                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
396                name=f"Automated test suite ({' '.join(cmd)})",
397                command=cmd,
398                category="unit_test",
399                required=True,
400            )
401            idx += 1
402
403        for cmd in context.hygiene_commands:
404            plan.add_step(
405                step_id=f"step-{idx:02d}",
406                name=f"Repository hygiene gate ({' '.join(cmd)})",
407                command=cmd,
408                category="repository_hygiene",
409                required=True,
410            )
411            idx += 1
412
413        return plan

114        lint_commands: List[List[str]] = []

119        metadata: Dict[str, Any] = {}
120        has_manifest = False

122
123        def _extract_manifest_cmds(cmds: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
124            for k in ("test", "build", "lint", "format", "fmt"):
125                if k in cmds:
126                    val = cmds[k]
127                    cmd_list = val if isinstance(val, list) else [val]
128                    if k == "test":
129                        test_commands.append(cmd_list)
130                    elif k == "build":
131                        build_commands.append(cmd_list)
132                    elif k == "lint":
133                        lint_commands.append(cmd_list)
134                    else:
135                        format_commands.append(cmd_list)
136            for hk in ("hygiene", "repository_hygiene"):
137                if hk in cmds:
138                    hval = cmds[hk]
139                    hygiene_commands.append(hval if isinstance(hval, list) else [hval])
140                    break

142        # 1. Check for .ai-project.toml

class HumanBoundaryGate: 
241class HumanBoundaryGate:
242    """Evaluates task intent, actions, and risk against human authority policies."""
243
244    @classmethod
245    def _build_pre_execution_packet(
246        cls,
247        task: TaskSpec,
248        triggers: List[str],
249        actions: List[ProposedAction],
250        change_summary: str,
251        evidence: List[str],
252        risk_prefix: str = "Pre-execution boundary",
253    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
254        """
255        Shared decision-packet construction for the pre-implementation
256        boundary paths (evaluate_pre_execution and the non-delegated
257        fallback of evaluate_with_delegated_authority), which otherwise
258        differ only in change_summary/evidence text.
259        """
260        risks = [f"{risk_prefix} '{t}': {HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS.get(t, t)}" for t in triggers]
261        packet = HumanDecisionPacket(
262            task_id=task.task_id,
263            objective=task.objective,
264            change_summary=change_summary,
265            boundary_triggers=triggers,
266            evidence=evidence,
267            risks=risks,
268            review_findings_summary={"total": 0, "blocker": 0, "high": 0},
269            verification_status="pre_execution",
270            recommended_action="Review requested consequential action and authorize or reject execution.",
271            proposed_actions=[a.to_dict() for a in actions],
272            executor_id=actions[0].executor_id if actions and actions[0].executor_id else None,
273        )
274        return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=True, triggered_boundaries=triggers, decision_packet=packet)
275
276    @classmethod
277    def evaluate_pre_execution(
278        cls,
279        task: TaskSpec,
280        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
281        target_repo: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
282    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
283        """
284        Evaluates task objective, metadata, and planned actions BEFORE launching an implementation agent.
285        Prevents unrestricted agents from executing consequential mutations prior to human authority.
286        """
287        repo_name = task.repository or (Path(target_repo).name if target_repo else "")
288        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
289            objective=task.objective,
290            repo_name=repo_name,
291            planned_actions=planned_actions,
292            human_approval_requirements=task.human_approval_requirements,
293        )
294
295        triggers = [a.authority_boundary for a in actions if a.authority_boundary]
296        if task.human_approval_requirements:
297            for req in task.human_approval_requirements:
298                if req in HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS and req not in triggers:
299                    triggers.append(req)
300
301        if task.risk_level == "critical" and "production_deployment" not in triggers:
302            triggers.append("production_deployment")
303
304        if not triggers:
305            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False)
306
307        return cls._build_pre_execution_packet(
308            task, triggers, actions,
309            change_summary="Consequential action requested prior to implementation agent launch.",
310            evidence=["Pre-execution authority evaluation"],
311        )
312
313    @classmethod
314    def evaluate(
315        cls,
316        task: TaskSpec,
317        planned_actions: List[str],
318        change_summary: str = "",
319        reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None,
320        verification: Optional[VerificationPlan] = None,
321        hygiene_policy: Optional[PolicyEvaluationResult] = None,
322        non_independent_roles: Optional[List[str]] = None,
323    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
324        """
325        Determines whether the post-verification task hits a human authority boundary.
326        Distinguishes quality improvements (autonomously permitted) from debt acceptance / weakening.
327        """
328        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
329            objective=task.objective,
330            repo_name=task.repository,
331            planned_actions=planned_actions,
332            human_approval_requirements=task.human_approval_requirements,
333        )
334        triggers = [a.authority_boundary for a in actions if a.authority_boundary]
335
336        if task.human_approval_requirements:
337            for req in task.human_approval_requirements:
338                if req in HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS and req not in triggers:
339                    triggers.append(req)
340
341        if hygiene_policy:
342            if hygiene_policy.is_hard_rejected and "hygiene_policy_violation" not in triggers:
343                triggers.append("hygiene_policy_violation")
344            if hygiene_policy.verdict == PolicyChangeType.DEBT_ACCEPTANCE and "slop_debt_acceptance" not in triggers:
345                triggers.append("slop_debt_acceptance")
346            elif hygiene_policy.verdict == PolicyChangeType.WEAKENING and "hygiene_policy_weakening" not in triggers:
347                triggers.append("hygiene_policy_weakening")
348            elif hygiene_policy.verdict == PolicyChangeType.UNKNOWN and "security_policy_exception" not in triggers:
349                triggers.append("security_policy_exception")
350        else:
351            actions_str = " ".join(planned_actions).lower()
352            if "tombstone" in actions_str and "slop_debt_acceptance" not in triggers:
353                triggers.append("slop_debt_acceptance")
354            if "ceiling increase" in actions_str and "hygiene_policy_violation" not in triggers:
355                triggers.append("hygiene_policy_violation")
356
357        # 4. Inspect reconciliation findings for unresolved blockers or security human reviews
358        if reconciliation and reconciliation.requires_human_judgment:
359            if "security_policy_exception" not in triggers:
360                triggers.append("security_policy_exception")
361
362        # A change whose reviewer was its own author has not been independently
363        # reviewed, however clean the verdict reads. On HOWLFRAM-BUG-50 failover
364        # handed the implementer three of its own reviews and the run proceeded
365        # as though independence held, so this now reaches the human either way.
366        if non_independent_roles and "non_independent_review" not in triggers:
367            triggers.append("non_independent_review")
368
369        # 5. Critical risk tasks always trigger human authority
370        if task.risk_level == "critical" and "production_deployment" not in triggers:
371            triggers.append("production_deployment")
372
373        if not triggers:
374            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False)
375
376        # Build decision packet
377        evidence_list: List[str] = []
378        if verification:
379            for step in verification.steps:
380                evidence_list.append(f"Step '{step.name}': {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code})")
381
382        if hygiene_policy and hygiene_policy.changes:
383            for c in hygiene_policy.changes:
384                evidence_list.append(f"Policy Change [{c.change_type.value.upper()}]: {c.description}")
385
386        risks_list: List[str] = []
387        for t in triggers:
388            risks_list.append(f"Policy boundary '{t}': {HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS.get(t, t)}")
389
390        findings_summary = {
391            "total": len(reconciliation.findings) if reconciliation else 0,
392            "blocker": reconciliation.unresolved_blockers if reconciliation else 0,
393            "high": reconciliation.unresolved_highs if reconciliation else 0,
394        }
395
396        rec_action = "Review diff and evidence packet, then provide explicit approval or rejection."
397        if "hygiene_policy_violation" in triggers:
398            rec_action = "HARD REJECT: Prohibited ceiling inflation or policy violation must be remediated in code."
399
400        summary_text = change_summary
401        if not summary_text and hygiene_policy:
402            summary_text = hygiene_policy.summary
403        if not summary_text:
404            summary_text = "Pending review & human confirmation."
405
406        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
407            objective=task.objective,
408            repo_name=task.repository,
409            planned_actions=planned_actions,
410            human_approval_requirements=triggers,
411        )
412        executor_id = actions[0].executor_id if actions and actions[0].executor_id else None
413
414        packet = HumanDecisionPacket(
415            task_id=task.task_id,
416            objective=task.objective,
417            change_summary=summary_text,
418            boundary_triggers=triggers,
419            evidence=evidence_list,
420            risks=risks_list,
421            review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
422            verification_status=verification.overall_status if verification else "unverified",
423            recommended_action=rec_action,
424            proposed_actions=[a.to_dict() for a in actions],
425            executor_id=executor_id,
426        )
427
428        return BoundaryCheckResult(
429            requires_human_approval=True,
430            triggered_boundaries=triggers,
431            decision_packet=packet,
432        )
433
434    @classmethod
435    def evaluate_with_delegated_authority(
436        cls,
437        task: TaskSpec,
438        planned_actions: List[str],
439        envelope: Optional[Any] = None,
440        target_repo: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
441        repo_slug: Optional[str] = None,
442        files_changed: Optional[List[str]] = None,
443        **kwargs: Any,
444    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
445        """
446        Delegated-authority pre-check (#59 Phase 11): ProposedAction ->
447        identify authority class -> does the campaign's AuthorityEnvelope
448        contain exact permission? If every triggered boundary resolves to
449        DELEGATED_AUTHORITY_ALLOW, autonomous continuation is permitted
450        without asking a human. Otherwise this falls through to today's
451        evaluate_pre_execution()/evaluate() behavior unchanged -- this
452        method never weakens or replaces existing human-boundary protection,
453        it only adds a policy-driven allow path in front of it.
454
455        The model never answers "am I allowed?" here: the only inputs that
456        matter are the envelope (operator-created, tamper-verified) and the
457        NEVER_DELEGATABLE_BOUNDARIES set (code-defined, not campaign data).
458        """
459        # Local imports to avoid a hard import-time dependency from
460        # human_boundary.py (a foundational, widely-imported module) on the
461        # newer authority modules, and to keep this delegated-authority path
462        # entirely optional for callers that don't pass an envelope.
463        from src.control_plane.authority_envelope import (
464            AuthorityDecision,
465            evaluate_action_against_envelope,
466        )
467        from src.control_plane.proposed_action import infer_proposed_actions_from_diff
468
469        repo_name = task.repository or (Path(target_repo).name if target_repo else "")
470        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
471            objective=task.objective,
472            repo_name=repo_name,
473            planned_actions=planned_actions,
474            human_approval_requirements=task.human_approval_requirements,
475        )
476        actions = actions + infer_proposed_actions_from_diff(files_changed or [], repo_name=repo_name)
477
478        triggers = [a.authority_boundary for a in actions if a.authority_boundary]
479        if task.risk_level == "critical" and "production_deployment" not in triggers:
480            triggers.append("production_deployment")
481
482        if not triggers:
483            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False)
484
485        slug = repo_slug or repo_name
486        all_delegated = True
487        reasons: List[str] = []
488        for trigger in triggers:
489            if trigger in NEVER_DELEGATABLE_BOUNDARIES:
490                all_delegated = False
491                reasons.append(f"'{trigger}' is never delegatable regardless of envelope contents.")
492                continue
493            decision, reason = evaluate_action_against_envelope(envelope, trigger, slug)
494            if decision != AuthorityDecision.DELEGATED_AUTHORITY_ALLOW:
495                all_delegated = False
496            reasons.append(reason)
497
498        if all_delegated:
499            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False, triggered_boundaries=triggers)
500
501        # Not fully delegated: build the human decision packet directly from
502        # the triggers already computed above (which may include diff-based
503        # self-modification triggers that evaluate_pre_execution()'s own
504        # text-only inference would never see) rather than re-deriving
505        # triggers from scratch and silently losing them.
506        return cls._build_pre_execution_packet(
507            task, triggers, actions,
508            change_summary="Consequential action requested; delegated authority did not fully cover it.",
509            evidence=["Delegated authority evaluation: " + "; ".join(reasons)],
510            risk_prefix="Boundary",
511        )

Evaluates task intent, actions, and risk against human authority policies.

@classmethod
def evaluate_pre_execution( cls, task: TaskSpec, planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None, target_repo: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None) -> BoundaryCheckResult:

277    def evaluate_pre_execution(

282    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
283        """
284        Evaluates task objective, metadata, and planned actions BEFORE launching an implementation agent.
285        Prevents unrestricted agents from executing consequential mutations prior to human authority.
286        """

288        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
289            objective=task.objective,

294
295        triggers = [a.authority_boundary for a in actions if a.authority_boundary]

297            for req in task.human_approval_requirements:
298                if req in HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS and req not in triggers:
299                    triggers.append(req)
300
301        if task.risk_level == "critical" and "production_deployment" not in triggers:
302            triggers.append("production_deployment")
303
304        if not triggers:
305            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False)
306
307        return cls._build_pre_execution_packet(
308            task, triggers, actions,
309            change_summary="Consequential action requested prior to implementation agent launch.",
310            evidence=["Pre-execution authority evaluation"],
311        )

@dataclass
class HumanDecisionPacket(src.control_plane.task_spec.DataClassSerializationMixin): 
168@dataclass
169class HumanDecisionPacket(DataClassSerializationMixin):
170    """Concise decision packet presented to a human operator for sign-off."""
171
172    task_id: str
173    objective: str
174    change_summary: str
175    boundary_triggers: List[str]
176    evidence: List[str]
177    risks: List[str]
178    review_findings_summary: Dict[str, int]
179    verification_status: str
180    recommended_action: str
181    proposed_actions: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
182    executor_id: Optional[str] = None
183    changeops_decision_id: Optional[str] = None
184
185    def render_markdown(self) -> str:
186        triggers_str = "\n".join(f"- ⚠️ **{t}**: {HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS.get(t, t)}" for t in self.boundary_triggers)
187        evidence_str = "\n".join(f"- {e}" for e in self.evidence) or "None recorded."
188        risks_str = "\n".join(f"- {r}" for r in self.risks) or "None recorded."
189        findings_text = (
190            f"{self.review_findings_summary.get('total', 0)} total ("
191            f"{self.review_findings_summary.get('blocker', 0)} blockers, "
192            f"{self.review_findings_summary.get('high', 0)} highs)"
193        )
194
195        exec_section = ""
196        if self.executor_id or self.changeops_decision_id:
197            exec_section = f"""
198## Bounded Execution Context
199- **Executor:** `{self.executor_id or 'None'}`
200- **ChangeOps Decision ID:** `{self.changeops_decision_id or 'None'}`
201"""
202
203        return f"""# 🛑 Human Authority Decision Packet: Task `{self.task_id}`
204
205## Objective
206{self.objective}
207
208## Boundary Triggers (Human Authorization Required)
209{triggers_str}
210{exec_section}
211## Proposed Change Summary
212{self.change_summary}
213
214## Verification Status
215- **Automated Verification:** `{self.verification_status}`
216- **Review Findings:** {findings_text}
217
218## Key Evidence
219{evidence_str}
220
221## Identified Risks
222{risks_str}
223
224## Recommended Action
225{self.recommended_action}
226
227---
228*Awaiting explicit human approval. Lack of response is treated as DENIED (fail-closed).*
229"""

 328class GovernedTaskOrchestrator:
 329    """
 330    Drives the end-to-end governed engineering lifecycle, maintaining
 331    strict control over state transitions, adversarial reviews,
 332    remediation loops, verification gates, and human authority boundaries.
 333    """
 334
 335    def __init__(
 336        self,
 337        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
 338        control_plane_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 339        config: Optional[OrchestrationConfig] = None,
 340    ):
 341        self.target_repo = Path(target_repo).resolve()
 342        self.control_plane_root = (
 343            Path(control_plane_root).resolve()
 344            if control_plane_root
 345            else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
 346        )
 347        self.config = config or OrchestrationConfig()
 348        ledger_path = str(self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
 349        self.ledger = EvidenceLedger(ledger_path)
 350        traj_dir = self.config.trajectory_store_dir
 351        if traj_dir is None:
 352            traj_dir = self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "trajectories"
 353        self.trajectory_store = TrajectoryStore(traj_dir) if self.config.record_trajectory else None
 354
 355    def _enforce_task_path_scope(self, task_spec: TaskSpec, delta: RepositoryDelta) -> List[str]:
 356        """
 357        Reverts edits outside `task_spec.allowed_paths` before the delta is
 358        reviewed (#59.2 Phase 8/17).
 359
 360        `allowed_paths` was previously enforced only at commit time, inside
 361        GitIntegrationExecutor.stage_and_commit -- after independent review had
 362        already seen (and legitimately objected to) the out-of-scope work. A
 363        path-scoped task whose agent wandered into production files therefore
 364        parked on review findings about code it was never permitted to change.
 365        Enforcing here keeps the reviewed diff identical to the committed one.
 366
 367        Reverts only the paths the delta itself names, using the same
 368        `git checkout --` / unlink pair as _reconcile_attempt_state: no
 369        `git reset --hard`, no `git clean`, and files the task never touched
 370        are never inspected. Returns the reverted paths (empty when the task
 371        declares no scope, which is the default for ordinary tasks).
 372        """
 373        allowed = list(task_spec.allowed_paths or [])
 374        if not allowed or delta is None or delta.is_empty:
 375            return []
 376
 377        repo_root = Path(self.target_repo).resolve()
 378        out_of_scope = [
 379            p for p in (
 380                list(delta.files_modified) + list(delta.files_deleted) + list(delta.files_added)
 381            )
 382            if p not in allowed
 383        ]
 384        added = set(delta.files_added)
 385        for rel_path in out_of_scope:
 386            if rel_path in added:
 387                candidate = (repo_root / rel_path).resolve()
 388                # Never step outside the repository, whatever the delta claims.
 389                if not str(candidate).startswith(str(repo_root)):
 390                    continue
 391                try:
 392                    if candidate.is_file():
 393                        candidate.unlink()
 394                except OSError:
 395                    pass
 396            else:
 397                run_git(repo_root, ["checkout", "--", rel_path], 30)
 398        return out_of_scope
 399
 400    def _capture_scoped_delta(
 401        self,
 402        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 403        baseline: GitBaseline,
 404        agent_id: str,
 405        stage: str,
 406    ) -> RepositoryDelta:
 407        """Capture delta and revert any out-of-scope edits before review/commit."""
 408        delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 409        reverted_scope = self._enforce_task_path_scope(task_spec, delta)
 410        if reverted_scope:
 411            delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 412            self._record_event(
 413                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 414                agent_id=agent_id,
 415                action="out_of_scope_edits_reverted",
 416                spec=task_spec,
 417                metadata={"reverted_paths": reverted_scope, "allowed_paths": list(task_spec.allowed_paths), "stage": stage},
 418            )
 419        return delta

 421    def _record_implementation_attempt(
 422        self,
 423        run_dir: Path,
 424        attempts_dir: Path,
 425        attempt_num: int,
 426        resource_id: str,
 427        impl_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult],
 428        delta: RepositoryDelta,
 429        failure_class: Optional[str],
 430        capacity_before: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 431    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 432        """Persists attempt-level evidence and returns an additive record."""
 433        attempt_dir = attempts_dir / f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 434        attempt_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 435
 436        if impl_res is not None:
 437            (attempt_dir / "result.json").write_text(impl_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 438        (attempt_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 439        if not delta.is_empty:
 440            (attempt_dir / "partial_work.patch").write_text(delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 441
 442        # A retained salvage artifact from an earlier, interrupted run lives on
 443        # this attempt's record. Re-recording the same slot on resume must not
 444        # erase the fallback; its patch is kept under its own name and its
 445        # identity is digest-checked before any promotion, so carrying it
 446        # forward can only ever be verified, never trusted blindly.
 447        carried_salvage: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
 448        existing_record = attempt_dir / "attempt_record.json"
 449        if existing_record.is_file():
 450            try:
 451                carried_salvage = (
 452                    safe_load_json(existing_record) or {}
 453                ).get("retained_salvage")
 454            except Exception:
 455                carried_salvage = None
 456
 457        capacity_after: Dict[str, str] = {}
 458        if self.config.provider_pool is not None:
 459            # record_result already mutated state; capture after.
 460            capacity_after = self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
 461
 462        record: Dict[str, Any] = {
 463            "attempt": attempt_num,
 464            "resource_id": resource_id,
 465            "agent_id": impl_res.agent_id if impl_res else resource_id,
 466            "identity": self._resource_identity_fields(resource_id),
 467            "success": impl_res.success if impl_res else False,
 468            "exit_code": impl_res.exit_code if impl_res else None,
 469            "duration_seconds": impl_res.duration_seconds if impl_res else 0.0,
 470            "failure_class": failure_class,
 471            "delta": delta.to_dict(),
 472            "capacity_before": capacity_before,
 473            "capacity_after": capacity_after,
 474            "schema": IMPLEMENTATION_ATTEMPT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 475            "evidence_dir": str(attempt_dir.relative_to(run_dir)),
 476        }
 477        if carried_salvage:
 478            record["retained_salvage"] = carried_salvage
 479        self._persist_attempt_record(record, attempts_dir)
 480        return record
 481
 482    def _resource_identity_fields(self, resource_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 483        """Names which provider, interface, and model actually ran this attempt."""
 484        state = (
 485            self.config.provider_pool.get_resource_status(resource_id)
 486            if self.config.provider_pool is not None else None
 487        )
 488        if state is None:
 489            return {
 490                "provider_id": None,
 491                "interface_id": None,
 492                "resource_id": resource_id,
 493                "model_id": None,
 494            }
 495        return {
 496            "provider_id": state.provider_id,
 497            "interface_id": state.interface_id,
 498            "resource_id": state.resource_id or resource_id,
 499            "model_id": state.model_id,
 500        }

 502    @staticmethod
 503    def _persist_attempt_record(
 504        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 505        attempts_dir: Path,
 506    ) -> None:
 507        """Rewrites an attempt's record in place as later evidence is amended.
 508
 509        Attempt evidence is additive and is filled in across the attempt's
 510        lifetime -- the result first, then the failover selection, then the
 511        rollback outcome, and now the retained-salvage block -- so every
 512        amendment goes through here rather than opening its own write path.
 513
 514        The write is atomic because a retained salvage artifact is discoverable
 515        only through this file: a torn write during an interruption would lose
 516        the fallback that HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07R proved must survive.
 517        """
 518        record_path = (
 519            attempts_dir
 520            / f"{attempt_record['attempt']:02d}-{attempt_record['resource_id']}"
 521            / "attempt_record.json"
 522        )
 523        atomic_write_json(record_path, attempt_record)
 524
 525    def _attach_next_selection(
 526        self,
 527        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 528        attempts_dir: Path,
 529        decision: Any,
 530    ) -> None:
 531        """Records which resource failover chose next, and why the others lost."""
 532        selected = getattr(decision, "selected", None)
 533        attempt_record["next_selection"] = {
 534            "selected_resource_id": selected.resource_id if selected else None,
 535            "blocked_reason": getattr(decision, "blocked_reason", None),
 536            "eligible_resources": [
 537                identity.resource_id
 538                for identity in getattr(decision, "eligible_resources", []) or []
 539            ],
 540            "exclusions": [
 541                {
 542                    "resource_id": exclusion.resource_id,
 543                    "reason": exclusion.reason,
 544                    "stage": exclusion.stage,
 545                }
 546                for exclusion in getattr(decision, "exclusions", []) or []
 547            ],
 548        }
 549        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)
 550
 551    def _attach_rollback_result(
 552        self,
 553        attempt_record: Dict[str, Any],
 554        attempts_dir: Path,
 555        restored: bool,
 556        error: Optional[str],
 557    ) -> None:
 558        """Records whether this attempt's work was safely undone before the next."""
 559        attempt_record["rollback"] = {"restored": restored, "error": error}
 560        self._persist_attempt_record(attempt_record, attempts_dir)

 562    def _park_awaiting_human(
 563        self,
 564        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 565        run_dir: Path,
 566        err_msg: str,
 567        decision_pkt: "HumanDecisionPacket",
 568        progress: Any,
 569    ) -> None:
 570        """Hands a task to human authority, leaving the working tree in place.
 571
 572        Every parking path performs the same five steps, and the working tree is
 573        deliberately never rolled back here: a human is being asked to look at
 574        exactly what is on disk.
 575        """
 576        progress.record_terminal(
 577            TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
 578            TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
 579            error_message=err_msg,
 580        )
 581        task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", err_msg)
 582        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 583        (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(
 584            decision_pkt.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8"
 585        )
 586        self._record_human_boundary_events(task_spec, run_dir, reason=err_msg)

 588    def _get_scratch_base_path(self) -> Path:
 589        """Determines the root directory for external provider scratch workspaces.
 590
 591        Provider scratch and the sanitized verification view share one root and
 592        one containment rule, so a root configured inside the target repository
 593        is rejected identically for both.
 594        """
 595        repo = self.target_repo if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else Path.cwd()
 596        return resolve_external_scratch_root(repo, self.config.scratch_root)
 597
 598    def _execute_verification_plan(
 599        self,
 600        verif_plan: VerificationPlan,
 601        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 602        baseline: GitBaseline,
 603        delta: RepositoryDelta,
 604        run_dir: Path,
 605        progress: Optional[Any],
 606    ) -> str:
 607        """Runs the deterministic gates against a sanitized view of the repository.
 608
 609        The gates measure the product, so they must see the product and nothing
 610        else. Running them in the live checkout let untracked control plane
 611        evidence decide the outcome: in HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07S a provider's
 612        source clone under `.task_runs/` moved the `go_production` clone count
 613        from 291 to 1421 without a line of product code changing.
 614
 615        A view that cannot be built fails the gate. Falling back to the live
 616        checkout would quietly restore that contamination and report the result
 617        as if it had been isolated.
 618        """
 619        if not self.config.verification_isolation:
 620            return verif_plan.execute_all(
 621                cwd=str(self.target_repo),
 622                stop_on_failure=self.config.stop_on_verification_failure,
 623                progress_tracker=progress,
 624            )
 625
 626        view_ref: Optional[Any] = None
 627        try:
 628            with verification_view(
 629                target_repo=self.target_repo,
 630                baseline=baseline,
 631                delta=delta,
 632                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 633                scratch_root=self.config.scratch_root,
 634            ) as view:
 635                view_ref = view
 636                self._record_event(
 637                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 638                    agent_id="control_plane",
 639                    action="verification_view_created",
 640                    spec=task_spec,
 641                    metadata={
 642                        "baseline_sha": view.baseline_sha,
 643                        "files_materialized": len(view.files_materialized),
 644                        "files_refused": view.files_refused,
 645                    },
 646                )
 647                status = verif_plan.execute_all(
 648                    cwd=str(view.path),
 649                    stop_on_failure=self.config.stop_on_verification_failure,
 650                    progress_tracker=progress,
 651                )
 652        except VerificationViewError as exc:
 653            reason = f"Sanitized verification view could not be built: {exc}"
 654            verif_plan.add_step(
 655                step_id="step-verification-view",
 656                name="Sanitized verification view",
 657                command=["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach"],
 658                category="policy_check",
 659                required=True,
 660                metadata={"baseline_sha": getattr(baseline, "initial_commit_sha", "")},
 661            )
 662            failed_step = verif_plan.steps[-1]
 663            failed_step.status = "failed"
 664            failed_step.exit_code = 1
 665            failed_step.stderr = reason
 666            verif_plan.overall_status = "failed"
 667            atomic_write_json(
 668                run_dir / "verification_view.json",
 669                {
 670                    "schema": VERIFICATION_VIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 671                    "task_id": task_spec.task_id,
 672                    "status": "unavailable",
 673                    "error": str(exc),
 674                },
 675            )
 676            self._record_event(
 677                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 678                agent_id="control_plane",
 679                action="verification_view_failed",
 680                spec=task_spec,
 681                result="failed",
 682                metadata={"error": str(exc)},
 683            )
 684            return "failed"
 685
 686        # Written after teardown so the recorded cleanup status is the real one.
 687        if view_ref is not None:
 688            atomic_write_json(run_dir / "verification_view.json", view_ref.to_dict())
 689        return status

 691    def _attempt_workspace_hint(self, task: TaskSpec) -> str:
 692        """The provider-writable scratch path, as named to the provider.
 693
 694        Deliberately outside `implementation/attempts/` and outside the target
 695        repository so scratch source trees or build caches cannot contaminate
 696        deterministic repository verification gates (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07S).
 697        """
 698        base = self._get_scratch_base_path()
 699        repo_slug = self.target_repo.resolve().name if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else "repo"
 700        return f"{base}/{repo_slug}/{task.task_id}/provider_scratch/<NN-resource>/"

 702    def _provider_scratch_dir(self, run_dir: Path, attempt_num: int, resource_id: str) -> Path:
 703        """Control-plane-owned scratch location for one attempt's provider."""
 704        base = self._get_scratch_base_path()
 705        repo_slug = self.target_repo.resolve().name if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else run_dir.parent.parent.name
 706        scratch_dir = base / repo_slug / run_dir.name / "provider_scratch" / f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 707        scratch_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 708        return scratch_dir

 710    def _record_scratch_manifest(
 711        self,
 712        run_dir: Path,
 713        task_id: str,
 714        attempt_num: int,
 715        resource_id: str,
 716        scratch_dir: Path,
 717        status: str = "active",
 718        artifacts: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 719    ) -> None:
 720        """Records durable scratch location and ownership metadata in evidence."""
 721        manifest_path = run_dir / "scratch_manifest.json"
 722        manifest: Dict[str, Any] = {}
 723        if manifest_path.is_file():
 724            try:
 725                manifest = safe_load_json(manifest_path) or {}
 726            except Exception:
 727                manifest = {}
 728        if not manifest:
 729            manifest = {
 730                "task_id": task_id,
 731                "repository": str(self.target_repo.resolve()) if hasattr(self, "target_repo") else str(run_dir.parent.parent),
 732                "scratch_root": str(self._get_scratch_base_path()),
 733                "attempts": {},
 734                "schema": SCRATCH_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 735            }
 736        attempt_key = f"{attempt_num:02d}-{resource_id}"
 737        attempt_entry = manifest.get("attempts", {}).get(attempt_key, {})
 738        attempt_entry.update({
 739            "attempt": attempt_num,
 740            "resource_id": resource_id,
 741            "scratch_path": str(scratch_dir.resolve()),
 742            "status": status,
 743            "updated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 744        })
 745        if "created_at" not in attempt_entry:
 746            attempt_entry["created_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 747        if artifacts:
 748            existing = set(attempt_entry.get("artifacts", []))
 749            existing.update(artifacts)
 750            attempt_entry["artifacts"] = sorted(existing)
 751        manifest.setdefault("attempts", {})[attempt_key] = attempt_entry
 752        atomic_write_json(manifest_path, manifest)

 754    def _prune_ephemeral_scratch(self, run_dir: Path, task_id: str) -> None:
 755        """Prunes large disposable build and tool caches from external scratch.
 756
 757        Preserves candidate patches, diffs, provider transcripts, failure evidence,
 758        and provenance files. Never removes candidate material or durable evidence.
 759        Strictly validates containment beneath the authorized scratch base to prevent
 760        path traversal or unintended file deletion.
 761        """
 762        manifest_path = run_dir / "scratch_manifest.json"
 763        if not manifest_path.is_file():
 764            return
 765        try:
 766            manifest = safe_load_json(manifest_path)
 767            if not manifest or manifest.get("schema") != SCRATCH_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION:
 768                return
 769            if not isinstance(manifest.get("attempts"), dict):
 770                return
 771            scratch_base = self._get_scratch_base_path().resolve()
 772            disposable_names = {"go-cache", ".cache"}
 773            disposable_suffixes = {".tar", ".iso"}
 774            for attempt_key, attempt_info in manifest["attempts"].items():
 775                scratch_str = attempt_info.get("scratch_path")
 776                if not scratch_str:
 777                    continue
 778                scratch_p = Path(scratch_str).resolve()
 779                # Security: scratch directory must be strictly contained within scratch_base,
 780                # cannot be scratch_base itself, and cannot be a symlink.
 781                if not scratch_p.is_relative_to(scratch_base) or scratch_p == scratch_base:
 782                    continue
 783                if scratch_p.is_symlink() or not scratch_p.is_dir():
 784                    continue
 785                pruned = False
 786                for item in scratch_p.iterdir():
 787                    if item.is_symlink():
 788                        continue
 789                    if item.is_dir() and item.name in disposable_names:
 790                        shutil.rmtree(item, ignore_errors=True)
 791                        pruned = True
 792                    elif item.is_file() and item.suffix in disposable_suffixes:
 793                        try:
 794                            item.unlink()
 795                            pruned = True
 796                        except OSError:
 797                            pass
 798                if pruned:
 799                    attempt_info["status"] = "cleaned"
 800                    attempt_info["pruned_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 801            atomic_write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
 802        except Exception:
 803            pass

 805    def _resolve_backend(self, resource_id: str) -> AgentBackend:
 806        """Resolves the execution backend for a resource, however it is wired.
 807
 808        A resumed run reconciles its implementation from the durable delta and
 809        never enters the attempt loop, so the loop-local backend it used to rely
 810        on did not exist by the time remediation needed one -- resume died with
 811        an UnboundLocalError before it could finish recovering anything.
 812        """
 813        if self.config.custom_backend is not None:
 814            return self.config.custom_backend
 815        if self.config.backend_resolver is not None:
 816            return self.config.backend_resolver(resource_id)
 817        return AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(resource_id)
