1952    def prepare_task_plan(
1953        self,
1954        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1955        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
1956    ) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, Path, Optional[Any]]:
1957        """Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs."""
1958        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
1959        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1960        (run_dir / "reviews").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1961        (run_dir / "remediation").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1962
1963        ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(self.target_repo)
1964        (run_dir / "project_context.json").write_text(ctx.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1965
1966        router = TaskRouter(resource_pool=self.config.provider_pool)
1967        routing = router.route(task_spec)
1968        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "route.json", asdict(routing))
1969        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "initial_route.json", asdict(routing))
1970
1971        verif_plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id=task_spec.task_id)
1972        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1973
1974        task_spec.recommended_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
1975        task_spec.actual_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
1976        task_spec.is_override = routing.is_override
1977        task_spec.override_reason = routing.rationale if routing.is_override else None
1978        if task_spec.current_state == "discovered":
1979            task_spec.transition_to("planned", "Task routed and verification plan generated")
1980        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1981        skill_ctx = build_skill_context(task_spec)
1982        for role_id in routing.recommended_reviewers:
1983            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
1984            if role:
1985                (run_dir / "reviews" / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(
1986                    role.render_brief(task=task_spec, diff_content="", context=skill_ctx), encoding="utf-8"
1987                )
1988        (run_dir / "findings_template.yaml").write_text("# Review Findings Template\nfindings: []\n", encoding="utf-8")
1989
1990        hf_res = None
1991        if self.config.enable_howlframe_audit:
1992            try:
1993                hf_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(
1994                    context=ctx,
1995                    record_evidence=self.config.record_evidence,
1996                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1997                    ledger=self.ledger,
1998                    dogfood_mode="shadow",
1999                )
2000                (run_dir / "howlframe_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(hf_res.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
2001            except Exception:
2002                pass
2003
2004        # Check pre-execution human authority boundary and bind HowlChangeOps decision if applicable
2005        pre_b = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
2006            task=task_spec,
2007            planned_actions=planned_actions,
2008            target_repo=self.target_repo,
2009        )
2010        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_b, run_dir)
2011        if pre_b.requires_human_approval and pre_b.decision_packet:
2012            (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(pre_b.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
2013
2014        return ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res
2015
2016    def _bind_decision_packet(self, boundary_res: Any, run_dir: Path) -> None:
2017        """Binds bounded executor decision ID to human decision packet if required."""
2018        if not boundary_res.requires_human_approval or not boundary_res.decision_packet:
2019            return
2020        if not boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions:
2021            return
2022        act_dict = boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions[0]
2023        action_obj = ProposedAction.from_dict(act_dict)
2024        from src.control_plane.executor import ExecutorRegistry
2025        executor = ExecutorRegistry.get_executor_for_action(action_obj.action_type)
2026        if executor and executor.is_available():
2027            verdict, dec_id, _ = executor.evaluate(action_obj, self.target_repo, run_dir)
2028            if dec_id:
2029                boundary_res.decision_packet.changeops_decision_id = dec_id
2030                boundary_res.decision_packet.executor_id = executor.name
2031
2032    def _fault(self, stage: str, run_dir: Path, task_spec: TaskSpec) -> None:
2033        """Fires the configured failure-injection hook for a lifecycle point.
2034
2035        Used to prove the acquisition/cleanup boundary holds: a test raises from
2036        any of these points and asserts no lock file survives.
2037        """
2038        if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
2039            self.config.failure_injection_hook(stage, run_dir, task_spec)
2040
2041    def run(
2042        self,
2043        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2044        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2045        lock_ownership: Optional[LockOwnership] = None,
2046    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2047        """
2048        Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under
2049        mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.
2050
2051        `lock_ownership` is the task-lock token of an outer lifecycle that
2052        already owns this run -- `ai resume` holds the task lock across the
2053        whole recovery, then hands it here. Without it a resumed run would
2054        deadlock against itself (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
2055        """
2056        start_time = time.time()
2057        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
2058
2059        # Setup Progress Tracker
2060        progress = self.config.progress_tracker
2061        if progress is None:
2062            enabled = (self.config.progress_mode != "never")
2063            stream = (
2064                self.config.progress_stream
2065                if self.config.progress_stream is not None
2066                else sys.stderr
2067            )
2068            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
2069                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2070                run_dir=run_dir,
2071                stream=stream,
2072                heartbeat_interval=self.config.heartbeat_interval,
2073                enabled=enabled,
2074            )
2075
2076        # Every acquisition below is registered for release the moment it
2077        # succeeds. Previously the repo lock was taken before the task lock but
2078        # outside the try/finally, so a task-lock failure stranded
2079        # `.git/howlplane.lock` and no later run could proceed
2080        # (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06). Progress starts only once the locks are held,
2081        # so a resume that cannot acquire never overwrites the durable
2082        # progress record of the run it was trying to recover.
2083        with ExitStack() as stack:
2084            if self.config.acquire_locks:
2085                repo_lock = RepoLock(
2086                    self.target_repo,
2087                    task_spec.task_id,
2088                    command=f"ai work {task_spec.task_id} --execute",
2089                )
2090                repo_lock.acquire()
2091                stack.callback(repo_lock.release)
2092                self._fault("after_repo_lock", run_dir, task_spec)
2093
2094                task_lock = TaskLock(
2095                    self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, operation="orchestrate"
2096                )
2097                task_lock.acquire(lock_ownership)
2098                stack.callback(task_lock.release)
2099                self._fault("after_task_lock", run_dir, task_spec)
2100
2101            progress.start(
2102                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2103                run_dir=run_dir,
2104                initial_phase=TaskPhase.PREPARING.value,
2105            )
2106            stack.callback(progress.close)
2107            self._fault("after_progress_start", run_dir, task_spec)
2108
2109            try:
2110                result = self._run_governed_loop(
2111                    task_spec, planned_actions, start_time, progress=progress
2112                )
2113                if self.trajectory_store is not None:
2114                    traj = ExecutionTrajectoryBuilder.from_orchestration_result(result)
2115                    self.trajectory_store.save(traj)
2116                    result.trajectory_id = traj.trajectory_id
2117                return result
2118            except Exception as exc:
2119                progress.record_terminal(
2120                    TaskProgressState.FAILED,
2121                    TaskPhase.FAILED,
2122                    error_message=str(exc),
2123                )
2124                raise
2125
2126    def _run_governed_loop(
2127        self,
2128        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2129        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2130        start_time: Optional[float] = None,
2131        progress: Optional[TaskProgressTracker] = None,
2132    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2133        start_time = start_time or time.time()
2134        if progress is None:
2135            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
2136                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2137                run_dir=None,
2138                enabled=False,
2139            )
2140
2141        progress.transition(
2142            TaskPhase.ROUTING, details="selecting implementation resource"
2143        )
2144        ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res = self.prepare_task_plan(task_spec, planned_actions)
2145        reviews_dir = run_dir / "reviews"
2146        remediation_base_dir = run_dir / "remediation"
2147        hf_audit_status = hf_res.status if hf_res else None
2148        hf_audit_match = (hf_res.status == "MATCH") if hf_res else True
2149
2150        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2151            run_dir,
2152            task_spec.task_id,
2153            "planned",
2154            repo_path=self.target_repo,
2155            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "route.json"), str(run_dir / "verification_plan.json")],
2156        )
2157
2158        self._record_event(
2159            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2160            agent_id="control_plane",
2161            action="task_created",
2162            spec=task_spec,
2163            metadata={"repo_path": str(self.target_repo), "project_types": ctx.project_types},
2164        )
2165        self._record_event(
2166            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2167            agent_id="control_plane",
2168            action="project_discovered",
2169            spec=task_spec,
2170            metadata={"hygiene_status": ctx.hygiene_status, "has_agents_md": ctx.has_agents_md},
2171        )
2172        self._record_event(
2173            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2174            agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
2175            action="route_selected",
2176            spec=task_spec,
2177            metadata={
2178                "selected_agent": routing.selected_agent_id,
2179                "reviewers": routing.recommended_reviewers,
2180                "is_override": routing.is_override,
2181            },
2182        )
2183        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(run_dir, "planned")
2184
2185        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2186        # Stage 2.5: Pre-Execution Human Authority Gating
2187        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2188        pre_boundary = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
2189            task=task_spec,
2190            planned_actions=planned_actions,
2191            target_repo=self.target_repo,
2192        )
2193        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_boundary, run_dir)
2194
2195        if pre_boundary.requires_human_approval:
2196            progress.record_terminal(
2197                TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
2198                TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
2199            )
2200            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2201                run_dir,
2202                task_spec.task_id,
2203                "awaiting_human",
2204                repo_path=self.target_repo,
2205                metadata={"boundary_triggers": pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries},
2206            )
2207            task_spec.transition_to(
2208                "awaiting_human",
2209                f"Pre-execution human authority boundary triggered: {pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries}",
2210            )
2211            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2212
2213            if pre_boundary.decision_packet:
2214                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(
2215                    pre_boundary.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8"
2216                )
2217
2218            self._record_human_boundary_events(
2219                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries, reason="Pre-execution boundary triggered"
2220            )
2221
2222            stage_kwargs = dict(
2223                start_time=start_time,
2224                run_dir=run_dir,
2225                routing=routing,
2226                initial_delta=None,
2227                current_delta=None,
2228                review_cycles=[],
2229                reconciliation=None,
2230                verif_plan=verif_plan,
2231                boundary_res=pre_boundary,
2232                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2233                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2234                remediation_count=0,
2235            )
2236            return self._make_result(task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2, **stage_kwargs)
2237
2238        if not routing.selected_agent_id:
2239            blocked = routing.metadata.get("blocked_outcome") or {
2240                "status": "BLOCKED",
2241                "reason": FAILURE_CLASS_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
2242            }
2243            progress.record_terminal(
2244                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
2245                TaskPhase.FAILED,
2246                error_message=blocked.get("reason"),
2247            )
2248            task_spec.transition_to("blocked", blocked["reason"])
2249            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2250            return self._make_result(
2251                task_spec,
2252                "blocked",
2253                3,
2254                start_time=start_time,
2255                run_dir=run_dir,
2256                routing=routing,
2257                verif_plan=verif_plan,
2258                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2259                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2260                err_msg=json.dumps(blocked, sort_keys=True),
2261                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_NO_ELIGIBLE_RESOURCE,
2262            )
2263
2264        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2265        # Stage 3: Baseline Capture / Baseline Recovery
2266        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2267        baseline_file = run_dir / "baseline.json"
2268        if baseline_file.is_file():
2269            try:
2270                baseline = GitBaseline.from_dict(safe_load_json(baseline_file))
2271            except Exception:
2272                baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
2273                (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2274        else:
2275            baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
2276            (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
2277
2278        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2279        # Stage 4: Implementation (implementing) / Reconcile on Recovery
2280        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
2281        has_existing_delta, rec_delta, rec_msg = CrashRecoveryEngine.reconcile_interrupted_implementation(
2282            self.target_repo, run_dir, task_spec
2283        )
2284
2285        impl_dir = run_dir / "implementation"
2286        impl_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2287        attempts_dir = impl_dir / "attempts"
2288        attempts_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2289
2290        # Declared for the whole loop, not just the branch that runs providers:
2291        # a recovered implementation skips the attempt loop entirely, and later
2292        # stages still need to know who (if anyone) is credited with the work.
2293        final_impl_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
2294
2295        # Stays None on the crash-recovery path, where an interrupted
2296        # implementation's delta is reconciled rather than re-run: there is no
2297        # provider execution in *this* process to report (#59.1 Phase 1).
2298        impl_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
2299        implementation_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
2300        # Declared out here because a resumed run can skip the attempt loop
2301        # entirely and still needs to report failover accounting.
2302        last_selection_decision: Optional[Any] = None
2303        # Set only when a budget-stopped attempt left a delta worth governing.
2304        timeout_candidate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
2305        # Set only when a retained fallback is promoted: the producer becomes
2306        # the candidate, but the failover chain still ended on this resource.
2307        salvage_last_attempted_id: Optional[str] = None
2308
2309        if has_existing_delta and rec_delta:
2310            current_delta = rec_delta
2311            initial_delta = rec_delta
2312            # A resumed run reconciles the delta instead of re-running the
2313            # provider, so who produced it is reconstructed from the durable
2314            # route rather than re-derived. Without this the later stages had
2315            # no implementer to credit and acceptance could never be recorded.
2316            final_impl_resource_id = self._recover_implementation_resource(
2317                run_dir, routing
2318            )
2319            # A parked candidate is the strongest form of recovered work. If
2320            # there is none, the delta in the tree may be a retained fallback
2321            # whose promotion was interrupted -- but only if it actually is
2322            # that artifact, which _recover_promoted_salvage proves before
2323            # crediting its producer.
2324            timeout_candidate = self._load_parked_candidate(run_dir)
2325            if timeout_candidate is None:
2326                timeout_candidate = self._recover_promoted_salvage(
2327                    run_dir, current_delta, task_spec
2328                )
2329                if timeout_candidate is not None:
2330                    final_impl_resource_id = timeout_candidate["resource_id"]
2331                    # The durable route already records which resource the
2332                    # failover chain ended on. Crediting the producer as the
2333                    # candidate must not overwrite that with the producer.
2334                    salvage_last_attempted_id = routing.metadata.get(
2335                        "last_attempted_implementation_resource"
2336                    )
2337            self._record_event(
2338                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2339                agent_id="control_plane",
2340                action="implementation_recovered",
2341                spec=task_spec,
2342                metadata={
2343                    "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
2344                    "recovered_implementation_resource": final_impl_resource_id,
2345                    "candidate_recovered": timeout_candidate is not None,
2346                },
2347            )
2348            if task_spec.current_state == "planned":
2349                task_spec.transition_to(
2350                    "implementing",
2351                    "Recovered existing implementation delta from interrupted run",
2352                )
2353                task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2354            impl_chk = CheckpointManager._find_latest_checkpoint_for_stage(run_dir, "implementing")
2355            if impl_chk and impl_chk.status == "in_progress":
2356                CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
2357                    run_dir,
2358                    "implementing",
2359                    result_summary={"recovered": True, "resource_id": final_impl_resource_id},
2360                )
2361        else:
2362            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
2363                run_dir,
2364                task_spec.task_id,
2365                "implementing",
2366                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
2367                repo_path=self.target_repo,
2368            )
2369
2370            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
2371                self.config.failure_injection_hook("implementing", run_dir, task_spec)
2372
2373            impl_prompt = self._build_implementation_prompt(task_spec, ctx)
2374            current_impl_resource_id = routing.selected_agent_id
2375            attempted_impl_resource_ids: Set[str] = set()
2376
2377            def fail_implementation(
2378                err_msg: str,
2379                failure_class: str,
2380                exit_code: int = 1,
2381                termination_reason: str = TERMINATION_NON_FAILOVER_FAILURE,
2382                rollback: bool = True,
2383            ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2384                """Terminal-fails the run from inside the implementation attempt loop.
2385
2386                Reads the attempt-scoped locals (delta, provider execution, attempt
2387                records) at call time, so every terminal path reports the state as of
2388                the attempt that failed.
2389
2390                Rollback used to sit at the end of the failover branch, where it
2391                only ever ran to prepare a clean tree for a *next* attempt. A
2392                terminal attempt therefore left its edits behind and its record
2393                carried no rollback key at all, contaminating the next run's
2394                starting state (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Undoing it here instead
2395                makes every terminal implementation failure restore the
2396                pre-task baseline, and say so. Evidence is already written by
2397                this point, so the patch survives the restore.
2398                """
2399                # Unconditional, exactly like the inter-attempt rollback: a
2400                # task-attributable delta can be empty while the provider has
2401                # still clobbered a file the operator had already modified,
2402                # which capture_delta deliberately excludes. Only the baseline
2403                # restore knows how to put those back.
2404                if current_impl_resource_id != routing.selected_agent_id:
2405                    self._persist_effective_route(
2406                        routing,
2407                        task_spec,
2408                        current_impl_resource_id,
2409                        ROUTE_STATUS_IMPLEMENTATION_FAILED,
2410                        accepted=False,
2411                    )
2412                if rollback:
2413                    restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
2414                        self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
2415                    )
2416                    self._attach_rollback_result(
2417                        attempt_record, attempts_dir, restored_ok, restore_err
2418                    )
2419                    if not restored_ok:
2420                        err_msg = (
2421                            f"{err_msg} Repository could not be restored to baseline "
2422                            f"({restore_err}); task-attributable changes remain."
2423                        )
2424                return self._fail_task(
2425                    task_spec,
2426                    run_dir,
2427                    err_msg,
2428                    start_time,
2429                    exit_code=exit_code,
2430                    agent_id="control_plane",
2431                    progress_tracker=progress,
2432                    stage="implementing",
2433                    routing=routing,
2434                    initial_delta=current_delta,
2435                    current_delta=current_delta,
2436                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
2437                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
2438                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
2439                    provider_execution=impl_res,
2440                    failure_class=failure_class,
2441                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
2442                    failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
2443                        implementation_attempts,
2444                        termination_reason,
2445                        last_selection_decision,
2446                    ),
2447                )
2448
2449            def govern_candidate() -> Dict[str, Any]:
2450                """Preserves the current attempt's delta as a governed candidate.
2451
2452                Reads the attempt-scoped locals at call time, the same way
2453                fail_implementation does, so both terminal exits salvage
2454                identically.
2455                """
2456                captured = self._capture_timeout_candidate(
2457                    run_dir=run_dir,
2458                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2459                    attempt_record=attempt_record,
2460                    task_spec=task_spec,
2461                    resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2462                    delta=current_delta,
2463                )
2464                self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
2465                return captured
2466
2467            def promote_retained_fallback() -> Optional[str]:
2468                """Recovers a retained fallback at a terminal exit.
2469
2470                Reads the attempt-scoped locals at call time, exactly like
2471                fail_implementation and govern_candidate, so all three terminal
2472                exits salvage identically instead of repeating the sequence.
2473                Returns the producing resource, or None to fail as before.
2474                """
2475                nonlocal timeout_candidate, current_delta
2476                promoted = self._promote_retained_salvage(
2477                    run_dir=run_dir,
2478                    attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2479                    task_spec=task_spec,
2480                    baseline=baseline,
2481                    current_delta=current_delta,
2482                    attempt_record=attempt_record,
2483                )
2484                if promoted is None:
2485                    return None
2486                timeout_candidate, producer, current_delta = promoted
2487                self._record_delta_captured(task_spec, current_delta)
2488                return producer
2489
2490            for attempt_num in range(1, self.config.max_provider_failover_attempts + 1):
2491                impl_res = None
2492                normalized_failure = None
2493
2494                impl_backend = self._resolve_backend(current_impl_resource_id)
2495
2496                if not impl_backend.is_available():
2497                    impl_res = AgentExecutionResult(
2498                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2499                        role="implementation",
2500                        command=f"backend:{current_impl_resource_id}",
2501                        exit_code=127,
2502                        stdout="",
2503                        stderr=f"Agent binary '{current_impl_resource_id}' is not installed or available on PATH.",
2504                        duration_seconds=0.0,
2505                        success=False,
2506                        error_message=f"Agent '{current_impl_resource_id}' unavailable",
2507                    )
2508                else:
2509                    if task_spec.current_state != "implementing":
2510                        task_spec.transition_to(
2511                            "implementing",
2512                            f"Launching implementation attempt {attempt_num}: {current_impl_resource_id}",
2513                        )
2514                        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2515
2516                    task_spec.actual_agent = current_impl_resource_id
2517                    task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
2518
2519                    self._record_event(
2520                        task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2521                        agent_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2522                        action="implementation_started",
2523                        spec=task_spec,
2524                        metadata={"attempt": attempt_num},
2525                    )
2526
2527                    attempt_scratch = self._provider_scratch_dir(
2528                        run_dir, attempt_num, current_impl_resource_id
2529                    )
2530                    attempt_scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2531                    self._record_scratch_manifest(
2532                        run_dir,
2533                        task_spec.task_id,
2534                        attempt_num,
2535                        current_impl_resource_id,
2536                        attempt_scratch,
2537                        status="active",
2538                    )
2539                    evidence_root_before = {
2540                        entry.name for entry in run_dir.iterdir()
2541                    }
2542                    attempts_before = {
2543                        entry.name for entry in attempts_dir.iterdir()
2544                    } if attempts_dir.is_dir() else set()
2545
2546                    impl_agent_id = getattr(impl_backend, "agent_id", None) or current_impl_resource_id
2547                    with progress.operation(
2548                        phase=TaskPhase.IMPLEMENTING,
2549                        resource_id=impl_agent_id,
2550                        role="implementation",
2551                        details="started",
2552                        suppress_completion=True,
2553                    ):
2554                        impl_res = impl_backend.execute(
2555                            task=task_spec,
2556                            cwd=self.target_repo,
2557                            role="implementation",
2558                            prompt_override=impl_prompt,
2559                            timeout_seconds=self.config.timeout_seconds,
2560                        )
2561
2562                # Relocate provider scratch before any evidence for this
2563                # attempt is written, so control-plane artifacts can never be
2564                # mistaken for files the provider left behind.
2565                if impl_backend.is_available():
2566                    swept = self._sweep_provider_scratch(
2567                        run_dir=run_dir,
2568                        resource_id=current_impl_resource_id,
2569                        attempt_num=attempt_num,
2570                        known_before=evidence_root_before,
2571                        attempts_dir=attempts_dir,
2572                        attempts_before=attempts_before,
2573                        owned_attempt_name=(
2574                            f"{attempt_num:02d}-{current_impl_resource_id}"
2575                        ),
2576                    )
2577                    if swept:
2578                        self._record_event(
2579                            task_id=task_spec.task_id,

3137                        f"{role}: {res.status}"
3138                        for role, res in sorted(cycle_res.reviewer_results.items())
3139                        if res.status == "reviewer_failure"
3140                    )
3141                if not triggers:
3142                    triggers.append("unresolved_findings")
3143                    risks.append("Unresolved reviewer findings may indicate defects or security vulnerabilities.")
3144
3145                decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
3146                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3147                    objective=task_spec.objective,
3148                    change_summary=(
3149                        f"Implementation diff ({current_delta.insertions} ins, {current_delta.deletions} del) "
3150                        f"reached the remediation limit; triggers: {', '.join(triggers)}."
3151                    ),
3152                    boundary_triggers=triggers,
3153                    evidence=evidence,
3154                    risks=risks,
3155                    review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
3156                    verification_status="unverified",
3157                    recommended_action="Review finding report in reconciliation_report.md and authorize override or manual remediation.",
3158                )
3159                self._park_awaiting_human(
3160                    task_spec,
3161                    run_dir,
3162                    f"Max remediation cycles exceeded: {err_msg}",
3163                    decision_pkt,
3164                    progress,
3165                )
3166                return self._make_result(
3167                    task_spec=task_spec,
3168                    final_state="awaiting_human",
3169                    exit_code=2,
3170                    start_time=start_time,
3171                    run_dir=run_dir,
3172                    routing=routing,
3173                    initial_delta=initial_delta,
3174                    current_delta=current_delta,
3175                    review_cycles=review_cycles,
3176                    reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3177                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
3178                    remediation_count=remediation_count,
3179                    err_msg=err_msg,
3180                    provider_execution=impl_res,
3181                    failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED,
3182                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3183                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3184                    implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3185                    failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
3186                        implementation_attempts,
3187                        TERMINATION_IMPLEMENTATION_SUCCEEDED,
3188                        last_selection_decision,
3189                    ),
3190                )
3191
3192            remediation_count += 1
3193            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3194                run_dir,
3195                task_spec.task_id,
3196                "remediating",
3197                repo_path=self.target_repo,
3198                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count},
3199            )
3200
3201            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3202                self.config.failure_injection_hook("remediating", run_dir, task_spec)
3203
3204            task_spec.transition_to(
3205                "remediating",
3206                f"Remediation cycle {remediation_count}: resolving {len(cycle_res.all_findings)} review findings",
3207            )
3208            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3209
3210            self._record_event(
3211                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3212                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
3213                action="remediation_started",
3214                spec=task_spec,
3215                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "findings_count": len(cycle_res.all_findings)},
3216            )
3217
3218            rem_cycle_dir = remediation_base_dir / f"cycle-{remediation_count:02d}"
3219            rem_cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
3220
3221            rem_resource_id = (
3222                final_impl_resource_id or routing.selected_agent_id
3223            )
3224            rem_backend = self._resolve_backend(rem_resource_id)
3225            rem_agent_id = getattr(rem_backend, "agent_id", None) or rem_resource_id
3226            with progress.operation(
3227                phase=TaskPhase.REMEDIATING,
3228                resource_id=rem_agent_id,
3229                role="remediation",
3230                cycle=remediation_count,
3231                details=f"cycle {remediation_count}",
3232            ):
3233                if self.config.custom_remediation_fn:
3234                    self.config.custom_remediation_fn(task_spec, self.target_repo, cycle_res.all_findings)
3235                else:
3236                    rem_prompt = self._build_remediation_prompt(task_spec, current_delta.diff_content, cycle_res.all_findings)
3237                    rem_res = rem_backend.execute(
3238                        task=task_spec,
3239                        cwd=self.target_repo,
3240                        role="remediation",
3241                        prompt_override=rem_prompt,
3242                        timeout_seconds=self.config.timeout_seconds,
3243                    )
3244                    (rem_cycle_dir / "result.json").write_text(rem_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
3245
3246            current_delta = self._capture_scoped_delta(
3247                task_spec, baseline, routing.selected_agent_id, stage="remediation"
3248            )
3249            self._write_delta_patch(current_delta, rem_cycle_dir, run_dir)
3250
3251            self._record_event(
3252                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3253                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
3254                action="remediation_completed",
3255                spec=task_spec,
3256                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "files_modified": len(current_delta.files_modified)},
3257            )
3258            self._record_delta_captured(task_spec)
3259            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
3260                run_dir,
3261                "remediating",
3262                output_artifacts=[str(rem_cycle_dir / "diff.patch")],
3263            )
3264
3265            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3266                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_remediation", run_dir, task_spec)
3267
3268            current_reviewers = ReviewRunner.determine_re_review_roles(
3269                cycle_res.all_findings,
3270                routing.recommended_reviewers,
3271            )
3272            task_spec.transition_to("reviewing", f"Re-review cycle {remediation_count + 1} for targeted roles: {current_reviewers}")
3273            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3274
3275        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3276        # Stage 6: Deterministic Verification Gate (verifying)
3277        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3278        if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
3279            self.config.failure_injection_hook("verifying", run_dir, task_spec)
3280
3281        # The same gate the resume path runs, called rather than restated, so a
3282        # task verified after a pre-verification escalation and a task verified
3283        # in one pass cannot reach different conclusions from the same evidence
3284        # (issues.md #12).
3285        verif_status = self.run_deterministic_verification(
3286            task_spec,
3287            run_dir=run_dir,
3288            progress=progress,
3289            verif_plan=verif_plan,
3290            baseline=baseline,
3291            delta=current_delta,
3292        )
3293        verif_summary = {s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps}
3294        if verif_status != "passed":
3295            failed_steps = [s.name for s in verif_plan.steps if s.status == "failed" and s.required]
3296            err_msg = f"Deterministic verification failed on required steps: {', '.join(failed_steps)}"
3297            # A salvaged candidate only ever existed on sufferance. Governance
3298            # has now rejected it, so the repository goes back to its pre-task
3299            # baseline rather than keeping a patch nothing stands behind. A
3300            # provider-attested implementation still keeps its diff in place for
3301            # inspection, as before.
3302            if timeout_candidate is not None and not current_delta.is_empty:
3303                restored_ok, restore_err = restore_repository_to_baseline(
3304                    self.target_repo, baseline, current_delta
3305                )
3306                self._record_event(
3307                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3308                    agent_id="control_plane",
3309                    action="timeout_candidate_rejected",
3310                    spec=task_spec,
3311                    metadata={
3312                        "stage": "verifying",
3313                        "origin": CANDIDATE_ORIGIN_TIMED_OUT,
3314                        "rollback_restored": restored_ok,
3315                        "rollback_error": restore_err,
3316                        "failed_steps": failed_steps,
3317                    },
3318                )
3319                if not restored_ok:
3320                    err_msg = (
3321                        f"{err_msg}. Repository could not be restored to baseline "
3322                        f"({restore_err}); candidate changes remain."
3323                    )
3324            return self._fail_task(
3325                task_spec,
3326                run_dir,
3327                err_msg,
3328                start_time,
3329                exit_code=1,
3330                progress_tracker=progress,
3331                stage="verifying",
3332                routing=routing,
3333                initial_delta=initial_delta,
3334                current_delta=current_delta,
3335                review_cycles=review_cycles,
3336                reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3337                verif_plan=verif_plan,
3338                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3339                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3340                remediation_count=remediation_count,
3341                provider_execution=impl_res,
3342                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_VERIFICATION,
3343                timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
3344            )
3345
3346        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3347        # Stage 7: Human Authority Boundary Gate (awaiting_human)
3348        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3349        actions_to_check = list(planned_actions or [])
3350        if any(kw in task_spec.objective.lower() for kw in ["deploy", "terraform apply", "kubectl apply", "drop table"]):
3351            actions_to_check.append(task_spec.objective)
3352
3353        boundary_res = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate(
3354            task=task_spec,
3355            planned_actions=actions_to_check,
3356            change_summary=f"Changed {len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added)} files (+{current_delta.insertions}/-{current_delta.deletions})",
3357            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3358            verification=verif_plan,
3359            non_independent_roles=sorted(
3360                {role for cyc in review_cycles for role in cyc.non_independent_roles}
3361            ),
3362        )
3363
3364        stage_kwargs = dict(
3365            start_time=start_time,
3366            run_dir=run_dir,
3367            routing=routing,
3368            initial_delta=initial_delta,
3369            current_delta=current_delta,
3370            review_cycles=review_cycles,
3371            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
3372            verif_plan=verif_plan,
3373            boundary_res=boundary_res,
3374            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3375            hf_match=hf_audit_match,
3376            remediation_count=remediation_count,
3377            provider_execution=impl_res,
3378            implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts,
3379            failover_summary=self._build_failover_summary(
3380                implementation_attempts,
3381                TERMINATION_IMPLEMENTATION_SUCCEEDED
3382                if timeout_candidate is None
3383                else TERMINATION_TIMEOUT_CANDIDATE_GOVERNED,
3384                last_selection_decision,
3385            ),
3386            timeout_candidate=timeout_candidate,
3387        )
3388
3389        if boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
3390            progress.record_terminal(
3391                TaskProgressState.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
3392                TaskPhase.AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION,
3393            )
3394            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3395                run_dir,
3396                task_spec.task_id,
3397                "awaiting_human",
3398                repo_path=self.target_repo,
3399                metadata={"boundary_triggers": boundary_res.triggered_boundaries},
3400            )
3401            task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", f"Human authority boundary triggered: {boundary_res.triggered_boundaries}")
3402            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3403
3404            if boundary_res.decision_packet:
3405                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(boundary_res.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
3406
3407            self._record_human_boundary_events(
3408                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=boundary_res.triggered_boundaries
3409            )
3410
3411            return self._make_result(
3412                task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2,
3413                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED, **stage_kwargs,
3414            )
3415
3416        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3417        # Stage 8: Governed Completion (complete)
3418        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
3419        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
3420            run_dir,
3421            task_spec.task_id,
3422            "complete",
3423            repo_path=self.target_repo,
3424        )
3425        task_spec.transition_to("complete", "All reviews, reconciliations, deterministic verifications, and policies passed.")
3426        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3427
3428        # The one place acceptance becomes true. Everything before this point
3429        # survived review, reconciliation, deterministic verification and the
3430        # human authority boundary; only now is there an accepted implementer.
3431        if final_impl_resource_id is not None:
3432            self._persist_effective_route(
3433                routing,
3434                task_spec,
3435                final_impl_resource_id,
3436                ROUTE_STATUS_SUPERSEDED
3437                if final_impl_resource_id != routing.metadata.get(
3438                    "initial_implementation_resource", routing.selected_agent_id
3439                )
3440                else ROUTE_STATUS_ACCEPTED,
3441                accepted=True,
3442                # Acceptance does not erase how the work arrived. A candidate
3443                # that cleared governance is still a candidate in provenance.
3444                candidate_resource=(
3445                    final_impl_resource_id if timeout_candidate else None
3446                ),
3447                # Acceptance names an accepted implementer; it does not
3448                # retroactively make a promoted fallback the last resource that
3449                # was actually attempted.
3450                last_attempted_resource_id=salvage_last_attempted_id,
3451            )
3452
3453        # Generate summary markdown
3454        summary_md = self._render_summary_markdown(
3455            task=task_spec,
3456            routing=routing,
3457            delta=current_delta,
3458            review_cycles=review_cycles,
3459            verif_plan=verif_plan,
3460            remediation_count=remediation_count,
3461            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
3462        )
3463        (run_dir / "summary.md").write_text(summary_md, encoding="utf-8")
3464
3465        self._record_event(
3466            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3467            agent_id="control_plane",
3468            action="task_completed",
3469            spec=task_spec,
3470            metadata={
3471                "remediation_cycles": remediation_count,
3472                "verification_status": verif_status,
3473                "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
3474            },
3475        )
3476        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
3477            run_dir,
3478            "complete",
3479            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "summary.md")],
3480        )
3481
3482        progress.record_terminal(
3483            TaskProgressState.COMPLETE,
3484            TaskPhase.COMPLETE,
3485        )
3486        self._prune_ephemeral_scratch(run_dir, task_spec.task_id)
3487        return self._make_result(task_spec, "complete", 0, **stage_kwargs)
3488
3489    def _record_human_boundary_events(
3490        self,
3491        task_spec: TaskSpec,
3492        run_dir: Path,
3493        boundaries: Optional[List[str]] = None,
3494        reason: Optional[str] = None,
3495    ) -> None:
3496        meta = {"boundaries": boundaries} if boundaries else {"reason": reason}
3497        self._record_event(

3501            artifact=str(run_dir / "decision_packet.md"),
3502            spec=task_spec,
3503            metadata=meta,

3505        self._record_event(
3506            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3507            agent_id="control_plane",
3508            action="human_boundary_triggered",
3509            spec=task_spec,
3510            metadata=meta,
3511        )

3513    def _make_result(
3514        self,
3515        task_spec: TaskSpec,
3516        final_state: str,
3517        exit_code: int,
3518        start_time: float,
3519        run_dir: Path,
3520        routing: Optional[Any] = None,
3521        initial_delta: Optional[Any] = None,
3522        current_delta: Optional[Any] = None,
3523        review_cycles: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
3524        reconciliation: Optional[Any] = None,
3525        verif_plan: Optional[Any] = None,
3526        boundary_res: Optional[Any] = None,
3527        hf_status: Optional[str] = None,
3528        hf_match: Optional[bool] = None,
3529        remediation_count: int = 0,
3530        err_msg: Optional[str] = None,
3531        provider_execution: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None,
3532        failure_class: Optional[str] = None,
3533        implementation_attempts: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
3534        failover_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
3535        timeout_candidate: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
3536    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
3537        return OrchestrationResult(
3538            implementation_completion_claim=timeout_candidate is None,
3539            candidate_origin=(
3540                timeout_candidate.get("origin") if timeout_candidate else None
3541            ),
3542            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3543            task_spec=task_spec,
3544            final_state=final_state,
3545            exit_code=exit_code,
3546            routing_decision=routing,
3547            initial_delta=initial_delta,
3548            final_delta=current_delta,
3549            review_cycles=review_cycles or [],
3550            reconciliation=reconciliation,
3551            verification_plan=verif_plan,
3552            boundary_result=boundary_res,
3553            howlframe_audit_status=hf_status,
3554            howlframe_audit_match=hf_match,
3555            remediation_cycles_count=remediation_count,
3556            duration_seconds=round(time.time() - start_time, 3),
3557            error_message=err_msg,
3558            run_dir=str(run_dir),
3559            provider_execution=provider_execution,
3560            failure_class=failure_class,
3561            resource_selection=(
3562                routing.metadata.get("resource_selection")
3563                if routing is not None else None
3564            ),
3565            capacity_after=(
3566                self.config.provider_pool.get_all_statuses()
3567                if self.config.provider_pool is not None else {}
3568            ),
3569            implementation_attempts=implementation_attempts or [],
3570            failover_summary=failover_summary,
3571        )

3573    def _fail_task(
3574        self,
3575        task_spec: TaskSpec,
3576        run_dir: Path,
3577        err_msg: str,
3578        start_time: float,
3579        exit_code: int = 1,
3580        agent_id: str = "control_plane",
3581        progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None,
3582        **kwargs,
3583    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
3584        # Capture the original active stage identity BEFORE modifying task_spec state
3585        active_stage = kwargs.pop("stage", None)
3586        if not active_stage or active_stage in ("failed", "cancelled"):
3587            active_stage = task_spec.current_state
3588        if not active_stage or active_stage in ("failed", "cancelled"):
3589            latest_chk = CheckpointManager.load_latest_checkpoint(run_dir)
3590            if latest_chk and latest_chk.stage not in ("failed", "cancelled"):
3591                active_stage = latest_chk.stage
3592
3593        # Terminalize current stage checkpoint so it does not remain permanently in_progress
3594        try:
3595            delta = kwargs.get("current_delta") or kwargs.get("initial_delta")
3596            summary: Dict[str, Any] = {
3597                "error": err_msg,
3598                "exit_code": exit_code,
3599            }
3600            if kwargs.get("failure_class"):
3601                summary["failure_class"] = kwargs.get("failure_class")
3602            if delta is not None:
3603                summary.update(delta.to_event_metadata())
3604                summary["partial_work"] = not delta.is_empty
3605            CheckpointManager.fail_stage(
3606                run_dir,
3607                stage=active_stage,
3608                reason=err_msg,
3609                result_summary=summary,
3610            )
3611        except Exception:
3612            pass
3613
3614        if progress_tracker is not None:
3615            progress_tracker.record_terminal(
3616                TaskProgressState.FAILED,
3617                TaskPhase.FAILED,
3618                error_message=err_msg,
3619            )
3620        task_spec.transition_to("failed", err_msg)
3621        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
3622
3623        self._record_event(
3624            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
3625            agent_id=agent_id,
3626            action="task_failed",
3627            result=err_msg,
3628            spec=task_spec,
3629        )
3630        self._prune_ephemeral_scratch(run_dir, task_spec.task_id)
3631        return self._make_result(
3632            task_spec=task_spec,
3633            final_state="failed",
3634            exit_code=exit_code,
3635            start_time=start_time,
3636            run_dir=run_dir,
3637            err_msg=err_msg,
3638            **kwargs,
3639        )
3640
3641    def _build_implementation_prompt(
3642        self,
3643        task: TaskSpec,
3644        ctx: Optional[ProjectContext] = None,
3645    ) -> str:
3646        """Constructs an implementation prompt with criteria and skill guidance."""
3647        lines = [
3648            f"# Task Implementation Request: `{task.task_id}`",
3649            f"**Objective:** {task.objective}",
3650            "",
3651            "## Acceptance Criteria",
3652        ]
3653        for c in task.acceptance_criteria:
3654            lines.append(f"- {c}")
3655        if task.constraints:
3656            lines.append("")
3657            lines.append("## Constraints")
3658            for c in task.constraints:
3659                lines.append(f"- {c}")
3660        if task.required_skills:
3661            lines.append("")
3662            lines.append("## Required Skills")
3663            for s in task.required_skills:
3664                lines.append(f"- {s}")
3665        lines.append("")
3666        lines.append("## Workspace")
3667        lines.append(
3668            f"- Scratch files belong in `{self._attempt_workspace_hint(task)}`."
3669        )
3670        lines.append(
3671            f"- Everything else under `.task_runs/{task.task_id}/` is "
3672            "control-plane evidence. Do not create or edit files there."
3673        )
3674        if "howlframe-app-development" in (task.required_skills or []):
3675            lines.append("")
3676            lines.append("## HowlFrame Application Guidance")
3677            lines.append("- Build & test commands: `bash scripts/build.sh`, `bash scripts/test.sh`")
3678            lines.append("- Standalone bytecode VM runs under capability gates (`network,database,filesystem`).")
3679            lines.append("- Single root form (`http_server`, `web_app`, `cli_app`, or `module`) per `.howl` file.")
3680            lines.append("- Handle fallible parsing/io using `try_let`.")
3681        return "\n".join(lines)
3682
3683    def _build_remediation_prompt(
3684        self,
3685        task: TaskSpec,
3686        diff_content: str,
3687        findings: List[ReviewFinding],
3688    ) -> str:
3689        """Constructs an actionable remediation prompt with confirmed defect evidence."""
3690        lines = [
3691            f"# Remediation Request for Task `{task.task_id}`",
3692            f"**Objective:** {task.objective}",
3693            "",
3694            "## Identified Defects to Remediate",
3695        ]
3696        for f in findings:
3697            lines.append(f"### [{f.severity.upper()}] {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
3698            if f.location:
3699                lines.append(f"- **Location:** `{f.location}`")
3700            if f.claim:
3701                lines.append(f"- **Claim:** {f.claim}")
3702            if f.evidence:
3703                lines.append(f"- **Evidence / Failure Case:** {f.evidence}")
3704            if f.suggested_fix:
3705                lines.append(f"- **Suggested Fix:** {f.suggested_fix}")
3706            lines.append("")
3707
3708        lines.extend([
3709            "## Current Implementation Diff",
3710            "```diff",
3711            diff_content,
3712            "```",
3713            "",
3714            "## Instructions",
3715            "Fix the reported defects in the repository. Ensure all edge cases and tests pass.",
3716        ])
3717        return "\n".join(lines)

3719    def _render_summary_markdown(
3720        self,
3721        task: TaskSpec,
3722        routing: RoutingDecision,
3723        delta: RepositoryDelta,
3724        review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult],
3725        verif_plan: VerificationPlan,
3726        remediation_count: int,
3727        hf_status: Optional[str],
3728    ) -> str:
3729        # One authoritative answer, not a per-line re-derivation. `actual_agent`
3730        # mirrors the effective implementer once implementation settles; the
3731        # explicit field wins where both exist (issues.md #16).
3732        implementer_id = (
3733            task.effective_implementer_resource_id
3734            or task.actual_agent
3735            or routing.selected_agent_id
3736        )
3737        lines = [
3738            f"# Governed Task Run Summary: `{task.task_id}`",
3739            "",
3740            "## Overview",
3741            f"- **Objective:** {task.objective}",
3742            f"- **Repository:** {self.target_repo.name}",
3743            f"- **Final State:** `{task.current_state.upper()}`",
3744            f"- **Implementing Agent:** {implementer_id} (`{implementer_id}`)",
3745            f"- **Reasoning Tier:** {routing.reasoning_tier}",
3746            f"- **HowlFrame Shadow Audit:** {hf_status or 'N/A'}",
3747            "",
3748        ]
3749        if implementer_id and implementer_id != routing.selected_agent_id:
3750            lines.append(f"- **Initial Route:** {routing.selected_agent_name} (`{routing.selected_agent_id}`)")
3751            lines.append("")
3752        lines.extend([
3753            "## Repository Changes",
3754            f"- **Files Added:** {len(delta.files_added)}",
3755            f"- **Files Modified:** {len(delta.files_modified)}",
3756            f"- **Files Deleted:** {len(delta.files_deleted)}",
3757            f"- **Total Insertions:** +{delta.insertions}",
3758            f"- **Total Deletions:** -{delta.deletions}",
3759            "",
3760            "## Review & Remediation",
3761            f"- **Total Review Cycles:** {len(review_cycles)}",
3762            f"- **Remediation Cycles:** {remediation_count}",
3763        ])
3764        if review_cycles:
3765            last_cycle = review_cycles[-1]
3766            lines.append(f"- **Final Review Status:** `{last_cycle.status}`")
3767            for role, res in sorted(last_cycle.reviewer_results.items()):
3768                lines.append(f"  - `{role}`: {res.status} ({len(res.findings)} findings)")
3769
3770        lines.extend([
3771            "",
3772            "## Deterministic Verification",
3773            f"- **Overall Status:** `{verif_plan.overall_status.upper()}`",
3774        ])
3775        executed_steps = [
3776            s for s in verif_plan.steps
3777            if s.exit_code is not None or s.status in ("verified", "failed")
3778        ]
3779        if not executed_steps and verif_plan.steps:
3780            lines.append(f"- **Discovered:** {len(verif_plan.steps)} steps (not executed — implementation failed before verification)")
3781        for step in verif_plan.steps:
3782            if step.exit_code is not None or step.status in ("verified", "failed"):
3783                mark = "✓" if step.status == "verified" else "✗"
3784                lines.append(f"- [{mark}] **{step.name}** (`{step.category}`): {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code})")
3785            else:
3786                lines.append(f"- [ ] **{step.name}** (`{step.category}`): {step.status}")
3787
3788        lines.extend([
3789            "",
3790            "---",
3791            "*Verified and sealed by HowlPlane AI Engineering Control Plane.*",
3792        ])
3793        return "\n".join(lines)

Drives the end-to-end governed engineering lifecycle, maintaining strict control over state transitions, adversarial reviews, remediation loops, verification gates, and human authority boundaries.

def run_deterministic_verification( self, task_spec: TaskSpec, run_dir: Optional[pathlib.Path] = None, progress: Optional[Any] = None, verif_plan: Optional[VerificationPlan] = None, baseline: Optional[GitBaseline] = None, delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta] = None) -> str: 
1614    def run_deterministic_verification(
1615        self,
1616        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1617        run_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
1618        progress: Optional[Any] = None,
1619        verif_plan: Optional[VerificationPlan] = None,
1620        baseline: Optional[GitBaseline] = None,
1621        delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta] = None,
1622    ) -> str:
1623        """Executes the deterministic verification plan for settled work.
1624
1625        The Stage 6 gate is reachable only by running the whole loop from the
1626        top, which re-invokes providers. A task that escalated to
1627        `awaiting_human` before Stage 6 already has its implementation, its
1628        reviews and its plan on disk; what it never had was the gate. This runs
1629        exactly that gate against the same sanitized view Stage 6 uses, and
1630        persists the same evidence.
1631
1632        Idempotent: a plan whose `overall_status` is already terminal is
1633        returned unchanged rather than re-executed, so a repeated resume cannot
1634        turn a recorded failure into a fresh pass (issues.md #12).
1635
1636        Returns the plan's overall status. Never transitions the task to
1637        `complete` -- that is the caller's policy decision.
1638        """
1639        run_dir = run_dir or (self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id)
1640        if verif_plan is None:
1641            plan_file = run_dir / "verification_plan.json"
1642            if not plan_file.is_file():
1643                raise VerificationPlanMissingError(
1644                    f"Task '{task_spec.task_id}' has no verification_plan.json at "
1645                    f"{plan_file}. Deterministic verification cannot be claimed "
1646                    f"for a plan that does not exist."
1647                )
1648            verif_plan = VerificationPlan.from_dict(safe_load_json(plan_file))
1649            if verif_plan.overall_status in TERMINAL_VERIFICATION_STATUSES:
1650                return verif_plan.overall_status
1651
1652        if baseline is None:
1653            baseline_file = run_dir / "baseline.json"
1654            if baseline_file.is_file():
1655                baseline = GitBaseline.from_dict(safe_load_json(baseline_file))
1656            else:
1657                baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
1658        if delta is None:
1659            delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
1660
1661        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
1662            run_dir,
1663            task_spec.task_id,
1664            "verifying",
1665            repo_path=self.target_repo,
1666            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "diff.patch")],
1667        )
1668        if task_spec.current_state != "verifying":
1669            task_spec.transition_to(
1670                "verifying",
1671                "Human approval authorized the governed workflow to continue; "
1672                "executing the deterministic verification plan that the "
1673                "pre-verification escalation skipped.",
1674            )
1675            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1676
1677        self._record_event(
1678            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1679            agent_id="control_plane",
1680            action="verification_started",
1681            spec=task_spec,
1682            metadata={
1683                "steps_count": len(verif_plan.steps),
1684                "trigger": "resume_after_pre_verification_escalation",
1685            },
1686        )
1687
1688        verif_status = self._execute_verification_plan(
1689            verif_plan=verif_plan,
1690            task_spec=task_spec,
1691            baseline=baseline,
1692            delta=delta,
1693            run_dir=run_dir,
1694            progress=progress,
1695        )
1696
1697        plan_json = verif_plan.to_json()
1698        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(plan_json, encoding="utf-8")
1699        (run_dir / "verification_result.json").write_text(plan_json, encoding="utf-8")
1700
1701        self._record_event(
1702            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1703            agent_id="control_plane",
1704            action="verification_completed",
1705            spec=task_spec,
1706            result=verif_status,
1707            verification_summary={s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps},
1708        )
1709        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
1710            run_dir,
1711            "verifying",
1712            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "verification_result.json")],
1713            result_summary={s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps},
1714        )
1715        return verif_status

Executes the deterministic verification plan for settled work.

The Stage 6 gate is reachable only by running the whole loop from the top, which re-invokes providers. A task that escalated to awaiting_human before Stage 6 already has its implementation, its reviews and its plan on disk; what it never had was the gate. This runs exactly that gate against the same sanitized view Stage 6 uses, and persists the same evidence.

Idempotent: a plan whose overall_status is already terminal is returned unchanged rather than re-executed, so a repeated resume cannot turn a recorded failure into a fresh pass (issues.md #12).

Returns the plan's overall status. Never transitions the task to complete -- that is the caller's policy decision.

def prepare_task_plan( self, task_spec: TaskSpec, planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, pathlib.Path, Optional[Any]]: 
1952    def prepare_task_plan(
1953        self,
1954        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1955        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
1956    ) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, Path, Optional[Any]]:
1957        """Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs."""
1958        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
1959        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1960        (run_dir / "reviews").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1961        (run_dir / "remediation").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1962
1963        ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(self.target_repo)
1964        (run_dir / "project_context.json").write_text(ctx.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1965
1966        router = TaskRouter(resource_pool=self.config.provider_pool)
1967        routing = router.route(task_spec)
1968        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "route.json", asdict(routing))
1969        atomic_write_json(run_dir / "initial_route.json", asdict(routing))
1970
1971        verif_plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id=task_spec.task_id)
1972        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1973
1974        task_spec.recommended_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
1975        task_spec.actual_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
1976        task_spec.is_override = routing.is_override
1977        task_spec.override_reason = routing.rationale if routing.is_override else None
1978        if task_spec.current_state == "discovered":
1979            task_spec.transition_to("planned", "Task routed and verification plan generated")
1980        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1981        skill_ctx = build_skill_context(task_spec)
1982        for role_id in routing.recommended_reviewers:
1983            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
1984            if role:
1985                (run_dir / "reviews" / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(
1986                    role.render_brief(task=task_spec, diff_content="", context=skill_ctx), encoding="utf-8"
1987                )
1988        (run_dir / "findings_template.yaml").write_text("# Review Findings Template\nfindings: []\n", encoding="utf-8")
1989
1990        hf_res = None
1991        if self.config.enable_howlframe_audit:
1992            try:
1993                hf_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(
1994                    context=ctx,
1995                    record_evidence=self.config.record_evidence,
1996                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1997                    ledger=self.ledger,
1998                    dogfood_mode="shadow",
1999                )
2000                (run_dir / "howlframe_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(hf_res.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
2001            except Exception:
2002                pass
2003
2004        # Check pre-execution human authority boundary and bind HowlChangeOps decision if applicable
2005        pre_b = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
2006            task=task_spec,
2007            planned_actions=planned_actions,
2008            target_repo=self.target_repo,
2009        )
2010        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_b, run_dir)
2011        if pre_b.requires_human_approval and pre_b.decision_packet:
2012            (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(pre_b.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
2013
2014        return ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res

Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs.

def run( self, task_spec: TaskSpec, planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None, lock_ownership: Optional[src.control_plane.locking.LockOwnership] = None) -> OrchestrationResult: 
2041    def run(
2042        self,
2043        task_spec: TaskSpec,
2044        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
2045        lock_ownership: Optional[LockOwnership] = None,
2046    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
2047        """
2048        Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under
2049        mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.
2050
2051        `lock_ownership` is the task-lock token of an outer lifecycle that
2052        already owns this run -- `ai resume` holds the task lock across the
2053        whole recovery, then hands it here. Without it a resumed run would
2054        deadlock against itself (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
2055        """
2056        start_time = time.time()
2057        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
2058
2059        # Setup Progress Tracker
2060        progress = self.config.progress_tracker
2061        if progress is None:
2062            enabled = (self.config.progress_mode != "never")
2063            stream = (
2064                self.config.progress_stream
2065                if self.config.progress_stream is not None
2066                else sys.stderr
2067            )
2068            progress = TaskProgressTracker(
2069                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2070                run_dir=run_dir,
2071                stream=stream,
2072                heartbeat_interval=self.config.heartbeat_interval,
2073                enabled=enabled,
2074            )
2075
2076        # Every acquisition below is registered for release the moment it
2077        # succeeds. Previously the repo lock was taken before the task lock but
2078        # outside the try/finally, so a task-lock failure stranded
2079        # `.git/howlplane.lock` and no later run could proceed
2080        # (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06). Progress starts only once the locks are held,
2081        # so a resume that cannot acquire never overwrites the durable
2082        # progress record of the run it was trying to recover.
2083        with ExitStack() as stack:
2084            if self.config.acquire_locks:
2085                repo_lock = RepoLock(
2086                    self.target_repo,
2087                    task_spec.task_id,
2088                    command=f"ai work {task_spec.task_id} --execute",
2089                )
2090                repo_lock.acquire()
2091                stack.callback(repo_lock.release)
2092                self._fault("after_repo_lock", run_dir, task_spec)
2093
2094                task_lock = TaskLock(
2095                    self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, operation="orchestrate"
2096                )
2097                task_lock.acquire(lock_ownership)
2098                stack.callback(task_lock.release)
2099                self._fault("after_task_lock", run_dir, task_spec)
2100
2101            progress.start(
2102                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
2103                run_dir=run_dir,
2104                initial_phase=TaskPhase.PREPARING.value,
2105            )
2106            stack.callback(progress.close)
2107            self._fault("after_progress_start", run_dir, task_spec)
2108
2109            try:
2110                result = self._run_governed_loop(
2111                    task_spec, planned_actions, start_time, progress=progress
2112                )
2113                if self.trajectory_store is not None:
2114                    traj = ExecutionTrajectoryBuilder.from_orchestration_result(result)
2115                    self.trajectory_store.save(traj)
2116                    result.trajectory_id = traj.trajectory_id
2117                return result
2118            except Exception as exc:
2119                progress.record_terminal(
2120                    TaskProgressState.FAILED,
2121                    TaskPhase.FAILED,
2122                    error_message=str(exc),
2123                )
2124                raise

Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.

lock_ownership is the task-lock token of an outer lifecycle that already owns this run -- ai resume holds the task lock across the whole recovery, then hands it here. Without it a resumed run would deadlock against itself (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).

215    # in deterministic tests to inject per-resource fake backends.

217    # Enables bounded reviewer failover (#59.2 Phase 4) in the governed review
218    # cycle: a reviewer whose assigned provider fails, times out, or emits
219    # invalid/malformed output gets one alternate-provider attempt instead of
220    # immediately blocking the task. Sharing the caller's pool means review
221    # quota exhaustion updates the same provider state implementation failover
222    # reads (#59.2 Phase 9). Left None (the default) by callers that inject a
223    # custom_backend/custom_reviewer_fn, which keeps deterministic tests on the
224    # prior single-attempt path.
225    provider_pool: Optional[Any] = None
226    heartbeat_interval: float = DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS
227    progress_stream: Optional[Any] = None
228    progress_mode: str = "auto"
229    progress_tracker: Optional[Any] = None

231    # to $HOWLPLANE_SCRATCH_ROOT or $XDG_CACHE_HOME/howlplane/scratch (~/.cache).
232    scratch_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
233    # Run deterministic gates against a sanitized view (baseline + task delta)
234    # instead of the live checkout, so untracked control plane evidence cannot
235    # change a verification result (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-07S).
236    verification_isolation: bool = True
