@dataclass
class OrchestrationResult: 
249@dataclass
250class OrchestrationResult:
251    """Complete result packet from governed task execution."""
252
253    task_id: str
254    task_spec: TaskSpec
255    final_state: str  # "complete", "awaiting_human", "failed", "blocked"
256    exit_code: int
257    routing_decision: Optional[RoutingDecision] = None
258    initial_delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta] = None
259    final_delta: Optional[RepositoryDelta] = None
260    review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult] = field(default_factory=list)
261    reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None
262    verification_plan: Optional[VerificationPlan] = None
263    boundary_result: Optional[BoundaryCheckResult] = None
264    howlframe_audit_status: Optional[str] = None
265    howlframe_audit_match: bool = True
266    remediation_cycles_count: int = 0
267    duration_seconds: float = 0.0
268    error_message: Optional[str] = None
269    run_dir: Optional[str] = None
270    # Structured provider evidence (#59.1 Phase 1). `provider_execution` is the
271    # verbatim implementation-role AgentExecutionResult -- exactly the type
272    # ProviderPoolManager.detect_exhaustion() consumes -- so a caller can tell a
273    # quota/session failure apart from bad generated code without parsing any
274    # human-readable summary text.
275    provider_execution: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
276    failure_class: Optional[str] = None
277    resource_selection: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
278    capacity_after: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
279    trajectory_id: Optional[str] = None
280    # Additive record of every implementation provider attempt, successful or not.
281    implementation_attempts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
282    # Why bounded failover stopped, and what was still eligible when it did.
283    failover_summary: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
284    # Whether the implementing provider actually reported completion. False for
285    # a candidate salvaged from a budget-stopped attempt, which reaches the same
286    # review and verification gates without ever being called a success
287    # (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
288    implementation_completion_claim: bool = True
289    candidate_origin: Optional[str] = None
290    schema: str = ORCHESTRATOR_SCHEMA_VERSION
291
292    @property
293    def executing_provider(self) -> Optional[str]:
294        """The provider that actually executed, from observed evidence."""
295        if self.provider_execution is not None:
296            return self.provider_execution.agent_id
297        return self.routing_decision.selected_agent_id if self.routing_decision else None
298

209class RoleBindingRegistry:
210    """Central declarative registry mapping domain roles to providers."""
211
212    def __init__(self) -> None:
213        self._bindings: Dict[Tuple[str, str], RoleBinding] = {}
214        self._descriptors: Dict[Tuple[str, str], RoleDescriptor] = {}
215
216    def register_descriptor(self, descriptor: RoleDescriptor) -> None:
217        key = (descriptor.domain.lower(), descriptor.role.lower())
218        self._descriptors[key] = descriptor
219
220    def register_binding(self, binding: RoleBinding) -> None:
221        key = (binding.domain.lower(), binding.role.lower())
222        self._bindings[key] = binding
223
224    def get_binding(self, domain: str, role: str) -> Optional[RoleBinding]:
225        key = (domain.lower(), role.lower())
226        return self._bindings.get(key)
227
228    def get_descriptor(
229        self, domain: str, role: str
230    ) -> Optional[RoleDescriptor]:
231        key = (domain.lower(), role.lower())
232        return self._descriptors.get(key)
233
234    def list_bindings(
235        self, domain: Optional[str] = None
236    ) -> List[RoleBinding]:
237        if domain is None:
238            return list(self._bindings.values())
239        return [
240            b for b in self._bindings.values()
241            if b.domain.lower() == domain.lower()
242        ]
243
244    def clear(self) -> None:
245        self._bindings.clear()
246        self._descriptors.clear()
247
248    def load_from_config(self, config_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
249        """Parses role bindings from config structure."""
250        roles_section = config_data.get("roles", {})
251        if not isinstance(roles_section, dict):
252            return
253
254        for domain_key, domain_val in roles_section.items():
255            if not isinstance(domain_val, dict):
256                continue
257            for role_key, role_spec in domain_val.items():
258                if isinstance(role_spec, str):
259                    # Shorthand: humanizer = "claude_code"
260                    self.register_binding(
261                        RoleBinding(
262                            domain=domain_key,
263                            role=role_key,
264                            provider=role_spec,
265                        )
266                    )
267                elif isinstance(role_spec, dict):
268                    # Full spec: [roles.writing.humanizer] provider = "..."
269                    provider = (
270                        role_spec.get("provider")
271                        or role_spec.get("agent_id")
272                    )
273                    if provider:
274                        self.register_binding(
275                            RoleBinding(
276                                domain=domain_key,
277                                role=role_key,
278                                provider=provider,
279                                model=role_spec.get("model"),
280                                interface=role_spec.get("interface"),
281                                capability=role_spec.get("capability"),
282                                timeout_seconds=role_spec.get(
283                                    "timeout_seconds", 300
284                                ),
285                                metadata=role_spec.get("metadata", {}),
286                            )
287                        )
288
289    def load_from_env(self) -> None:
290        """Loads bindings from HOWLPLANE_ROLE_<DOMAIN>_<ROLE> env vars."""
291        prefix = "HOWLPLANE_ROLE_"
292        for key, value in os.environ.items():
293            if key.startswith(prefix) and value.strip():
294                rest = key[len(prefix):].lower()
295                parts = rest.split("_", 1)
296                if len(parts) == 2:
297                    domain, role = parts
298                    self.register_binding(
299                        RoleBinding(
300                            domain=domain,
301                            role=role,
302                            provider=value.strip(),
303                        )
304                    )

Central declarative registry mapping domain roles to providers.

class RoleDispatcher: 
318class RoleDispatcher:
319    """Resolves and executes domain roles through HowlPlane backends."""
320
321    def __init__(
322        self,
323        binding_registry: Optional[RoleBindingRegistry] = None,
324        agent_registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
325    ) -> None:
326        self.binding_registry = binding_registry or get_default_role_registry()
327        self.agent_registry = agent_registry or AgentRegistry()
328
329    def resolve_provider(
330        self,
331        domain: str,
332        role: str,
333        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
334        preferred_provider: Optional[str] = None,
335    ) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], str]:
336        """Resolves target provider with honest independence calculation."""
337        binding = self.binding_registry.get_binding(domain, role)
338        candidate_provider = (
339            preferred_provider or (binding.provider if binding else None)
340        )
341        model_id = binding.model if binding else None
342
343        if not candidate_provider:
344            return None, None, IndependenceStatus.UNAVAILABLE.value
345
346        norm_candidate = AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(
347            candidate_provider
348        )
349        norm_avoid = (
350            AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(avoid_provider)
351            if avoid_provider
352            else None
353        )
354
355        if not norm_avoid:
356            return (
357                candidate_provider,
358                model_id,
359                IndependenceStatus.NOT_REVIEWED.value,
360            )
361
362        if norm_candidate != norm_avoid:
363            return (
364                candidate_provider,
365                model_id,
366                IndependenceStatus.INDEPENDENT.value,
367            )
368
369        # Candidate matches avoid_provider. Find available alternate.
370        available_agents = self.agent_registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
371        alternate = next(
372            (
373                a.agent_id
374                for a in available_agents
375                if AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(a.agent_id)
376                != norm_avoid
377                and AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(a.agent_id).is_available()
378            ),
379            None,
380        )
381
382        if alternate:
383            return alternate, None, IndependenceStatus.INDEPENDENT.value
384
385        return (
386            candidate_provider,
387            model_id,
388            IndependenceStatus.SAME_PROVIDER.value,
389        )
390
391    def execute(
392        self,
393        request: RoleExecutionRequest,
394        custom_backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None,
395        backend_resolver: Optional[Callable[[str], AgentBackend]] = None,
396    ) -> RoleExecutionResult:
397        """Executes a domain role request against the resolved backend."""
398        start_time = time.time()
399
400        if custom_backend is not None:
401            provider_id = getattr(
402                custom_backend, "agent_id", "custom_backend"
403            )
404            independence_status = (
405                IndependenceStatus.INDEPENDENT.value
406                if request.avoid_provider != provider_id
407                else IndependenceStatus.SAME_PROVIDER.value
408            )
409            model_id = None
410        else:
411            provider_id, model_id, independence_status = self.resolve_provider(
412                domain=request.domain,
413                role=request.role,
414                avoid_provider=request.avoid_provider,
415                preferred_provider=request.preferred_provider,
416            )
417
418        if not provider_id:
419            return RoleExecutionResult(
420                domain=request.domain,
421                role=request.role,
422                provider="none",
423                model=None,
424                success=False,
425                duration_seconds=0.0,
426                independence_status=IndependenceStatus.UNAVAILABLE.value,
427                error_message=(
428                    f"No executor or provider configured for role "
429                    f"'{request.role}' in domain '{request.domain}'."
430                ),
431                metadata={"request": request.to_dict()},
432            )
433
434        if custom_backend is not None:
435            backend = custom_backend
436        elif backend_resolver is not None:
437            backend = backend_resolver(provider_id)
438        else:
439            backend = AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(provider_id)
440
441        target_cwd = Path(request.cwd).resolve() if request.cwd else Path.cwd()
442
443        full_prompt = request.prompt
444        if request.system_instruction:
445            full_prompt = f"{request.system_instruction}\n\n{request.prompt}"
446
447        try:
448            agent_res: AgentExecutionResult = backend.execute(
449                task=None,
450                cwd=target_cwd,
451                role=f"{request.domain}:{request.role}",
452                prompt_override=full_prompt,
453                timeout_seconds=request.timeout_seconds,
454            )
455        except Exception as exc:
456            elapsed = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
457            return RoleExecutionResult(
458                domain=request.domain,
459                role=request.role,
460                provider=provider_id,
461                model=model_id,
462                success=False,
463                duration_seconds=elapsed,
464                independence_status=independence_status,
465                error_message=f"Backend execution exception: {exc}",
466                metadata={"request": request.to_dict()},
467            )
468
469        elapsed = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
470
471        if not agent_res.success:
472            err = (
473                agent_res.error_message
474                or agent_res.stderr
475                or "Provider execution failed"
476            )
477            return RoleExecutionResult(
478                domain=request.domain,
479                role=request.role,
480                provider=provider_id,
481                model=model_id,
482                success=False,
483                raw_output=agent_res.stdout,
484                duration_seconds=elapsed,
485                independence_status=independence_status,
486                error_message=err,
487                timed_out=agent_res.timed_out,
488                metadata={
489                    "request": request.to_dict(),
490                    "agent_result": agent_res.to_dict(),
491                },
492            )
493
494        raw_output = agent_res.stdout
495        structured = extract_structured_output(raw_output)
496
497        return RoleExecutionResult(
498            domain=request.domain,
499            role=request.role,
500            provider=provider_id,
501            model=model_id,
502            success=True,
503            raw_output=raw_output,
504            structured_output=structured,
505            duration_seconds=elapsed,
506            independence_status=independence_status,
507            error_message=None,
508            timed_out=agent_res.timed_out,
509            metadata={
510                "request": request.to_dict(),
511                "agent_result": agent_res.to_dict(),
512            },
513        )

Resolves and executes domain roles through HowlPlane backends.

RoleDispatcher( binding_registry: Optional[RoleBindingRegistry] = None, agent_registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None)

322        self,

324        agent_registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
325    ) -> None:
326        self.binding_registry = binding_registry or get_default_role_registry()
327        self.agent_registry = agent_registry or AgentRegistry()
binding_registry
agent_registry
def resolve_provider( self, domain: str, role: str, avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None, preferred_provider: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], str]: 
329    def resolve_provider(
330        self,
331        domain: str,
332        role: str,
333        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
334        preferred_provider: Optional[str] = None,
335    ) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], str]:
336        """Resolves target provider with honest independence calculation."""
337        binding = self.binding_registry.get_binding(domain, role)
338        candidate_provider = (
339            preferred_provider or (binding.provider if binding else None)
340        )
341        model_id = binding.model if binding else None
342
343        if not candidate_provider:
344            return None, None, IndependenceStatus.UNAVAILABLE.value
345
346        norm_candidate = AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(
347            candidate_provider
348        )
349        norm_avoid = (
350            AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(avoid_provider)
351            if avoid_provider
352            else None
353        )
354
355        if not norm_avoid:
356            return (
357                candidate_provider,
358                model_id,
359                IndependenceStatus.NOT_REVIEWED.value,
360            )
361
362        if norm_candidate != norm_avoid:
363            return (
364                candidate_provider,
365                model_id,
366                IndependenceStatus.INDEPENDENT.value,
367            )
368
369        # Candidate matches avoid_provider. Find available alternate.
370        available_agents = self.agent_registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
371        alternate = next(
372            (
373                a.agent_id
374                for a in available_agents
375                if AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(a.agent_id)
376                != norm_avoid
377                and AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(a.agent_id).is_available()
378            ),
379            None,
380        )
381
382        if alternate:
383            return alternate, None, IndependenceStatus.INDEPENDENT.value
384
385        return (
386            candidate_provider,
387            model_id,
388            IndependenceStatus.SAME_PROVIDER.value,
389        )

Resolves target provider with honest independence calculation.

def execute( self, request: RoleExecutionRequest, custom_backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None, backend_resolver: Optional[Callable[[str], AgentBackend]] = None) -> RoleExecutionResult: 
391    def execute(
392        self,
393        request: RoleExecutionRequest,
394        custom_backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None,
395        backend_resolver: Optional[Callable[[str], AgentBackend]] = None,
396    ) -> RoleExecutionResult:
397        """Executes a domain role request against the resolved backend."""
398        start_time = time.time()
399
400        if custom_backend is not None:
401            provider_id = getattr(
402                custom_backend, "agent_id", "custom_backend"
403            )
404            independence_status = (
405                IndependenceStatus.INDEPENDENT.value
406                if request.avoid_provider != provider_id
407                else IndependenceStatus.SAME_PROVIDER.value
408            )
409            model_id = None
410        else:
411            provider_id, model_id, independence_status = self.resolve_provider(
412                domain=request.domain,
413                role=request.role,
414                avoid_provider=request.avoid_provider,
415                preferred_provider=request.preferred_provider,
416            )
417
418        if not provider_id:
419            return RoleExecutionResult(
420                domain=request.domain,
421                role=request.role,
422                provider="none",
423                model=None,
424                success=False,
425                duration_seconds=0.0,
426                independence_status=IndependenceStatus.UNAVAILABLE.value,
427                error_message=(
428                    f"No executor or provider configured for role "
429                    f"'{request.role}' in domain '{request.domain}'."
430                ),
431                metadata={"request": request.to_dict()},
432            )
433
434        if custom_backend is not None:
435            backend = custom_backend
436        elif backend_resolver is not None:
437            backend = backend_resolver(provider_id)
438        else:
439            backend = AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(provider_id)
440
441        target_cwd = Path(request.cwd).resolve() if request.cwd else Path.cwd()
442
443        full_prompt = request.prompt
444        if request.system_instruction:
445            full_prompt = f"{request.system_instruction}\n\n{request.prompt}"
446
447        try:
448            agent_res: AgentExecutionResult = backend.execute(
449                task=None,
450                cwd=target_cwd,
451                role=f"{request.domain}:{request.role}",
452                prompt_override=full_prompt,
453                timeout_seconds=request.timeout_seconds,
454            )
455        except Exception as exc:
456            elapsed = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
457            return RoleExecutionResult(
458                domain=request.domain,
459                role=request.role,
460                provider=provider_id,
461                model=model_id,
462                success=False,
463                duration_seconds=elapsed,
464                independence_status=independence_status,
465                error_message=f"Backend execution exception: {exc}",
466                metadata={"request": request.to_dict()},
467            )
468
469        elapsed = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
470
471        if not agent_res.success:
472            err = (
473                agent_res.error_message
474                or agent_res.stderr
475                or "Provider execution failed"
476            )
477            return RoleExecutionResult(
478                domain=request.domain,
479                role=request.role,
480                provider=provider_id,
481                model=model_id,
482                success=False,
483                raw_output=agent_res.stdout,
484                duration_seconds=elapsed,
485                independence_status=independence_status,
486                error_message=err,
487                timed_out=agent_res.timed_out,
488                metadata={
489                    "request": request.to_dict(),
490                    "agent_result": agent_res.to_dict(),
491                },
492            )
493
494        raw_output = agent_res.stdout
495        structured = extract_structured_output(raw_output)
496
497        return RoleExecutionResult(
498            domain=request.domain,
499            role=request.role,
500            provider=provider_id,
501            model=model_id,
502            success=True,
503            raw_output=raw_output,
504            structured_output=structured,
505            duration_seconds=elapsed,
506            independence_status=independence_status,
507            error_message=None,
508            timed_out=agent_res.timed_out,
509            metadata={
510                "request": request.to_dict(),
511                "agent_result": agent_res.to_dict(),
512            },
513        )

Executes a domain role request against the resolved backend.
